He seems distracted, best to walk away while you can.
彼は気が散っているようだ。今のうちにその場を離れたほうがいい。
He begins to list off a seemingly endless amount of examples.
彼は、まるで尽きることのないかのような例を次々と挙げ始めた。
It looks like he's nearly finished.
もうすぐ終わりのようだ。
It seems like he's lost in reminiscence.
彼は思い出にふけっているようだ。
He doesn't seem to be stopping any time soon.
彼は当分、止まる気配がないようだ。
It seems like he's waiting expectantly.
彼は期待に胸を膨らませて待っているようだ。
He's thoughtfully rubbing his jaw. Best to leave him be
彼は思案げに顎をさすっている。放っておいたほうがいいだろう。
彼は誇らしげに満面の笑みを浮かべている。
It seems like he's deep in thought.
彼は深く考え込んでいるようだ。
He proceeds to rattle off several grievances about pastry making.
彼は、菓子作りに関する不満を次々と口にし始めた。
彼は期待に胸を膨らませて待っている。
You don't have the time for this.
こんなことに時間を割いている場合じゃない。
He seems pretty comfortable, best not to disturb him.
彼はぐっすり寝てるようだ。邪魔しないほうがいいだろう。
Heh, have fun, mate. Lot'sa treasure out there, eh?
へえ、楽しんでな、相棒。あそこには宝が山ほどあるんだろ？
Looks like the parrot dropped the map! You should get this back to Relend.
オウムが地図を落としたみたいだ！これをRelendに返してあげよう。
You have no use for this yet, you should speak with Relend up near the steering wheel.
まだこれは必要ないだろう。操舵輪の近くにいるRelendに話しかけてみよう。
You'll need a [Wooden Board], a [Center Piece], and a [String] to craft a Steering Wheel.
総舵輪をクラフトするには、[木の板]、[中心部品]、[糸]が必要だ。
This will probably work... You should show Relend.
たぶんこれでうまくいくはず……Relendに見せたほうがいい。
You have nothing to load... You should continue through the wreckage.
積むものは何もない……瓦礫の中を進み続けるべきだ。
Bring [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], and [{~} Berries] to the Cooking Pot
[{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], [{~} Berries]をCooking Potに持っていく
You'll need [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], and [{~} Berries] to make a stew.
シチューを作るには[{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], [{~} Berries]が必要だ。
Take a look at your content book if you forgot your project, this island has supplies we ought to collect!
やる事を忘れてしまったら、コンテンツブックを確認して。この島には、集めておくべきアイテムがある！
This looks dangerous! You should go blow open that boulder now.
これは危なっかしい！　今すぐあの岩を吹き飛ばしたほうがいい。
I've been looking for my old friend all this time. Sailing with every young adventurer in their prime!
ずっと、あの旧友を探し続けてきたんだ。全盛期の若い冒険者たちと、共に航海しながらね！
...Oh, you're goin' out with Relend, hey? You sure?
…おっ、Relend と出かけるのか、へえ？本気か？
This looks... edible. You should see what Relend thinks.
これは…食べられそうだ。Relend の意見を聞いてみよう。
Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to learn more of this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
おや、{p} 軍の者か。この凍てついた墳墓のことをもっと知りたいと思っている。力を貸してほしい。
If you don't remember what I said, I remember you writing something in your book. Try looking there.
私の話を覚えていないなら、本に何か書き留めていただろう。そこを見てみるといい。
You should head back to the mage with the wand.
杖を持ったあの魔術師のところへ戻るといい。
This is the Temple of Time...
Here you can visit the memories of this land...
ここでは、この地の記憶を訪れることができる…
The altar requires an item from the time you desire to access...
祭壇には、行きたい時代の品が必要だ…
You will access a memory as if you were present, but when you return it will be as if you were never there.
その場にいるかのように記憶の中へ入れるが、戻れば、まるでそこにいなかったかのようになる。
You should stick around to find out how to reverse the spell.
ここに残って、魔法を解く方法を突き止めるといい。
Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too far gone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
ぐああ…皆に…伝えろ。私はこの地を凍らせる。私は…も、もう手遅れだ。この地には癒える時間が要る…そして私の力は、封じ…凍らせねば…
If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
あの鼻持ちならない奴…Mael から学んだことがあるとすれば…理由なき死は魂をさまよわせる。あいつにこれ以上苦労をかけたくはない。
Wha... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true that this place has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
何と…これほどの真実が…氷の魔法が腐敗を防ぐ…？確かにここは地方の他の場所より腐敗の脅威が少なかった…
Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... It was to protect everyone... but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
なんということだ…ずっと勘違いしていた…皆を守るためだった…だが正気なら、誰かに意図を伝えたはずだ！
I froze this land to allow it to heal.. People did not understand.. They came for me here, seeking revenge.
この地を凍らせたのは癒すためだった…人々には理解されなかった…彼らは復讐を求めてここへ来た。
Of course, just like you.. They can not leave. Their souls are stuck here. For the spell must not be broken.
もちろん、お前と同じく…彼らは去れない。魂がここに囚われている。この魔法は決して破られてはならぬからだ。
Even if you think you can cure me.. I can not allow you to try for if it were to fail my corrupted body would wreak havoc on the world!
私を治せると思っていても…試させるわけにはいかない。失敗すれば、この腐敗した体が世界を破壊し尽くすだろう！
It will be dangerous...perhaps your toughest fight yet...but it must be done. If you need time to prepare, do so. But you must end Theorick's pain.
危険だろう…おそらくこれまでで最も厳しい戦いになる…だが、やらねばならない。準備が要るなら整えてくれ。だが、Theorick の苦しみは必ず終わらせてくれ。
Don't you just love fishing? The little waves in the river, the wind and the rewarding feeling when you catch something, those are my favorite things about it.
釣りって最高じゃない？川のさざ波、風、何かが釣れた時の満足感、そこが一番好きなんだ。
You can not return until your goal is fulfilled...
目的を果たすまで、戻ることはできない…
Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] で魔術師 Telvu と話す。
Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
Theorick と {p} の話は知っているか？
Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
知らないだろうな。実は、{p} は昔から凍っていたわけではない。
During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
Theorick の時代、ここは Wynn の平原のように暖かく、耕作に適していた。
For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
なぜか Theorick Twain は強大な力でこの地を凍らせ、自らをここに追放した。
We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
この魔法を解くには理由を突き止めねば。魔力の源はおそらく墳墓の中にある…だが手ぶらで入りたくはない。
As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
そこで…{p} という場所を聞いたことは？それを使って過去に戻り、Theorick の行いを探れるかもしれない。
Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
まあ…ある意味ではな。この手の魔法には法則がある。一つ、見たい時代の品が必要だ。二つ、過去は見られても変えられない。
One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Theorick の杖の一本が {p} の銀行に展示されている。目的には使えるはずだ。どうにか取ってこられるか？
{p} の銀行で Theorick の杖を見つける。
Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
ははあ、早いな。杖を手に入れたか。銀行員に手放させるには、相当口が回ったのだろう。
Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
さて、{p} までは長い道のりだ。だが歩く必要はない、私が転送しよう。たぶんな。
Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
着いたら Temple of Time に入れ。そこへ行けば何をすべきか分かるはずだ。時間旅行には気をつけろ、友よ…何に出くわすか分からん。
ポータルに入るだけでいい。
Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
何かあれば、ここに残って神殿へ転送し戻そう。
Enter the portal the mage made.
魔術師が作ったポータルに入る。
Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.
[-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の Gate of Time に入り、過去へ遡る。
過去の {p} を探索する。
Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
うわ、君の武器も防具もすごく進んでる！
Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
Twain 家の人？あんな魔法は Twain 家しか使えないよ。
ああ、Theorick を探してるんだ。
He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
彼は戦争で忙しいよ。君も戦うべきじゃない？
He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
西へ向かったよ。何か緊急事態があったみたい。
We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
僕らは何年も腐敗と戦ってきた。ついに {p} まで飲み込まれそうなんだ。
Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
{p} の西の森で Theorick を見つける [{~1}, {~2}, {~3}]。
I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
確かにこっちへ行ったはずだが…ああ、今度は何だ、また愚か者か？この森は危険なんだぞ！
If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
助けが要るなら衛兵に苦情でも出せ。私は忙しい。この忌々しい地方を救う最中に、お前の牛乳を冷やしに行けるか！！
Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
耳が詰まってるのか？！言っただろう―
Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
くっ、奴らがついて来た！ほら見ろ！どいていろ。
As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
助ける相手が二人も要るか！さっさと失せろ、行方不明の女を探さねばならんのだ！
HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!
助けてー！逃げ切れない！！！衛兵！誰か！！
Whuh! That's her voice! Where is she?! I just cleared this area!
むっ！あの女の声だ！どこだ？！この辺りは片付けたばかりだぞ！
Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
くっ、西から奴らを引き連れてきたのか？！そこのお前、凍りたくなければ今すぐ私の後ろに下がれ！！
Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
ふう…もう安全だ。だが町を出なければ、そもそも危険な目に遭うこともなかったんだ！
Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
謝るのはいい、町に戻れ。今すぐだ。
Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
次に森で花摘みだか何だかしたくなったら、自分の命を思い出せ、いいな？！
Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
毎日、腐敗体は増え、死者も増える…手はひとつ。私自ら片をつける。根を断ち…この地獄の雑草を殺す。
Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
まだいたのか？なら聞け。私と数人で危険な計画を立てている。正気を失おうが構わん、あのポータルを通らねばならん。
You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
装備は立派なようだから、お前を徴用する。直ちに拠点に来い。川沿いに南へ行けば、右手に家が見える。
Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
{p} の南にある作戦拠点へ向かう [{~1}, {~2}, {~3}]。
Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
まあ、これは認めよう。少なくとも命令にはすぐ従うな。我々は {p} へ向かう。
The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
ポータルに入って戻った最後の男は Bak’al になった…だがわずかでも可能性があるなら、今はそれに賭けるしかない。
Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
出発だ。道中休憩はなしだ、準備はできているだろうな。
Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
さて。私の操る極寒は腐敗そのものを食い止められる。お前たちに同じことが言えるとは思えん。私一人で入る。
When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
私が入れば…推測だが、腐敗体が後を追ってポータルに群がるだろう。お前の役目？奴らを倒せ。中で気を散らすわけにはいかん。
You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
私がポータルから出るまで、持ち場を離れるな。分かったな？
...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
…だめだ、だめだ、だめだ！！くそっ！！
You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
何が起きたか分かるか？！負けたんだ！！完全に変わり果てれば、私は地方を滅ぼす！離れろ、今すぐ！聞こえるか？！逃げろ！！
I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
私は…お、落ち着け、Theorick…飲まれるな…まだ…解決策は…一つ…
Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
ああ…またお前か…他の者は…死んだ？逃げた？臆病者め…うぐっ…
You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
生きているなら…顔を上げろ。聞け。私が変われば…い、いや、変わった時…だ、だめだ…ぐああ、私は滅ぼ…んぐっ…
I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
長くはもたん、分かるだろう…今…私を殺すのは不可能だ、この愚かな弱…ぐっ、私の頭から出ていけ！！
All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
皆、役立たずだ…いや、違う…彼らにも生きる資格はある…この魔法は…必ず犠牲を出す。どうか、理由を伝えてくれ…
K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
す、進み続けろ。お前の装備…皆がお前ほど強ければ…勝ち目はあるかもしれん。私が弱った暁には、これで私を終わらせられるだろう。
Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
知らしめよ…Theorick Twain は死んでいない。殺すことはできぬ…全ては燃える…未来の日まで。ここ、この呪われた地で。私を見つけ…全てを終わらせよ。
Tell Telvu the mage what happened.
魔術師 Telvu に何があったか伝える。
You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
成功したようだな、でなければまだ過去の記憶の中にいるはずだ。君から強い魔力を感じる。
So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
それで、Theorick に会ったのか？大凍結の後、彼は英雄から堕ちたと言われてきた。
Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
せめて、なぜ彼がここを凍らせたのかは分かったか？
All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
これほど長く、生き埋めのまま腐敗と戦ってきたとは。その顔を見るに、君もぞっとしているようだな。彼を殺すことは慈悲になるだろう。
Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
ほら、これを使え。氷の墳墓の中で身を守ってくれるかもしれない……頼む、兵士よ。Theorick の守護天使になってくれ。彼をこの苦しみから解き放ってやってくれ。
Most of the pages are filled with religious verses. At the very end of the book, there's a card separate from the rest of the pages.
ページのほとんどは宗教の詩句で埋まっている。本の最後に、ほかのページとは別に一枚のカードが挟まれている。
I covered over the way down to that giant archive like you asked. It shouldn't be reachable now.
言われたとおり、あの巨大な書庫へ下りる道はふさいでおいた。もう辿り着けないはずだ。
It'd take something really heavy to crack open the foundation- Frankly, that gold church bell might do it if it's not maintained.
あの土台をこじ開けるには、よほど重いものが必要だ――正直に言えば、手入れをしなければあの金の教会の鐘でも足りるかもしれん。
I left ladders and platforms as access to the bell tower- Make sure you keep it in good condition! I don't want to have to do that kind of work again.
鐘楼へ上がれるように梯子と足場を残しておいた――ちゃんと手入れしておけよ！あんな仕事を二度とやりたくはない。
What, are you thinking "oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?" IS THAT IT?!
何、「変なエルフの子が何度も何度も失敗するのを見物しよう」って思ってるの？！そうなの？！
This is enough, Lari. I waken. And thus, your task is complete, {u}. You have done as Orphion asked.
もうよい、Lari。我は目覚めた。これで汝の務めは果たされた、{u}。汝は Orphion の求めたとおりに成した。
What connection does a primordial force have with the moral leanings of mortals- or even immortals?
原初の力が、定命の者――いや、不死の者であっても――その道徳の傾きと、いかなる関わりを持つというのか？
For now, {u} must learn what you have learned, of the nature of realms. They must know what you know if they are to aid you fully.
今はまず、{u} が汝の学んだこと、すなわち領域の本質を学ばねばならぬ。彼らが心から汝を助けるには、汝の知ることを知らねばならぬ。
Allow me to show you our reality, {u}. It is difficult to properly present its scale... So here is an approximation.
我らの現実を見せよう、{u}。その規模をそのまま示すのは難しい……ゆえに、これはあくまで近いかたちだ。
The balance shifts, and Orphion grows weary. Angered, desperate. He called to you as a last plea- and you have done admirably, for what he has asked of you.
均衡は傾き、Orphion は疲れ果てていく。怒り、そして絶望している。彼は最後の願いとして汝に呼びかけた――そして汝は、求められたことを見事に果たした。
Enter the portal, {u}. I shall show you the Gateway to Light... And I shall wish you luck.
ポータルに入れ、{u}。光への門を示そう…そして幸運を祈る。
What you have done may not have been the right thing, by anyone's account. However, it was necessary. You have thrown off your bonds, in a sense.
誰から見ても正しい行いではなかったかもしれぬ。だが、必要だった。ある意味、お前は己の枷を振り払ったのだ。
New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
新しいクエスト開始: 光の領域 IV - 光を求めて
That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
今ので土台が割れたはずだ！メモのカードにあった書庫へ行けるか確かめよう。
The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
仕掛けを作動させたので、下の扉が開くはずだ。
Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
何ページか破り取られている。最初の欠けたページまでは、森の守護者に起きた出来事が書かれているようだ。
The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
本の残りは無傷だ。書庫が封じられていたなら誰の仕業だ？先に誰かが入ったのか？
...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
…こうしてそれは戻り、眠ったまま目覚めなくなった。光は語った、守護者が再び我らの前に現れる時が来ると…
...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
…だがその時は数百年先で、多大な努力を要する。同封の呪文はその過程に不可欠だ。
The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
光は警告もした。闇が迫り守護者の根に達すれば、二度と目覚めぬと…だが、その心配はなさそうだ。
There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
ここにも破れたページがあり、高位 Gavel 語が書かれている。Lari なら訳せるはずだ。
...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
…さあ、やって。今のところ、私はあなたの通訳でしかないみたいね。
The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
光の声は彼女を追えと告げた。今さら止まるわけにはいかないだろう？
The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
この建物は登れそうだ…壁を登れば、会話を盗み聞きできるかもしれない。
出てって！とにかく…出てって。
You got the plant! You should return by the Guardian of the Forest to proceed.
植物を手に入れた！森の守護者のもとへ戻って先へ進もう。
I DON'T CARE ANYMORE! STOP STEALING MY LIFE LIKE THIS!!!
もうどうでもいい！こんなふうに私の人生を奪わないで！！！
...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS "ENOUGH!" TELL ME, NOW!
…ぐああああっ！！これのどこが「十分」なの！今すぐ答えて！
To do something "dark," you are about to say, and to that I say you have not.
「闇」に手を染めた、と言うのだろう。だがそうではない。
For a thousand years or more of your own thoughts, I understand that you are conflicted.
千年以上も独りで考え続けたのだ。迷うのも無理はない。
However... You have, in that time, made a grave error. You have grown to realize an incorrect assumption.
だが…その間にお前は重大な過ちを犯した。誤った思い込みを真実と信じたのだ。
Dark and Light... They oppose. They clash. They create a cloying pox. But, allow me to ask.
闇と光…両者は対立し、衝突し、息苦しい病を生む。だが、問わせてほしい。
Is the axe evil for chopping the tree? Is the wood evil for resisting the metal?
木を切る斧は悪か？金属に抗う木は悪か？
Are the flames evil for burning up the leaves? Is the water evil for dousing the fire?
葉を焼く炎は悪か？火を消す水は悪か？
Is a victim evil for striking back against those that have struck them?
自分を傷つけた者に反撃する被害者は悪か？
And most importantly... Are any of these things light, or dark?
そして何より…これらのうち、光はどれで、闇はどれだ？
I will not ask you to. You must understand that Orphion has no moral bearings- He simply needs action.
無理にとは言わぬ。Orphion に善悪の基準はないと知るのだ。彼はただ行動を求めている。
I admit, such a thing is a conundrum. I agree that it is a tragedy to kill, in many instances.
確かに難問だ。多くの場合、殺すことは悲劇だと私も思う。
Yet when such an action could save the lives of others, it becomes a conundrum with no answer. An impossible value to weigh.
だがその行いが他者の命を救うなら、答えのない難問となる。量りようのない重さだ。
Despite the circumstances, you have done the best you could. I cannot fault you for your thoughts and morals.
あの状況で、お前は最善を尽くした。その考えも良心も責められはせぬ。
And so... As you are now proven, as I am awoken, the gateway to the Light shall reveal itself to you. Lari... You must prepare for your journey to the Realm of Light.
そして…お前が証を立て、私が目覚めた今、光への門が姿を現すだろう。Lari…光の領域への旅に備えるのだ。
I do not blame you for it. By the time you have composed yourself, your ally will be ready. Understand that they are as necessary as you are.
お前を責めはせぬ。心が落ち着く頃には、仲間の準備も整っていよう。彼らもお前と同じく欠かせぬ存在なのだ。
I must ask you to pay close attention. I shall present it simply- though the enormity of this cannot be understated.
よく聞いてほしい。簡潔に話そう。事の重大さは言い尽くせぬがな。
This is our world, the world we stand in right now. The physical plane of existence.
これが我らの世界、今立っている世界。存在の物質界だ。
Only a select few are aware that there is more of the world than this. Even the astronomers and those who view the enormity of the sky cannot understand.
これ以上の世界があると知る者はごく僅かだ。広大な空を眺める天文学者でさえ理解できぬ。
For, you see, this realm, this plane- It is mirrored upon a second plane, as the embodiments of Realms clash.
この界は第二の界に映し出されている。そこで諸領域の化身がぶつかり合うのだ。
This is the Plane of Influence, comprised of many realms. There are three you must know- But only one you must pay attention to.
それが影響界、多くの領域から成る界だ。知るべきは三つ。だが注意すべきは一つだけだ。
The Realms of Influence are connected to the physical plane, tied inexorably so to it. This is why even those gazing at the cosmos cannot grasp the enormity of it.
影響の領域は物質界と切っても切れぬほど結びついている。ゆえに宇宙を見つめる者にも全容は掴めぬ。
These realms are in a constant push and pull- Battles that could not be seen by those of this world, waged constantly.
これらの領域は絶えず押し合い引き合っている。この世界の者には見えぬ戦いが続いているのだ。
However, they can be felt. Wide-scale changes to the balance of one realm or another are reflected on the physical plane.
だが、感じ取ることはできる。いずれかの領域の均衡が大きく揺らげば、物質界にも表れる。
The Realms of Influence are, themselves, reflections of a Beast- They themselves, a physical manifestation of their realm, as their realm is a manifestation of them.
影響の領域そのものが、ある獣の映し身だ。獣はその領域の具現であり、領域もまた獣の具現なのだ。
So surely, you must know- As Gavel has decayed, it must mean that the Realm of Light is in peril, and thus that Orphion is, as well.
ならば分かるだろう。Gavel が腐朽した以上、光の領域は危機にあり、Orphion もまた危ういのだ。
The Light is infected- That abominable parasite has breached the Realm of Light, and sought Orphion to leech away his light.
光は侵されている。あの忌まわしき寄生体が光の領域に入り込み、Orphion の光を吸い取ろうとしている。
And so, as the sun is forced to set, the land of Gavel grows dark. As the dark parasites spread and devour the minds of those here, so too is Orphion subject to this torture.
ゆえに陽は沈まされ、Gavel の地は暗くなってゆく。闇の寄生体が人々の心を喰らうように、Orphion もまた同じ責め苦を受けている。
Now, you must enter the Realm of Light, and aid Lari in purging the parasite, before its work is finished and Orphion's mind is consumed.
さあ、光の領域へ入り、Lari と共に寄生体を祓うのだ。その企みが成り、Orphion の心が喰い尽くされる前に。
You must ready yourself before this, of course. To venture to another realm is a lofty task.
無論、その前に備えねばならぬ。別の領域へ赴くのは大事業だ。
I will bestow upon you two things that will surely aid you in this, however. First, I shall provide you the way to the Gateway to Light.
だが、きっと助けとなるものを二つ授けよう。まずは、光への門への道を示す。
Once you have reached it, I shall bestow upon you a personal blessing of mine, in the hopes that your path will become clear.
そこに辿り着いたなら、私自らの祝福を授けよう。お前の道が明らかになるように。
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Lari を見つける。
目覚めて！導きが必要なの！
...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
…あら。{u}。ここでもあなたが必要とされてるってわけ？
I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
私は…必死に…森の守護者を目覚めさせて導きを得ようとしてるのに、びくともしない！Orphion の声にすら反応しないの。
I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
もう一度お願い、目覚めて！私たち二人は…あなたの知恵を求めてるの！
I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Orphion のかすかな光を捧げます。どうか、応えて！
Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can effect some change, considering what you've done before.
うう…ほらね？何も起きない。もうどうしたらいいかわからない。前にしてくれたことを考えたら、あなたなら何か変えられるかも。
Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
うう…ほらね？何も起きない。もうどうしたらいいか分からない。今までのあなたなら、何か変えられるかも。
My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
我が脈動よ、時は来た。守護者の根に我が光を照らそう。お前と彼女は、今こそ学ばねばならぬ。
Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.
大樹の根元の碑文を読む。
An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
碑文だわ！さっきまでなかったのに！それが…一瞬で現れた。一体どうやって…？
But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
でも、とにかく！私だって役に立てる、訳してあげる！Gavel のよそ者に高位 Gavel 語は分からないでしょうし…
It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
こう書いてある…秘密は {p} で最も古い図書館で明かされる、と。
...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
…そういうこと。エルフは入れないけど、人間は入れる場所。{u}、この図書館は自分で探すしかなさそうね。
Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
{p} の街の [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] にある教会図書館を探す。
Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
{p} の街の [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] にある教会図書館を探す
Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
教会の頂上にある鐘まで登る方法を探す。
Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
秘密の図書館を探索し、木を目覚めさせる方法を見つける。
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Lari のもとへ戻る
Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Orphion の光を拒むというの？お願い、目覚めて！
Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
うう…{u}、何か進展があったと言って。守護者はまだ…全然…目覚めない！
What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
これは何？呪文の巻物…目覚めの森の？！よりによって {p} で？私には…とても行けない場所なのに…
So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
私は Orphion に選ばれたのに、頼まれたことすらできなかったのね。それは…いえ、考えても仕方ない。巻物を見せて。
...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
…ふむ。求める者はこの言葉を守護者の言葉の上に置くべし、と。
I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
つまり、碑文のそばに置けってことね。またあなたがやらなきゃいけない仕事か…
Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.
木の下の碑文に呪文を使う。
Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
これも読ませて。骨が折れそうだけど…
It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
こう書いてある…森の守護者を目覚めさせるには魔法だけでは足りない。エルフの故郷に答えと啓示がある…？
That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
それって…ついに私の出番だわ！まだ私にもできることがある！！ここで現状を保つだけじゃなく、やっと何かができる！
Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
聞いて、{u}。Achara…今度は私の番。やっと直接あなたを助けられる。{p} の長老たちを知ってるの。きっと答えをくれるわ！
You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
私が悩んでる間も、あなたは本当に助けてくれた。感謝してる。でももう休んでいいわ！今回は私がやる！
You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
あなたは…他にやるべきことをやってて。いろんな場所で人助けしてるのを見てきたわ。今はそっちに専念して。ここは私に任せて。
Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
彼女を追え、我が脈動よ。彼女は決死の行動をとらねばならぬ。独りではその光は何も照らさぬ。道を示してやれ。
Enter the portal Lari left behind
Lari が残したポータルに入る
Go to the hut Lari entered.
Lari が入った小屋へ行く。
W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
な、何？あなた…なんでついて来たの？私ならやれる！やっとまた役に立てるのに！私を…信用してないの？
Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
お願い、私の意思を尊重して！助けが要るなら私から探しに行く。今は帰って！あなたが心配することじゃない！
Find a way to sneak into the hut.
小屋に忍び込む方法を探す。
...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
…この人間が本当にお前の言う通りのことを成したなら、なぜ助けを拒む？お前らしくもない。
I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
分かってる、分かってるわ。ただ信じられないの。Orphion 本人に呼ばれて、Taproot にも入れて、Orphion の祝福の印まで持ってるのよ！！
They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
あの人は…ふらっと現れて、私が千年も人生を捧げてこの州を救おうとしてきたのに、私にできなかったことを数週間で全部やってのけたのよ！
Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
これがどれだけ腹立たしいか分かる？私の立場になったこともないのに、分かるっていうの？
No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
いや。分からぬ。だが、なぜこの助けに感謝せぬのかも分からぬ。
I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
感謝すべきなのは分かってる！ずっとそればかり考えてた。大喜びするべきなの！光は救われる、夢見たことそのものなのに…
But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
でも、自分がまるで役立たずに思えるの。私のしてきたことが全部無駄で、ずっと何もかも間違えてたみたいで！
I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
過ちを犯したのは分かってる。私が早く動いていれば、Dullahan は今も…彼自身のままだった。でも何ひとつ正しくなかったなんて、受け入れられない。
This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
これはまだ役に立てると証明するチャンスなの。Orphion が私を選んだのはまぐれじゃないって！お願い、碑文には長老なら行き先が分かるって！
...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
…千年経っても、我らには学ぶことが山ほどある。よかろう。
But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
だが、差し伸べられた助けは受け入れると約束せよ。この機会を無駄にはできぬぞ、Lari。
...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
…せめて一つくらい正しいことをしなきゃ。いつまでも足踏みしてられない。必要なことは何でもする！
You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
ならば缶詰の Abis という植物を探すのだ。巨大なシダの葉に覆われた洞窟の中にある。
Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
ありがとうございます。やっと本来の役目を果たせる！今度は何にも邪魔させない！！
...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
…人間よ、見えておるぞ。彼女に見つからなかったのは幸運だったな。こちらへ来て話せ。
So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
では、お前が Orphion の新たな選ばれし者か。意外でもあり、そうでもない。人間の評判は面白いからな。
Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
人間は何でも限りなく成し遂げると言われる。不可能な任務の達成であれ、道徳の戒めを破ることであれ。
In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
だが今回は、その両方をせねばならぬ。Orphion が命じたのだろう？ならばやるしかない。そのことは詫びよう。
I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Lari の働きは見てきた。この地にかけがえのない貢献をした。独りで腐朽の南下を食い止め、ゆえに守護者は今も我らと共にある。
However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
だが、彼女自身の道徳が事態の進展を阻んでいる。彼女は殺せぬ。そして再び光でこの地を満たすには、元凶を根絶せねばならぬ。
Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Orphion の状況は切迫している。ゆえに理解してほしい。道徳において彼は我らの上にいる。そうした概念は当てはまらぬ。
As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
光そのものの化身として、彼に道徳の感覚はない。あるのは存続と維持のみ。その求めに、多くの者は尻込みしよう。
It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
道徳を脇に置かねばならぬ事柄だ…それこそ Lari には受け入れられぬ。千年もの間、頑なにそれにしがみついてきたのだから。
To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
それを破るとは…正直、他に解決策があるとは思う。だが実のところ、もう時間が残されていないのだ。
She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
彼女は持てる力をすべて使わねばならぬが、不殺を貫く限りそれは叶わぬ。Orphion の望み通り、彼女の後を追ってくれ。
There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
残念ながら、ここに正しさはない。あるのは必要だけだ。そこで彼女を限界まで追い込むのだ。缶詰の Abis の洞窟を探せ。
It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
ここから北東だ。入口は巨大なシダの葉に覆われている。これで足りることを祈るばかりだ。
Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で缶詰の Abis の洞窟を見つける
Find the plant inside the cave.
洞窟の中で植物を見つける。
...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
…信じられない。私の何がいけないの？何なの？何か理由があるはず、それは何なの？！
There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by "dire actions?!" I've done everything I can think of!
新しい碑文もない…同じ言葉だけ！「決死の行動」ってどういう意味？！思いつくことは全部やったのに！
...{u}. I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
…{u}。わ、私、知りたいの。Orphion はあなたに何て言ったの？もう知らないままなんて耐えられない。本当に私の代わりにされたの？
Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
こ、これじゃまだ足りないの？あなたに縋って、役目もプライドも他人に譲るのが、まだ極端じゃないっていうの？！
I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
私のすることが全部…うまくいかなくなった理由が他に思いつかない。そうなの？お願い、教えて――
...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
…待って…あなた…缶詰の Abis を持ってる！！どこで手に入れたの？！
You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
あなた…知ってるはずがない、もし…あなた！盗み聞きしてたのね！！
You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
来ないでって頼んだのに、洞窟までついて来たのね！あなた…私があれだけ言ったのに！！私の心の内を全部聞いておきながら！
You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
それでもまだ追ってくるのがいい考えだと思ったの！こんなことして何がしたいの？！
You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
やっぱり聞いてたのね！！全部バレてる！私は成功できない！あなたがいる！私にできないことを全部やってる！
I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
私は役立たずじゃない！違う！そうはならない！絶対に！私がもがいてあがくのを見物なんてさせない！！
Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
こ、殺しかけたのよ！私が守ってきたもの全部を、踏みにじって汚したのよ！！
TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
答えて！！どうしてこれが答えなの？！どうしてこうならなきゃいけなかったの？！
WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
なぜ私がこんな…こんな…
T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
わ、私にできないことをやったからって殺そうとしたのが、闇じゃないって？どうしてそう思えるの？！
What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
こんな暴力を許すなんて、どういう守護者なの？今の私のどこが許されるっていうの？
...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
…あなた。私のしたことが正しかったなんて、言うはずないわよね。そんなの受け入れない。
...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
…だったら…感じるべきじゃないの…分からない。縛られてない感じとか？怖くないとか？もっと…自由だとか？
If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
私のしたことが必要なことだったなら、なぜ自分が最低のクズに思えるの？なぜこんなに苦しいの？！
...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
…私…考える時間が欲しい。私…これを聞くのが、受け止めるのがどれだけつらいか分かる？
My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
我が脈動よ、お前の光は眩い…それは Lari を照らし、やがて彼女の光も我が方へ届くだろう…
Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
根に入り、我が領域への道を見届けよ。そして備えよ。最も眩い光を奮い起こすのだ…
secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in cinfras
最も古い図書館で明かされる秘密は Cinfras にある
awakening the guardian of the forest requires more than just magic
森の守護者を目覚めさせるには、魔法だけでは足りない
the home of the elves will house the answers and revelations
エルフの故郷に、答えと啓示が眠っている
dire actions in the presence of the guardian will waken many things
守護者の御前での凶行は、多くのものを目覚めさせる
Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Gavel のパスポートを [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の飛行船の受付に持っていく。
Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
こんにちは、兵隊さん！本日はご搭乗ですか？
May I see your passport please?
パスポートを拝見します。
It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
ちょっと埃っぽいですね！かなり古そうですが、写真はあなたですね。
Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
はい、問題ありません。ご搭乗ください、快適な旅をお祈りします。
Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
乗客の皆様、ご着席ください。まもなく離陸いたします！
Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.
行方不明の子供について Ackbar 船長と話す。
Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
乗客の皆様にお知らせします。船内で行方不明者の届けがありました。捜索にご協力いただける方は、艦橋で船長にお申し出ください。
This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee at your cabin.
離陸中、この区域は乗客立入禁止です。客室デッキへお上がりください。お部屋で係員がお待ちしています。
熊は腹を空かせているようだ…
The bear really liked the cod!
クマはタラをすごく気に入ったみたい！
I hope I don't get nauseous...
Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
やあ、若き冒険者よ。わしの眼鏡を見かけなかったかね？
The interior of this ship is beautiful!
この船の内装は素敵だ！
Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
こんにちは、兵隊さん！こちらが今回のお部屋です。快適な空の旅を！
You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
他にすることがなければ、ここで寝て過ごしてもいいですよ！
The food they're serving here is dreadful! As if it was meant for the beasts they transport below deck.
ここの食事はひどいわ！まるで下の甲板で運んでる獣のエサみたい。
*Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
*ぐすっ*…うちの子を見ませんでしたか？部屋にいたのに、急にいなくなったんです！
I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
北から大きな船が近づいてるらしい。入口デッキから見えたよ。何をするつもりだろう。
Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
行方不明の子の捜索に志願してくれたのかね？
We only just set off and there is already an incident.
出発したばかりなのに、もう事件だ。
Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It's been following us since we lifted off.
ねえ！あっちの遠くの船を見て。離陸してからずっとついて来てるんだ。
His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
母親によると、乗船してすぐに息子がいなくなったそうだ。
Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
親の監督不行き届きだと思うがね。まあ、あの子を見つけねば。
Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
手がかりがないから、乗客に話を聞いて回るのがいいだろう。
Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
ほとんどは食堂かラウンジにいるはずだ。
Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
協力に感謝する。早くあの子が見つかるといいが。
Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.
乗客たちに話を聞き、行方不明の子供の居場所を突き止める。
Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
ねえ！あっちの遠くの船を見て。出発してからずっとこの船について来てるんだ。
I know I shouldn't be down here but...
ここにいちゃダメなのは分かってるけど…
I love airships, and I've never seen one like that.
飛行船が大好きなんだ。あんなの見たことないよ。
Okay then, I'll head back right now!
Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
うちの子を見つけてくれて本当にありがとう！残りの旅の間、この子は絶対にそばから離しません。
I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
さっきは心配かけてごめんなさい…
Hello again, did you find him?
How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
どうして下に行けたんだ？！当番がいるはずだぞ！
Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
見つけてくれて本当にありがとう。志願者は君だけだった。
Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
旅のトラブルがこれだけで済むといいが。
What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
一体何事だ？乗組員、報告しろ！
Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
船長！エンジンが一基吹っ飛びました！そちら側の推力が全部失われました！
Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
くそっ！エンジンが両方ないと、立ち往生だ。
Go check on the condition of the passengers.
乗客の様子を確認してきてくれ。
Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
兵士よ、機関室の機関士のところへ行ってくれ。再び動けるよう、何か手伝えることがないか確かめてほしい。
Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.
機関士に手伝えることがないか確かめる。
Ye must be the 'uman the captain done told me about.
おめえが船長の言ってた人間だな。
We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
下じゃ、えれえことになってるだ。
I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
おらはここでエンジンを見てねえと、こいつが自分をぶっ壊しちまう。
If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
手伝う気があんなら、索具を登ってプロペラを見てきてくれ。
Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
艦橋の点検口から行けるだ。
If'n they are stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
止まってたら、落ちてるブレーカーを入れりゃいい。
Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
終わったらここへ戻ってこい。おらはここでこいつを冷やさねえと。
Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.
飛行船のエンジンの不具合を見つけて直す。エンジンは艦橋から上がった気嚢の上にある。
In event of shut-down, maintenance must be performed.
停止時は、整備を行うこと。
That fixed the engine, better get back to the Engineer now.
これでエンジンは直った。技師のところへ戻ろう。
Worker must restart all wooden switches before the engine overheats.
作業員はエンジン過熱前に全ての木製スイッチを再起動すること。
DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
石製スイッチは押さないこと
Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.
エンジンを直したことを Engineer Eric に報告する。
Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
ありがとよ！エンジンがまた動き出しただ！
I couldn't have dun it without ye.
おめえがいなきゃ無理だった。
You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
部屋へ戻って休んでくれ。おめえみてえな乗客が船員の手伝いなんぞするもんじゃねえ。
I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the good cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
残りの旅がいいもんになるといいな。船長に言って全開にしてもらって、また進むだ。
All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff, report to stations!
全乗組員、持ち場につけ！訓練ではない！全乗組員、持ち場につけ！
That should be enough of them gone. The way to the lower deck is open
これだけ倒せば十分だろう。下甲板への道が開いた
Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.
下層デッキを探索し、爆発の原因を突き止める。
Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
しっかりしろ、おめえならやれる！
Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
野郎ども、船を安定させろ。まだ助かる！奴らの追跡を止めればいいんだ！
もう一隻の船へ向かう。
Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
Send more in! They can't get all of us!
もっと送り込め！全員は倒せないさ！
The rest of you all, get in here!
残りの奴らも、全員来な！
I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
戦いの音が？誰かいるのか？わしは牢屋の中だ！
I heard the fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
上で戦っているのが聞こえた、見事だ！あの略奪者どもが報いを受けるのを見られるなら、この老骨も温まる。
It looks like the way out is open.
出口への道が開いたようだ。
I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
わしはかつて Gavel 一の錠前師だった！不幸にも、あちこちに名が知れていてな。
These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
この悪党どもは何年も前にわしを捕らえ、略奪用の鍵を何百本も作らせた。
I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
もう年だが、この世を去る前に奴らが倒されるのを見たいものだ。
My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
わしの鍵作りの道具は、廊下の先の階段の裏にしまってある。それで女王の部屋に入る鍵を作れるはずだ。
Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
鍵穴を覗けば作り方が分かる。幸運を祈る！
Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.
スカイレイダーの女王のもとへ行くための鍵を作る。
So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
あたしの船に乗り込めると思ったのかい？
Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
手下を殺して？略奪の邪魔をして？
I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
あんたみたいな「厄介者」の扱いは心得てるよ！
Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.
スカイレイダーの女王と戦い、彼女の私物の宝を一つ持ち帰る。
Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.
船から脱出し、Ackbar 船長と話す。
Wow... You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
なんと、スカイレイダーの襲撃を一人で撃退するとは。
And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
しかも乗客なのに！大した働きだった…
We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
この船には防衛手段がない。民間の輸送船なのだ。
What is this? A ring from the Queen?! It looks valuable. You should keep it.
これは？女王の指輪？高価そうだ。君が持っていたまえ。
I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
どう礼をすればいいか…君には大きな借りができた。
Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
待て！そうだ！{p} と {p} の間を無料で移動できるようにしよう！
Wait! I know! You can have free travel between {p} and {p}!
待ちたまえ！そうだ！{p} と {p} の間を無料で往復できるようにしよう！
A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
Calo という自家用飛行船の持ち主に大きな貸しがある。
I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
話はつけておく。彼の船に乗るだけで、往復で運んでくれるぞ！
Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
ああ、それから謝礼金もたっぷり出る。指輪は途中で傷まないよう私が直接彼に送っておくから、向こうで受け取ってくれ。
Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
入口デッキへ下りてくれ。まもなく {p} 空軍基地に到着する。
Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.
入口デッキへ下り、船を降りる。
Speak to Calo next to the little ship at the {p} docks.
{p} の港にある小さな船の横で Calo と話す。
Hey there. You must be the Human Ackbar told me about.
やあ。Ackbar が言ってた人間だな。
I heard what you did on the ship, very admirable. Fortunately for you, I owe Ackbar.
船でのことは聞いたよ、見事だった。運がいいな、俺は Ackbar に借りがある。
I'll take you from {p} to {p} or vice versa whenever you want.
いつでも {p} から {p}、その逆でも乗せてやる。
All you have to do is board my ship. Oh, this was also from Ackbar.
俺の船に乗るだけでいい。ああ、これも Ackbar からだ。
Y'see, I got a few things here... look around for a bit, they're all very rare...
ほら、いいモンがあるだろ…ちょっと見てきな、どれも激レアだぜ…
I see that look in yer eyes... Ya interested in something here? It's all 'fa sale...
その目つき、分かるぜ…何か気になるモンでも？全部売りモンだ…
..Say, humie... I ain't mean to alarm ya, but do ya know who that guy sneakin' up behind 'ye is?
…なあ、人間ちゃん…脅かす気はねえが、あんたの後ろに忍び寄ってるあいつ、誰だか知ってるか？
OI! Wake up, you damned miscreant!
おい！起きろ、このクズ野郎！
Took ya long enough.. Alright, listen up, maggot!
ずいぶん寝てやがったな…よし、よく聞け、ウジ虫！
We found ya outside of {p}, passed out near some dead body, and... Well, we had to arrest someone for that merchant's death!
{p} の外で、死体のそばでぶっ倒れてるお前を見つけてな…まあ、あの商人殺しで誰かを捕まえなきゃならなかったんだよ！
And don't think you get to just lounge around all day in your cell. You gotta do work here, or you're getting thrown in the hole.
牢屋で一日中ゴロゴロできると思うなよ。ここでは働くんだ。さもなきゃ独房行きだ。
But for now, you’re stayin’ in your cell, understood? Now, stay here, and take a look around your cell. You'll know when it's time to work..
だが今は牢屋にいろ、分かったな？ここで待って、牢屋の中を見ておけ。仕事の時間になれば分かる…
GWAH! Who the hell are you?
Oh, thank grook, you're just another prisoner... So young, too...
おお、Grook に感謝を、ただの囚人か…しかもこんなに若い…
You just got here, right? Well... I can tell you're innocent... Just like almost everyone else in this forsaken prison...
来たばかりじゃろ？ふむ…お前さんが無実なのは分かる…この呪われた刑務所のほぼ全員と同じようにな…
Listen, human... This prison... You couldn't have come to a more horrific prison in the entire world! This place is hellish!!
聞け、人間…この刑務所は…世界中でこれ以上恐ろしい所はない！ここは地獄じゃ！！
The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
ここの看守どもはサディストじゃ！適当に囚人を牢から引きずり出し、そいつらは二度と戻らん！わしら全員をここで殺す気なんじゃ！
I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
本気じゃぞ、人間！ここに残ればお前さんも殺される！何としてもここから逃げるんじゃ、どんな代償を払っ―
Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
おい、クズ！お前は来い。今すぐ牢から出ろ！
Are you sure, uh, sir? I don't think I'm supposed to be anywhere today...
ほ、本当ですか、旦那？今日はどこにも行く予定はないはずじゃが…
Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
ほう、抵抗とは賢いつもりか？？おい Jon、入口を塞げ！
H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
お、おい！何を――離せ――うわああああ！！誰か！！助けて！！！頼む！！！！
OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
おい！ぼーっとしてんじゃねえ、ウジ虫！牢の格子のところへ来い。
It’s work time, filth. I'll escort you to the hallways. Once you're there, someone will tell you what to do. Do as they say, and you might come back tonight.
仕事の時間だ、クズ。廊下まで連れていく。そこで誰かが指示を出す。言われた通りにすりゃ、今夜は戻ってこられるかもな。
You got that, wretch? Alright, now get out of your cell!
分かったか、ゲス野郎？よし、牢から出ろ！
Get your instructions from the guard
看守から指示を受ける
Guess you're the one on cleanin' duty, huh? Alright. Listen up, scum!
お前が掃除当番か？よし。よく聞け、クズ！
Take this sponge, and look around the hallways. If you see a mess, use the sponge to clean it up. Someone will escort you back to the cells once you're done.
このスポンジを持って、廊下を見て回れ。汚れを見つけたらスポンジで掃除しろ。終わったら誰かが牢まで連れ戻す。
Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
分かったか？よし。さっさと働け！
Search the hallways for messes to clean up
廊下で掃除すべき汚れを探す
Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
You're done cleaning? Alright, it's time for rollcall. You're being escorted back to the cell block. Follow me, and don't move.
掃除は終わったか？よし、点呼の時間だ。牢区画まで連れ戻す。ついて来い、勝手に動くなよ。
Well, well, well... Looks like the dross of society is here on time!
おやおや…社会のカスどもが時間通りに揃ったようね！
Alright. Stay in line, and don't move, maggots! It's time for roll call...
よし。列を乱すな、動くんじゃないよ、ウジ虫ども！点呼の時間だ…
You’re all here… Ha! That’s a surprise, you outcasts can actually follow orders!
全員いる…ハッ！驚いた、はみ出し者どもにも命令が守れるとはね！
...Hm… Looks like we’ve got a new arrival too.. Don’t worry, peon... your soul will be well secure here for the rest of eternity.
…ふむ…新入りもいるようね…心配いらないよ、下郎…お前の魂はここで永遠にしっかり預かってあげる。
Alright. That’s it for now, you worthless menaces. It’s meal time. Head to the cafeteria, and pray that we’re not giving you your last meal.
よし。今はここまでだ、役立たずの厄介者ども。食事の時間だよ。食堂へ行って、これが最後の食事じゃないよう祈るんだね。
Find a place to sit in the cafeteria
食堂で座る場所を探す
Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
やあ…なあ、ちょっと…頼みを聞いてくれないか…？
I'm... starving to death here... those blasted guards won't... let me get any food...
俺…ここで飢え死にしそうなんだ…あのクソ看守どもが…食べ物をくれなくて…
Please... to my right... There's some food sitting there, if you could get it for me, I'd be... eternally grateful...
頼む…俺の右に…食べ物が置いてある。取ってきてくれたら…一生恩に着るよ…
これは…これは…食べ物だ！！
I... I can't thank you enough, human... I should be able to keep going with this...
本当に…ありがとう、人間…これでまだ持ちこたえられそうだ…
Say... if you ever get out of this slaughterhouse... could you go to {p}... and try and talk with my family, there? Let them know that I'm still alive...? I'd appreciate that....
なあ…もしこの屠殺場から出られたら…{p} に行って…家族と話してくれないか？俺がまだ生きてると伝えてほしい…？そうしてくれたら嬉しい…
Hey.. It's alright, you can sit here, don't worry.
やあ…大丈夫、ここに座っていいよ、心配ない。
So... you're new here, right? Hah… Guessing you're innocent, just like the rest of us… and I mean that...
それで…新入りだろ？はは…君も無実なんだろうな、他のみんなと同じで…本気でそう思ってる…
He's tellin' the truth, new guy. Most of us here are just average civilians. I worked at a transportation company in {p}, and was delivering some crates to {p} when they snatched me just out of town.
新入り、そいつの言う通りだ。ここにいる大半はただの一般人さ。俺は {p} の運送会社で働いてて、{p} に木箱を届ける途中、町を出たところで捕まった。
Me too! I don't even know why I was put here at all! I wasn't even given a trial in court, or anything! They just plucked me off the streets and threw me in here!
俺もだ！なんでここに入れられたのかも分からない！裁判すら受けてないのに！通りからいきなり連れ去られて放り込まれたんだ！
They wanna kill you, that's why. Did ya hear about Revan? He got taken away a couple of days ago, after he accidentally stumbled during roll call. Nobody's heard or seen 'em since.
殺したいからさ、それだけだ。Revan の話は聞いたか？数日前、点呼中にうっかりつまずいて連れていかれた。それ以来、誰もあいつを見てない。
I… you're probably right... I just dont understand any of this anymore... I just want to escape this damn place for good...
俺…たぶんその通りなんだろうな…もう何もかも分からない…とにかくこの忌々しい場所から永遠に逃げ出したい…
...Good luck with that.. Only way out is through that exit door, and even then you gotta get into the Control Room, as well. It's...just impossible, y'know?
…まあ頑張れよ…出口はあの扉だけ、しかもその前に制御室に入らなきゃならない。そんなの…無理だろ、な？
Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
よし、食事は終わりだ！牢に戻れ、クズども！
...Well… That's this place in a nutshell for you, human. Just try not to get in anyone's way or step out of line, and you should be alright until they end up taking you.
…まあ…ここはざっとこんな所さ、人間。人の邪魔をせず列を乱さなきゃ、連れていかれるまでは何とかなるはずだ。
Oi, who’s this guy right ‘ere? We don’t know ya. Move it!
おい、こいつは誰だ？見ねえ顔だな。どけ！
‘Ey, ‘ey, let it rest, Don. They're not hurtin’ nobody.
おいおい、放っとけ、Don。誰にも迷惑かけちゃいねえ。
…分かりました、ボス…すいません…
Don’t worry about it. So... You know who we are, novello?
気にすんな。で…俺たちが何者か知ってるか、novello？
We’re part of the Placido Crime Family. We do business across the entire world; all parts of it, you know what I’m saying?
俺たちは Placido Crime Family の者だ。世界中で商売してる。隅々までな、分かるだろ？
Almost all of us at this table got caught for running with the family-... Ah, bet you’re surprised to hear that there are some guilty people up in this slaughterhouse, yeah?
このテーブルのほぼ全員、ファミリーの仕事で捕まったのさ――おっと、この屠殺場に本物の罪人がいると聞いて驚いたか？
It’s alright, you don’t have to worry about us getting plucked and killed like those other piacevole here. Guards keep on sayin’ something about “our souls are too tainted”, whatever they mean.
心配すんな、俺たちはここの他の piacevole みたいに連れていかれて殺されたりしねえ。看守どもは「魂が汚れすぎてる」とかぬかしてるがな。
Hah! Maybe you’ll get the same treatment too, novello. I saw it the minute I laid eyes on ya. You’re a killer too, ain't ya? Hey, gotta be one to know you're dealin' with one..
ハッ！お前も同じ扱いかもな、novello。一目見て分かった。お前も人殺しだろ？同類だからこそ分かるってもんだ…
..Anyways... You thinkin’ about staying in this prison, fratello? Word of advice: Don’t. If you can, you gotta escape. You might think it’s impossible for someone to escape here, or whatnot...
…ともかく…この刑務所に居続ける気か、fratello？忠告しとく、やめとけ。できるなら逃げろ。ここから逃げるなんて無理だと思うかもしれねえが…
Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
よし、食事は終わりだ！牢に戻れ、クズども！

But no, you're different. I can see it in those eyes. You just gotta find a way into that Control Room, somehow. And hey, if you do get outta here, go and raise some hell in the Levtus Black Market for us, yeah?
だが、お前は違う。その目を見りゃ分かる。何とかしてあの制御室に入ればいい。それと、ここを出られたら、俺たちの代わりに Letvus の闇市で暴れてきてくれよ、な？
Alright, look straight, scum! Morning rollcall is about to start.
よし、前を向け、クズども！朝の点呼を始めるよ。
...you’re all here...? Hm... Disappointing, honestly. Rollcall is over. All of you, head to wherever your job is, and get to work!
…全員いる…？ふむ…正直、がっかりだね。点呼は終わりだ。全員、持ち場へ行って働きな！
Search the hallways for possible escape routes, and find a guard outfit
廊下で脱出経路になりそうな場所を探し、看守の制服を見つける
Report to the Prison Guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
You're done? Alright, now follow me. Rollcall is about to start.
終わったか？よし、ついて来い。点呼が始まる。
What with you all, showing up late like this?? It's time for rollcall!
なんだいお前ら、こんなに遅れて？？点呼の時間だよ！
You're all here, huh? Alright then, head on to dinn-
全員いるね？じゃあ、晩飯に行き―
Oi! Quit steppin' on my shoes, cretino!
Hey! What the hell are you talkin' about, making up something like that! I didn't do anythin'!
おい！何言ってやがる、そんなでっちあげを！俺は何もしてねえ！
Shut it, fat-nose! You know what you were doin'! Now stay out of my way!
黙れ、デブ鼻！自分が何してたか分かってんだろ！どけ！
OI! Are you blind, or something?!? Get those lowlifes under control, guards!
おい！お前ら目が見えないのかい？！？看守ども、あのゴロツキを押さえな！
You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
お前ら二人、点呼中にケンカとはいい度胸だ！
W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
う、うわっ、おい！こいつナイフを持ってる！下がれ！！！
LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
封鎖！封鎖！全員、牢に戻れ、今すぐ！
You two really are stupid, huh? Fighting in the midst of all of these guards? And you got a shank, too...
お前ら二人、本当にバカだね？看守だらけの中でケンカ？しかも手製ナイフまで…
Well, looks like it's game over for you two outcasts. You're heading straight to the hole!
さて、はみ出し者二人はこれで終わりだね。独房へ直行だ！
You, take these two cretins to the hole, and you, go to my office and get one of the spare control room keys. Now, LIGHTS OUT!
お前はこのバカ二人を独房へ。お前は私の部屋から制御室の予備の鍵を取ってきな。さあ、消灯！
Alright, everyone get in line, and stand straight! Don't move, or it's game over for you!
よし、全員並んで、まっすぐ立ちな！動いたら終わりだよ！
H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-
お、おい！押すなって！マジで―
Well, well, well... Another peon thought it was wise to step off course..
おやおや…また下郎が一人、列を外れるのが賢いと思ったようね…
W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
ま、待ってください、所長！誰かに押し出されたんです！誓って！
BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
黙りな！しゃべっていいとは言ってないよ、クズ！
Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
列に戻りな！これが終わったら、お前はおしまいだ、ゲス！
Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room
所長室から鍵を盗み、制御室へ向かう
Find a way to open the exit door
出口の扉を開ける方法を探す
Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room
看守の目を盗み、記録室への道を探す
Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
おお、聖なる牛に感謝を！やっと味方の顔が見られた…
Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
聞いてくれ、人間、ここから出してくれ！奴ら一日中ここで人を殺してるんだ！助けてくれなきゃ次は俺だ！
Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
見ろ、俺の牢の隣の机の上！鍵がある！取って渡してくれ！
Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
そう、完璧だ、完璧！その鍵だ、渡してくれ！
I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
人間、この恩は言葉にできない…どれだけ感謝してるか…
Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
なあ、名前は何だ、人間？{u}？よし、俺は Kaetan だ。先に行け、後から追いつく。この解体場から出られたら、{p} で会おう。渡したい物がある。
た、た、たす…け…て…お、ね、が…いっ！
Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
ん…？お、おい！テーブルが燃えてる、誰か来て火を消すのを手伝え！
Find and destroy your criminal records
自分の犯罪記録を見つけて破棄する
Who are you? Can I help you, human?
どなた？何かご用ですか、人間さん？
WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
何ですって？？Taron が、い、生きてる？？しかもあなたが…刑務所で飢え死にしないようにしてくれたの…？
I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
私…人間さん、何とお礼を言えば。あの人が出られなくても、生きていると分かっただけで…どうか、大した物じゃないけど受け取って。
Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
こんばんは。何かご用でしょうか？
M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
む、息子が？生きてるの？！？ああ、牛神様、それは…！どこにいるの？？
...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
…刑務所、ですか？それでも…もう少し持ちこたえられると分かってよかった…本当にありがとう、人間さん。これをどうぞ！
The only way to escape is by heading through the exit door. You'll need to access the control room in order to open it...
脱出するには出口の扉を通るしかない。開けるには制御室に入る必要がある…
The Prison appears to be lying about almost everything they do to the government, and they appear to buy into it, despite all the rumors about this place.
この刑務所は自分たちの行いのほぼすべてを政府に偽っているようだ。噂が絶えないのに、政府はそれを信じ込んでいるらしい。
It looks like the only way to get out of here is through the exit door..
ここから出るには出口の扉を通るしかないようだ…
Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin to ya here..
おい、おい、人間ちゃん！そう、あんたに話してんだよ…
So, welcome to the {p}. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
というわけで、{p} 連邦刑務所へようこそ。お前は一生ここだ、短っ鼻。文句を言っても無駄だぞ。
中に囚人服が入っている。
There's a dusty key inside, labeled "SUPPLY CLOSETS"
中にほこりをかぶった鍵があり、「備品室」と記されている
シャワーの栓をひねる……
Some water came out of the shower head.
シャワーヘッドから水が少し出てきた。
Looks like there's an inmate being interrogated...
囚人が一人、取り調べを受けているようだ……
これが発電機に違いない……
It's blocked off, though the holes in the fence are wide enough for you to get something through...
ふさがれているが、柵の穴は何かを通せるくらいには広い……
This must be the exit door..
これが出口の扉に違いない……
It appears to be completely locked.
完全に施錠されているようだ。
There's some stuff on the table. It looks like... flesh??
机の上に何か載っている。まるで……肉のかたまり？？
You bite back the urge to vomit... was this once a person???
吐き気をこらえる……これは以前、人だったのか？？？
The book is titled 'A GUIDE TO SOUL EXTRACTION'.
その本の題は『魂の抽出の手引き』だ。
It'd probably be best not to touch it..
触らないほうがよさそうだ……
There's some broken bits and pieces of a torture device here..
ここには拷問具の壊れた破片がいくつか落ちている……
The blade is rusted and completely stained with dried blood..
刃は錆びつき、乾いた血で一面が汚れている……
There's some cheese inside of the crate.
木箱の中にチーズが少し入っている。
This must be the warden's office...
ここが所長室に違いない……
The warden seems very engrossed in her writing..
所長は書き物にすっかり没頭しているようだ……
You place the cheese on the floor, where the rat had run by...
ネズミが走っていったところに、チーズを床へ置く……
Looks like the rat dropped something when it ran away...
逃げるときに、あのネズミは何かを落としていったようだ……
You managed to fill your bucket with some water.
バケツに水を汲むことができた。
You throw the water bucket onto the generator...
水の入ったバケツを発電機にぶちまける……
Looks like something popped out of the generator...
発電機から何かが飛び出してきたようだ……
Looks like you've cleaned up all the messes! You should return to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're done.
汚れはすべて片付けたようだ！廊下の入り口にいる看守のところへ戻って、終わったと伝えよう。
You're escorted back to the cell block by the guard...
看守に連れられて房棟へ戻る……
The two of you arrive just as rollcall is about to begin. Some guards shove you into place with the other prisoners...
二人が着いたのは、ちょうど点呼が始まる直前だった。看守たちがあなたを他の囚人と並ぶ位置へ押しやる……
You're escorted to the cafeteria by the guards...
看守たちに連れられて食堂へ向かう……
You're escorted out of the cafeteria and back to your cell...
食堂から連れ出され、自分の房へ戻される……
Looks like that's the end of today... Your top priority tomorrow should be to devise a plan to escape the prison. Finding a guard outfit could be helpful, as well..
今日はここまでのようだ……明日いちばんに考えるべきは、この監獄から脱け出す計画だ。看守の制服を手に入れられれば役に立つだろう……
[{~}/{~}] ??? Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
[{~1}/{~2}] ??? よし！全員、起きろ！房から出ろ、今すぐだ！点呼の時間だ！
There's a lockpicking kit inside of this crate!
この木箱の中にピッキング道具が入っている！
There's a few stacks of coins inside of this crate.
この木箱の中に硬貨が何積みか入っている。
There are some vegetables inside of this crate.
この木箱の中に野菜がいくつか入っている。
This must be the exit door.
これが出口の扉に違いない。
This should be the most direct way out of the prison... You'll need to get into the control room to open it, though.
これが監獄から出る最も直接の道のはずだ……ただし開けるには制御室に入る必要がある。
It's the map of the prison's hallways.
Looks like the Warden isn't here during your regular work time... That could be useful later on...
普段の作業時間には所長はここにいないようだ……これは後で役に立つかもしれない……
This must be the control room those inmates were talking about yesterday...
これが昨日あの囚人たちが話していた制御室に違いない……
This room has to be your ticket out of this place. You just need to find a way inside of it...
この部屋こそ、ここから出るための切符に違いない。あとは中に入る方法を見つけるだけだ……
You vaguely remember the rat that had ran by here yesterday...
昨日ここを走っていったネズミのことを、なんとなく思い出す……
You put the guard uniform underneath your regular outfit. This should help you avoid some suspicion when you make your escape...
看守の制服を普段の服の下に着込む。脱走するとき、これで多少は怪しまれずに済むだろう……
Looks like this is all you'll be able to find for now. You should head back to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're finished working.
今のところ見つけられるのはこれだけのようだ。廊下の入り口にいる看守のところへ戻って、作業が終わったと伝えよう。
Time to take stock of the situation. You need to get out of here, and you might just have found enough out to do it.
状況を整理するときだ。ここから出なければならないし、そのために必要なことはもう十分つかんだかもしれない。
The Warden mentioned during rollcall that there's spare control room keys in her office. You'll have to find a way into her office during work time in order to access the control room.
点呼のとき、所長は自分の部屋に制御室の予備の鍵があると口にしていた。制御室に入るには、作業時間のあいだに所長室へ入り込む方法を見つけなければならない。
Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over fo-
よし、残りの者は仕事に行け！点呼は終わりだよ！
-The hell? Ow, hey! Get off me, you worthless pests!
――なんだ？いてっ、おい！離れろ、この役立たずの害虫どもが！
...All of you... Get out... Of my sight... NOW.
……お前たち全員……私の前から……消えろ……今すぐだ。
Now that the guard isn't standing here, you can more closely inspect this vent...
看守がここに立っていない今なら、この通気口をもっとよく調べられる……
It looks quite old, and the vent grates appear to be splitting at their seams... it shouldn't take too much effort to just...?
かなり古びていて、通気口の格子は継ぎ目のあたりが割れているようだ……それほど力を入れずに、ただ……？
Perfect! With the grate off, it's relatively easy to squeeze through the vent opening.
よし！格子が外れたので、通気口の口から体をねじ込むのは比較的たやすい。
These papers on the desk appear to be directed to the Warden.
机の上のこの書類は、所長に宛てたもののようだ。
The papers appear to be asking the Warden for...? A quota of souls...
書類は所長に何かを求めているようだ……？魂の割り当てを……
The signature at the end simply reads the letter D.
末尾の署名には、ただ D という文字だけが書かれている。
There are some books stacked up in piles right here.
ちょうどここに本が何積みか重ねられている。
The subject of the books range from the history of the Decay, to spirit magic and... Soul extraction.
本の題材は腐朽の歴史から、霊の魔法、そして……魂の抽出にまで及ぶ。
It'd probably be best to stop looking through these.
これ以上はめくらないほうがよさそうだ。
The key fits perfectly into the door's keyhole...
鍵は扉の鍵穴にぴったり合う……
There are some papers here about the prison's history..
ここに監獄の歴史についての書類がいくつかある……
The papers say that the prison was constructed in {~} AP, and was reserved for Gavel's worst criminals...
書類には、この監獄は {~} AP に建てられ、Gavel で最も凶悪な犯罪者のために用意されたと書かれている……
It's also the largest prison in all of Gavel, and receives an enormous amount of funding in order to maintain captivity of their inmates...
Gavel 全土で最大の監獄でもあり、囚人を閉じ込めておくために莫大な資金を受け取っているという……
ここに書類がいくつかある……
It's just instructions on how to operate electromagic appliances.
電磁魔法の器具の操作手順が書いてあるだけだ。
There are a few rusted axe heads in here. The sharp edges are stained with dried blood...
ここには錆びた斧の頭がいくつかある。刃の部分は乾いた血で汚れている……
The screen appears to show a map of the entire prison! It looks like after you head through the exit door, you'll have to sneak through a large portion of the prison to escape.
画面には監獄全体の地図が映っているようだ！出口の扉を抜けたあとも、脱出するには監獄のかなりの範囲をこっそり通り抜けなければならないらしい。
Near the back of the prison, there's a room that holds almost all of the records in the prison... You might be able to destroy your criminal record if you reach it!
監獄の奥のほうに、ここの記録のほぼすべてを収めた部屋がある……そこまでたどり着ければ、自分の犯罪記録を消せるかもしれない！
There's a lever on this control panel that is labeled with the words "UNLOCK EXIT DOOR".
この制御盤には「出口の扉を解錠」と記されたレバーがある。
You can hear the sound of a door opening in the distance... the exit door must have just opened!
遠くで扉が開く音が聞こえる……出口の扉がたった今開いたに違いない！
This screen appears to show some information about guard patrols and placements in the second half of the prison...
この画面には、監獄の後半における看守の巡回と配置についての情報が映っているようだ……
...The entire area is going to be crawling with guards. You're going to have to sneak through them all in order to escape the prison for good.
……この一帯は看守でいっぱいになる。監獄から完全に脱出するには、その全員のあいだをこっそり通り抜けなければならない。
There's some extremely dark looking metal inside of this closet. You can't tell what it's used for...
この戸棚の中に、きわめて黒く見える金属がいくつか入っている。何に使うものかは見当がつかない……
This cabinet has a number of letters between Gavel's government and the Prison.
この書類棚には、Gavel 政府とこの監獄とのあいだの書簡がいくつも入っている。
The government must not care about the lives of anyone who lives in Gavel's northern forests enough to condemn the prison for all of this slaughter.
政府は、Gavel 北部の森に住む者の命を、この虐殺のために監獄を咎めるほどには気にかけていないのだろう。
These cabinets have some criminal records on a lot of the prisoners here...
この書類棚には、ここの囚人の多くについての犯罪記録が入っている……
Most of these files are virtually empty, save for a select few that had committed petty thefts some time ago.
これらの書類はほとんどが実質的に空で、少し前に軽い盗みを働いたごく一部を除いては何も書かれていない。
This box has a few criminal records in here. The first one has your name on it... At least you didn't need to search very long to find it.
この箱には犯罪記録がいくつか入っている。一枚目にはあなたの名前が書かれている……探すのにそう長くかからなかったのは幸いだ。
There should be something nearby you can use to destroy it.
これを壊すのに使えるものが、近くにあるはずだ。
You toss your criminal records into the fire. Good riddance.
自分の犯罪記録を火に投げ込む。これでやっと厄介払いだ。
Your record has been destroyed, for now. You can finally leave the prison for good.
記録はとりあえず破棄された。これでようやく、この監獄から永久に出て行ける。
This cabinet has a few records on the Warden...but they all seem incomplete.
この書類棚には所長についての記録が数枚ある……だがどれも不完全なようだ。
Hardly any of the information is actually filled out, No age, career history, family, or any other information. She appears to be a complete un-person.
ほとんどの項目が実際には埋められていない。年齢も、経歴も、家族も、その他の情報も何もない。まるで完全に存在しない人間のようだ。
It's as if she just popped into existence for the sole purpose of being this prison's warden.
まるで、この監獄の所長になるためだけに、ふいに存在し始めたかのようだ。
There you are! Good to see you managed to escape that horrid place!
いたいた！あのひどい場所から逃げ出せたようで何よりだ！
But seriously, thank you, {u}. I thought I was going to get killed in there! This isn't much, but hopefully it can help you get back on your feet after all of that.
だが本当に、ありがとう、{u}。中で殺されると思っていた！これはたいしたものではないが、あれだけのことがあった後、立ち直る助けになればいい。
Anyways, I have to go now. But if I can ever help you with anything at all, just let me know! I'm forever in your debt, human.
とにかく、私はもう行かなければ。だが何か力になれることがあれば、いつでも言ってくれ！この恩は忘れない、人間。
An'! The best part! The idiot came back with a crumpled wrist and this HORRIFIED look- Musta gotten on the Hive witch's bad side!
それに！ここからが傑作だ！あのバカ、手首をぐしゃぐしゃにして真っ青な顔で戻ってきやがった――巣の魔女を怒らせたに違いねえ！
Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
あ、やあ、人間さん！下のこのバザーにはもう気づいたよね。ドワーフの誇りなんだ――ドワーフの街で一番大きな市場さ！
Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
よそでは手に入らない特別な品ばかり――奇妙で素敵で唯一無二の物がいろいろ。僕もここでちょっとした物を探してるんだ。
It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
上のピカピカのお金を扱う商人と違って、ここはほとんど物々交換。それが…僕にはちょっと不運でね。
You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after right now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
実は僕、本業は歴史学者なんだけど、今本当に欲しいのは Troll Hair なんだ。あの匂いがたまらな――えっと。本を綴じるのに丈夫でいいんだよ――ちょっと待って！
YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
君、持ってるの？すごい！僕には手に入らなくてさ――戦うのは苦手で。えっと、はい！それと…これを交換しよう！
A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
飾り王冠のセット！なかなか手に入らないけど、どうせ二セットあるから。見てみて！勉強になるよ。ところで、本当にありがとう！
...this is more useless to you than that troll hair. But, Nakoba did say the merchants barter. Maybe you can get something more useful for these.
…これはあの Troll Hair よりも役に立たない。だが Nakoba は商人たちが物々交換すると言っていた。これでもっと役立つ物と交換できるかも。
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
{p} で [Decorative Bottlecap Collection] を買いたい人を探す。Dobile は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる
Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
鉱石売ってるよ！鉱石売ってるよ！希少金属はいかが！Kanderstone、Wynnic Copper、本物の {p} Sandstone、{p} 産の本物の虚無石もあるぞ！
Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
そこの人間！鍛冶に興味があるなら、ここで正解だ！…ドワーフの酒が好きならな。これと引き換えに王冠のセットを探してるんだ。
What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
何だその顔は？新入りか何かか？王冠コレクターを見たことないのか？それとも元からその顔か？
Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
な――それ！それは！俺！どうやって！こ…完璧な保存状態だ！王冠が一つも欠けてない！栓抜きの凹みすらない！！！
There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
自分で集めたはずがない！手にしてる物の価値が分かるわけない！！俺には！それが！必要だ！
Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
ほら！一番珍しい金属だ！持ってけ！持ってって、その王冠をよこせ！コレクションを完成させなきゃ！！よこせ！よこせ！よこせよこせよこせ、今すぐ！
...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
…ええと。ゴホン。つい熱くなった。でも…その王冠は第一回 Dogun Festival の物なんだ。作られた当時は、まだ Courag で開かれてすらいなかった！
I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jaspilite I gave you!
もっと語りたいが、一つの商売に時間をかけすぎると他の客が帰っちまう。でも、渡した Jasplite はいい取引だったぞ！
Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what he's selling instead.
そういや、あれを欲しがってた奴がいたが、普通の炭酸の王冠一つ持ってなかった！すぐ近くにいると思う。お前の売り物に興味を持つかもな。
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
{p} で [Molten Jasplite Ingots] を買いたい人を探す。Dorroc は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる
Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
ふむ…人間の商人か？噂は聞いているが、ありきたりの品でないことを願うよ。
Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables and all. You all seem to have metals in bulk...
ああ、このバザーで君のような者は大勢見た――共用の炉や鍛冶台を使ってな。金属を大量に持っているようだが…
...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
…だが人間が使う金属インゴットは、百のうち九十八はゴミ同然だ！練習にしか使えん！私が求めるのは最上の金属だけなのだよ。
...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPILITE?! Oh, you must've gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
…なのに、よりによって MOLTEN JASPLITE を出して私の鼻を明かすとは？！ああ、Dobile から手に入れたのだな。君が王冠コレクターとは！
I've been pestering him for awhile about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is incredibly valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
彼の在庫をずっとせがんでいたのだ。Unseen Blade の金属は非常に貴重なのだよ。脆いのは確かだが…
...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
…それを振るえば、Ockar the Unseen Blade 本人の力を引き出せる！短剣一本で百の悪魔を震え上がらせた戦時の監督官だ！
Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
敵陣の背後に忍び込み、焼けつく熱に立ち向かう！影に徹し、硬い岩盤もマグマもひるまず斬り裂く！！
...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
…えー、ゴホン。とにかく！その対価に、最も希少な在庫を渡そう。Golemlus Power Core だ。これを持っているのが Qira に知れたら、死ぬよりひどい目に遭う。
She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
彼女はあの生物の秘密を厳重に隠している――これがその謎を解く鍵に違いない。大切にしたまえ、人間！ただの Corkus 製の電池ではないぞ。
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
{p} で [Golemlus Power Cell] を買いたい人を探す。Lodog は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる
Aight chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
よう大将、何にするかい？ここにはいろんな機械があるぜ。どれか一つは目に留まるはずさ、な？
I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
おいらのお手製ジューサーだ！レモンを入れて、へへ、パワーを搾れば一瞬でレモンジュース！
Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business! Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
それともこのコイン発射機はどうだい？ハンドルを回せば、コインくらいの物なら何でも猛烈に撃ち出すぜ。ただ、窓には向けんなよ。その窓がよっぽど嫌いなら別だがな。
...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round, I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
…何だって？ああ、なるほど。逆に、おいらが興味を持ちそうな物を持ってるってわけか。分かった。ちょいと見せてみな。
...okay, I can't make heads or tails 'a this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-Legendary island!
…いや、こいつはさっぱり分からねえ。何だって言ったっけ？まさか、あの大して伝説でもねえ島の Corkus 製ガジェットじゃねえだろうな！
...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!
…よし。こいつはさっぱり分からん。何だって言ったっけ？まさか、あの大したことねえ {p} の Corkus 製ガジェットじゃねえだろうな！
...a... A Golemlus Power Core...? This...hot DOG! Yahaaah, I'd heard about those wacko golem thingies ages ago, I always wanted to take 'em apart! Aw hell but this is an opportunity!
…ゴ…Golemlus Power Core…？こいつは…たまげた！ヤッホー、そういうイカれたゴーレムの話は昔から聞いてて、ずっとバラしてみたかったんだ！こりゃチャンスだぜ！
Gotta say, for something that came from that Hive it's a lot less purple and black and spidery-all-over than I expected. The complexity...this has gotta be the real deal, but...
言っとくが、あの巣から来た物にしちゃ、思ったより紫でも黒でもねえし、クモっぽくもねえ。この複雑さ…こいつは本物に違いねえが…
Feels like someone else made this. That Qira lady doesn't seem like the handsy type, and this is somethin' like {~} mechanics, {~} magic. Just seems out of character.
別の誰かが作った気がする。あの Qira って女は自分で手を動かすタイプじゃなさそうだし、これは機械が {~}、魔法が {~} って感じだ。どうも彼女らしくねえ。
Ah, but I'm gettin' away from myself. Tell ya what- prob'ly went through a lotta trouble ta get this, and that means you got guts. You got bravery. You got STONES, human!
おっと、話がそれた。こうしよう――これを手に入れるのにさぞ苦労したろう。つまり、お前には根性がある。勇気がある。肝っ玉があるぜ、人間！
So, how 'bout these Ice Drake Scales then? It fits a brave soul like you, it does! Take 'em with pride, there!
じゃあ、この Ice Drake Scales はどうだい？お前みたいな勇敢な奴にぴったりさ！誇りを持って持ってきな！
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the Ice Drake Scales. Mastro is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
{p} で Ice Drake Scales を買いたい人を探す。Mastro は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる
Ardent Magma Crystals for sale! Pure, {~}! Accept no substitutes, unless you're paying in emeralds, in which case kindly substitute...a lot of them!!
Ardent Magma Crystal 売ってるぞ！純度 {~}！代用品はお断り、エメラルド払いなら話は別、その時はぜひ代わりに…たっぷり頼む！！
Human! You have a keen eye for prices and values! I can tell by that glint in your eye- a real MAN's spirit! Even if you aren't a man, your spirit shines all the same as a man...!
人間！お前には値段と価値を見抜く鋭い目がある！その目の輝きで分かる――真の漢の魂だ！漢でなくとも、その魂は漢と同じく輝いている…！
A SALES MAN! YES! Macho and brave! Chiseled and strong! Strong enough to carry {~} Liquid Emeralds to trade for this brilliant Ardent Magma Crystal!
セールス漢！そうだ！マッチョで勇敢！彫りが深くて力強い！この輝く Ardent Magma Crystal と交換する液体エメラルド {~} 個を運べるほど強い！
...but hold on a moment. Hold on just one moment. Do I detect...a vein of ICE in that manly aura? A chill, pushing against that spirit of market machismo?
…だが待て。ちょっと待て。その漢のオーラに…氷の筋を感じるぞ？市場のマッチョ魂に逆らう冷気を？
YES, I DO! Human, you have Ice Drake Scales! I needn't see them to be sure! I was right about you from the start- Such burning passion!!
感じる！人間、お前は Ice Drake Scales を持っている！見なくても分かる！最初から見込み通りだ――なんと燃える情熱！！
AND SUCH NAIVETE! Let me strengthen your MIND! Ice Drake Scales are indicative of a great challenge having been overcome! A truly macho trophy of accomplishment!
そして、なんと純真！その心を鍛えてやろう！Ice Drake Scales は偉大な試練を乗り越えた証！真にマッチョな功績のトロフィーだ！

To tame Ice Drakes required UNBREAKABLE will! To overcome the sheerest cold with MACHO HEAT! And to outshine demons of lava and flame with that same determination! Those scales represent such resilience!
Ice Drake を手懐けるには不屈の意志が要る！極寒をマッチョな熱で乗り越える！その決意で溶岩と炎の悪魔にも勝る輝きを放つ！その鱗はそんな不屈の証だ！
And yet...I must wonder. Such a fiery spirit you have- THOSE SCALES HOLD YOU BACK! Your spirit cannot be contained in such a manner!
だが…思うのだ。お前はそれほど燃える魂を持っている――その鱗はお前を縛っている！お前の魂はそんな形で閉じ込められはしない！
DISRESPECT YOURSELF NO LONGER! I DEMAND YOU HAND OVER THOSE SCALES! But you will not leave empty-handed, no no, friend!
もう自分を軽んじるな！その鱗を渡してもらおう！だが手ぶらでは帰さん、いやいや、友よ！
You have ignited my passion as a salesman, so I shall present you one of my own greatest accomplishments! For a spirit so WHITE HOT, only an ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL is fitting!
お前はセールス漢としての俺の情熱に火をつけた、だから俺の最高傑作の一つを贈ろう！白熱する魂には、ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL こそふさわしい！
YES! Your soul shines brighter than the shimmer of EIGHT-HUNDRED-MILLION EMERALDS! Forever may your spirit BURN, human!
そうだ！お前の魂は八億個のエメラルドの輝きより眩しい！永遠に魂を燃やせ、人間！
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy an [Ardent Magma Crystal]. Dohstaj is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
{p} で [Ardent Magma Crystal] を買いたい人を探す。Dohstaj は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる
…Mastro の叫びが聞こえた。彼…とても情熱的。
...he's married to his work. Would I were his.
…彼は仕事と結婚してる。私がその仕事ならいいのに。
...but business first. Wartime artifacts for sale.
…でも商売が先。戦時の遺物、売ってるよ。
...priciest thing is a Dogun Flameshooter. Practically invaluable. You want it?
…一番高いのは Dogun Flameshooter。値がつけられないほど。欲しい？
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the [Dogun Flameshooter]. Syni is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
{p} で [Dogun Flameshooter] を買いたい人を探す。Syni は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる
I can't stand this. I can't stand this! SHUT UP, MASTRO! NO ONE CARES ABOUT YOUR SWEATY SPIRIT OR WHATEVER!
もう無理。もう無理！黙って、MASTRO！あんたの汗くさい魂だか何だか、誰も気にしてないから！
MY MACHISMO CANNOT BE CONTAINED! Your aversion only inspires my salesman's spirit! Ardent Magma Crystals! Pure, {~} gold! {~} Liquid Emeralds, {~} off! STRONG bargains!
俺のマッチョは抑えられん！その嫌悪こそセールス漢の魂を奮い立たせる！Ardent Magma Crystal！純度 {~} の金！液体エメラルド {~} 個、{~} 引き！力強いお買い得！
AAAGH! Stupid, stupid, stupid Dohstaj! I just need him to fork over that stupid Flameshooter and then I can get away from this tripe but he just! Won't! DO IT!
