According to the notes you saw, it's probably the "human" cannon. This must be your escape route!
さっきのメモによれば、これが例の「人間」大砲だろう。これが脱出路に違いない！
There are mentions of a hidden key in the hold...
船倉に隠された鍵のことが書いてある…
You should probably search the hold later, when possible.
後で機会があれば、船倉を探してみたほうがよさそうだ。
You cleaned the bodies! You should talk to Honip on the deck.
死体を片付けた！甲板の Honip と話そう。
'ey! How's the cleaning? Don't forget to check everywhere, ya never know what you might find!
おう！掃除はどうだ？隅々まで調べろよ、何が見つかるか分かんねえからな！
You're done? Well good job! Honip's next to the helm if you're lookin' for him.
終わったのか？よくやった！Honip なら舵のそばにいるぜ。
You've been running around the boat for a while now!
ずいぶん長いこと船の中を駆け回ってるな！
Honip's probably waitin' for ya by now! Take these ladders next to me, he's up there.
Honip がもう待ってるだろうよ！俺の横のはしごを上りな、あいつは上だ。
If you lose your sponge, Honip can give you a new one on the deck.
スポンジをなくしたら、甲板の Honip に新しいのをもらえる。
The only boat that will take ye directly to {p}.
{p} まで直行する唯一の船だぜ。
Hey! You aren't allowed on my ship!
おい！俺の船に乗るんじゃねえ！
This hologram will teleport you back on the island to continue the quest or Reset your quest.
このホログラムで島へ戻ってクエストを続けるか、クエストをリセットできる。
Are you sure you wish to Reset your quest?
本当にクエストをリセットしますか？
Misadventure On The Sea has been reset!
「海の災難」がリセットされました！
Maybe you could somehow use it..? There's no way to tell how dangerous it is. Probably very.
それを何とか使えるかもしれない…？どれほど危険かは分からない。たぶん、かなり危険だ。
It must be the one up you saw up there! That's got to be the way to escape!
きっと上で見たあれだ！あれが脱出路に違いない！
Who knows, maybe there's gunpowder in there?
ひょっとしたら、中に火薬があるかもな？
Seems like it likes you now!
すっかりなついたみたいだな！
Not done yet? Well, take your time!
まだか？まあ、ゆっくりやれ！
We sometimes hear unusually loud footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
時々やけにでかい足音が聞こえるし、すげえ不気味なキーキー声もする…
Looks like this crate is filled with rat hair, with some eaten carrots.
この木箱はネズミの毛と、かじられたニンジンでいっぱいのようだ。
You defeated the rats! You should grab the gunpowder and the fuse before leaving.
ネズミを倒した！出る前に火薬と導火線を持っていこう。
Looks like this crate is filled with even more rat hair!
この木箱には、さらに多くのネズミの毛が詰まっている！
You picked up a dusty key!
ほこりまみれの鍵を拾った！
導火線はもう手に入れた。
You got the fuse as well as the gunpowder. Looks like you can use that cannon now!
導火線も火薬も手に入れた。これであの大砲が使えそうだ！
You put the gunpowder in the cannon and attach the fuse...
大砲に火薬を詰め、導火線を取り付けた…
Looks like it's fully functional. Make sure the pirates don't see you! Once you leave, you won't be able to come back.
完全に使えるようだ。海賊に見つからないように！一度出たら、もう戻れない。
大砲の中に這い込んだ…
Huh? Something's approaching off in the distance...
ん？遠くから何かが近づいてくる…
Looks like they're headed toward the island! Is that..?
こっちの島へ向かってくるようだ！あれは…？
Ah... Trust. Say, why don't I make it so you can travel to {p} for free? That way, if ya ever think o' doin' somethin' foolish like that again, ya can jus' take a trip on my ol' ship!
ああ…信頼か。そうだ、これからは {p} までタダで乗せてやるってのはどうだ？そうすりゃ、またあんな馬鹿なことをしたくなっても、俺のおんぼろ船でひとっ走りすりゃいい！
[{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある {p} の酒場を訪ねる
Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
よう兵隊さん！何にする？
So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
で…町でお前を見かけたぜ。日誌を届けてやった時、あの男がえらく喜んでたな。
{p} ウイスキー {~} 杯、お待ち！
So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
で…兵隊さんよ。俺と海に出る気はねえか？あの Seaskipper より上等な船があるんだ！
I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
海の探検に興味があると思ってな！
[{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Honip と合流する
There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
来たな！準備はいいか？ついて来い、船はこっちだ！
Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
見ろよ…見事だろ！Seaskipper のボロ船よりずっといい！
Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
で、何を待ってる？乗りな！
Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
じゃあ決まりだ、冒険に出発だぜ！
Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
しっかりつかまれ、波に乗るぞ。
So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
あー…言っとくが、実は船を操るのは初めてでな…
It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
でも大して難しくなさそうだ、ちょいと左に…
Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
ふむ、今日海に出てるのは俺たちだけじゃないらしい。
不運なのは…「お前」だがな！
よう、やっと目が覚めたか。
I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
正直、あんなのに引っかかるなんて信じられねえ。まとめてやるよ…
Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
めちゃくちゃ怪しい海賊が近づいてきて、酒をおごり、怪しい船に案内する。
Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
普通の奴ならその時点で引き返す。なのにお前は？飛び乗った！ってわけで、もう俺たちから逃げられねえ。
Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
手短に言う。この船は修繕が必要で、お前にやってもらう。
Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
なぜかって？お前は兵隊だろ！命令に従うのが仕事だ！とにかく、俺たちの物を掃除してもらう。ほら、出ろ。
I told you to stay back!
下がれって言っただろ！
If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
用があれば甲板にいる。それと、あー、船倉には入るな。ネズミがひどくてな。
Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
あと、手下のためにも、もう少し協力的になってくれねえか？この薬も無限にあるわけじゃねえんだ。
Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}
船内の死体を掃除する。同時に脱出の手がかりを探す。-掃除した死体: #/{~}
Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
よう、お前が俺たちの専属護衛か？
That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
そのはしごは船倉に通じてるが、今は鍵がかかってる…ネズミがひどくてな。
Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Pep はまさにお宝だよな？お前も世話してくれて嬉しいぜ！
Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Honip はニワトリを飼ってる、変だろ？
I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
きっと自分の島にいた変な奴から思いついたんだろうな…
What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
何？あいつの一番大事なニワトリを殺した？変わった奴だな、兵隊さん。
Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
あー、えっと…それは気にすんな、な？
あれは俺たちの…燃料源だ。
Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
おお、それは俺の大砲だ！かっこいいだろ？たくさんの腕を使って作―いや、何でもない…
おっ、Snoo が気に入ったみたいだ！
He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
こいつは強いニワトリだぜ、そこは信じてくれ。
I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
俺はただ…ここで待ってるよ…大砲と一緒に…
Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
甲板の Honip と話し、次の仕事をもらう
Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
おい！船がずいぶん綺麗になったな！
I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
そろそろ休ませてやるか―待て。
Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
ホ、Honip！仲間の一人が、何かすげえ変なもんがまっすぐこっちに来るのを見たって！
We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
わ、分からねえ！よく見えねえが、とんでもなくデカいらしい！
Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
あー…具体的にどこを見りゃいいんだ？
I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
誓って言う、さっきは海全体が狂ったみたいだったんだ！
If this is another one of your jokes...
これがまたお前らの冗談なら…
I don't know, this wasn't planned!
知らねえ、こんなの予定にねえぞ！
Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
兵隊、お前の見せ場だ！呪文か何かで追っ払え！
効いてるぞ！もう一回だ！
I knew you had it in ya, haha!
やれると思ってたぜ、ははっ！
What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
大したもんだ！来い、話がある！
I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
あの化け物がどこから来たかは知らねえが、お前のおかげで消えた。
I've got somethin' else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
もう一つ片付けてほしいことがある。例の…ネズミだ。
Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
船倉に来い、道すがら説明する。
I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
どうもこいつは地獄みてえな問題らしい。
I'm not sure what ya'll find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
そこで何が見つかるか知らねえが、あいつらは普通のネズミ「じゃねえ」。
So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
だから頼む、中に入って…全部ぶっ殺してくれ、いいな？
I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Just cast one of your fancy spells!
ご自慢の呪文を使えよ！
That was... Phew... That was something.
今のは…ふう…大したもんだった。
Now, for an even bigger surprise...
さて、もっと大きなお楽しみだ…
What the hell, soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
何やってんだ兵隊？？仕事の「兵隊」って部分の何が分からねえんだ？
Come, let's figure some things out.
来い、いくつか話をつけよう。
You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
お前にはがっかりさせられっぱなしだ、分かるか？
But you can still redeem yourself.
だが、まだ挽回はできる。
Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
ついて来い、道すがら説明する。
I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
さっきネズミの話をしたろ…あー、ちっとやそっとの話じゃねえ。
We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
取り戻す火薬があるんでな、船倉を片付けるのはお前だ。
So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
だから中に入って…全部殺すつもりでやれ、いいな？
Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
さっきみたいなヘマはすんなよ。お前は兵隊だろ。
I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
兵隊、何かするのはお前だと思ってたんだ、そいつじゃねえ！
とにかく、話がある、来い。
I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
もう一つ頼みがある。例の…ネズミだ。
See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
いいか、どうもよくある類の問題じゃねえ気がするんだ。
That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
だから入りたくねえんだが…火薬はあそこなんだ！海賊にゃ必要なんだよ！
So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
だから、中に入って…全部ぶっ殺してくれ、いいな？
Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
いざ勝負。Snoo、お前はそこにいろ！
Explore the hold and kill the rats
船倉を探索してネズミを倒す
Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold
船倉の Colossal Rat を倒す
Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape
火薬と導火線で大砲を動かし、脱出する
Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
あの忌々しい盗人ネズミどもを片付けた？…Colossal Rat だと？
Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
よくやった、頼りになると思ってたぜ！こっち来い、これを持ってけ！
Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
とにかく、今は休むなり好きにするなりしていいぞ！
Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself, soldier!
こいつはたまげた！ちゃんと挽回したな、兵隊！
よう兵隊。船旅を楽しんでるか？
Huh? It looks like there's a hidden lock in this bookshelf!
あれ？この本棚に隠し錠があるみたいだ！
Where could the key be? Does the crew know about this?
鍵はどこだろう？船員たちは知ってるのか？
It's barely visible, it's probably not going to help on escaping.
ほとんど見えない。脱出の役には立たなさそうだ。
That's definitely not a place to store gunpowder, nor a fuse.
火薬をしまう場所じゃないのは確かだ。導火線もな。
Huh? What did you do?? Oh well, whatever...
え？何をした？？まあいいか…
いろいろな物が詰まっている。
Mo'in, traveller, have you heard of Corkus? The new province filled with machines!
Mo'in、旅の人。Corkus を知ってるかい？機械だらけの新しい地方さ！
If you were level {~} I'd let you enter Corkus for free. Come back to me then!
レベル {~} ならタダで Corkus に入れてやるよ。そうなったらまた来な！
That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
そりゃ恐ろしい話だ！しかも一人でやったのか！よし、ほら、これを持ってけ。
Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
いや、でも船倉ではいい仕事してたぜ！火薬がいくらか消えたけどな。
Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
現在地を確かめ、島から逃げる方法を探す
'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
よう兵隊さん！困ってるみてえだな！乗ってくかい？
Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
さて…行き先は海の中心、{p} だ！さっきまでいた所よりは安全だぜ、へへ！
I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
景色のいい寄り道をしてたら、あの島にいるお前さんとピカピカの装備が見えたんでな。
So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
で、何があったか聞かせてくれ！
Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
ほう、海賊にさらわれたか！そりゃ災難だ…
I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
頼れる Seaskipper を避けようとするからだぜ！この辺で信用できるのは俺だけさ。
Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
ま、ひどい目に遭ってなきゃいいが！ほら、お詫びに {p} までタダで乗せてやる。
Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
とにかく、遠くに岸が見えてきた！つかまってな、もうすぐだ！
Speak to Javen at the Corkus Docks.
Corkus の波止場で Javen と話す。
Mo’in lad! We don’t get many Wynn folks round ‘ere.
おはよう坊主！ここらじゃ Wynn の連中は珍しいんだ。
Welcome to old Javen’s tavern, what can I do yer for?
Javen じいさんの酒場へようこそ、何にするかね？
Let’s see... I can give ya some of the islands “Old Cork” Brew..
どれどれ…島の「オールドコルク」酒でも出してやろうか…
Seems like you are in luck today, adventurer.
今日は運がいいようだな、冒険者。
My day's been long, and you also look like you could do with a drink or two.
長い一日だった。君も一杯二杯やりたそうな顔をしている。
There's no need to pay by yourself. Javen, we'll have two cups of the seasonal brew.
自分で払う必要はない。Javen、季節の酒を二杯頼む。
Everything alright, lad? Looking a bit pale...
大丈夫か、坊主？ちと顔色が悪いぞ…
Oh by the mighty founders, everything is ruined!
偉大なる創設者様にかけて、何もかもめちゃくちゃだ！
You did this! Yer mad in the head! Possessed or summet!
お前がやったんだ！頭がイカれてる！取り憑かれたか何かだ！
Yer seem fine now though. What got inter ye lad? You went berserk like!
だが今は平気そうだな。何に取り憑かれた、坊主？まるで暴れ牛だったぞ！
It weren’t just here neither. You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise
ここだけじゃねえ。飛び出してって何から何までぶっ壊した！迷惑かけた連中を探して謝ってこい
Talk to the citizens around the docks.
波止場周辺の住民と話す。
The whole aqueduct is ruined! The city's fresh water is just draining into the ocean...
水道橋がめちゃくちゃだ！街のきれいな水がそのまま海に流れ出てる…
Ah! It's you! Back to wreck the rest of the city's infrastructure?! You're meant to be a tourist!
あっ！お前か！街の残りの設備も壊しに戻ってきたのか？！観光客のくせに！
Wait... Weren't your eyes red before? Were you ill? It was a bit scary.
待てよ…さっき目が赤くなかったか？病気か？ちょっと怖かったぞ。
Oh.. You don't even remember? Well.. If you want to help, I need it right now.
え…覚えてもいないのか？まあ…手伝う気があるなら、今すぐ頼みたい。
The system needs to be rebooted, which can only be done down in the sewers.
システムを再起動しないといけないんだが、それは下水道でしかできない。
Kind of a design flaw if you ask me.. But if you go down that trap door, you will find it in the sewers!
設計ミスだと思うがな…とにかく、あの落とし戸から下りれば下水道で見つかるはずだ！
You fixed it? Everything you broke? That's one hell of a twisted personality.
直した？壊した物全部を？とんでもなくねじれた性格だな。
Corkus has been urging tourists and envoys from the other provinces to gain recognition.
Corkus は認められようと、ほかの州の観光客や使節を呼び込んできた。
There are others that blame any outsiders for the problems of the islands.. They say they are patriots.. but honestly...
でも島の問題を全部よそ者のせいにする連中もいる…自分たちは愛国者だと言うが…正直…
They are just awful people. They want to do anything to make non Corkians look bad.
ただのひどい連中だ。Corkus 人以外を悪く見せるためなら何でもする。
If I were you, I'd better start asking around to find out more about that!
俺があんたなら、そのことを聞いて回って調べるね！
Speak to the other citizens around the docks.
波止場周辺のほかの住民と話す。
It’s THEM! Someone call the authorities! It’s the one who set my house on fire.
「あいつ」だ！誰か役人を呼んで！うちに火をつけた奴よ。
How could you do this and just come back all calm like? You were screaming your head off!
こんなことしておいて、よく平然と戻ってこられるわね？大声でわめき散らしてたくせに！
My house is still burning! Wait… You say you don’t have any memory of any of this?
うちはまだ燃えてるの！待って…何も覚えてないって言うの？
Look, if you’re serious, you have a chance to help make it better.
いい、本気なら、償うチャンスはあるわ。
There are valuables in a chest in there you must save before the whole place burns to the ground, get going!
中の箱に貴重品があるの、家が燃え尽きる前に助け出して、早く！
You did it! So you weren't lying? Ugh, I guess you might just be trustworthy.
やったのね！嘘じゃなかったの？はあ、信用してもいいのかもね。
You know about the 'patriots' of Corkus?
Corkus の「愛国者」を知ってる？
Well this kind of maneuver is right up their alley.. It certainly made you look bad!
こういう手口はまさに連中の得意技よ…おかげであなたは悪者扱いだもの！
Now that you bring it up, I did hear a group of Corkians quietly discussing something about framing tourists.
そういえば、Corkus 人の一団が観光客をはめる相談をひそひそしてるのを聞いたわ。
I have no idea how they would make you do something against your will though...
でも、どうやってあなたの意志に反することをさせたのかは分からないわね…
Talk to the final victim of your rampage.
暴走の最後の被害者と話す。
Came back to wreck the rest of my work have you? Why aren't you all insane looking?
俺の仕事の残りも壊しに戻ってきたか？なんで狂った顔してないんだ？
So now your story is you were not in control? It's easy to believe. You were mad!
で、今度は自分じゃ制御できなかったって言い分か？そりゃ信じやすい。お前はイカれてた！
I don't know if you have some kind of condition.. but if you want to help, I need it to clean up the mess you made.
何かの持病か知らんが…手伝う気があるなら、お前が散らかしたのを片付けてくれ。
I need to replace all the cargo you destroyed.
お前が壊した積み荷を全部補充しなきゃならん。
All you gotta do is get those crates here and put them back on the boats. The limit is {~} for each boat, not more not less!
木箱をここに運んで船に戻すだけだ。一隻につき {~} 個、多くても少なくてもだめだ！
Some weights might not be needed, but be careful, I don't wanna go diving after you.
重りは要らないのもあるかもしれんが、気をつけろ、お前を追って潜るのはごめんだ。
You did it? ... -I mean, at last. Eh... I guess I was too fast with my judgement for once.
やったのか？…いや、ようやくか。まあ…今回ばかりは早まって決めつけたようだ。
Hmm… As it happens I have seen some strange things around here.
ふむ…実はこの辺で妙なものを見かけてな。
During the night I saw something moving across the cliffs.. Looked like a personal balloon.
夜中、崖の向こう側で何かが動くのを見かけた……。まるで人の形をした風船のようだった。
It wouldn't have been out of the ordinary except there are occasional blood trails leading from the balloon...
それだけなら珍しくもないが、気球から時々血の跡が続いてるんだ…
If you really want to approach these people… I guess all you would need to do is follow the trail of blood.
本気でそいつらに近づきたいなら…血の跡をたどればいいだろうな。
Can't say I recommend it but the trail starts near the aqueduct.
おすすめはしないが、跡は水道橋の近くから始まってる。
Follow the trail of blood and board the airship.
血の跡をたどり、飛行船に乗り込む。
崖のふもとを探索する。
Why are you here? I don't mean here and now, I mean why are you on our island?
なぜここにいる？今この場の話ではない、なぜ我々の島にいるのかと聞いている。
You have of course found yourself in front of me because you were a pawn in our attempts to save this nation.
お前が私の前にいるのは当然だ。この国を救う我々の企ての駒だったのだからな。
I suppose I should apologize, but truth is you are the reason for this movement. Not you personally... but your people.
謝るべきなのだろうが、この運動の原因はお前だ。お前個人ではない…お前の同胞だ。
You... Look at yourself. You fight in a war you did not cause. You come from a land you don't even remember.
お前は…自分を見ろ。自分が起こしてもいない戦争を戦い、覚えてもいない土地から来た。
We ask ourselves why would we invite people from two lands of sin. Invite a nation of warring travellers and a nation of greedy merchants to our doors?
我々は自問する。なぜ二つの罪の地の者を招くのか？戦に明け暮れる旅人の国と、強欲な商人の国を我が門に？
The Corkian people are above such mundane capitalism and brutality. We work as a nation to better all.
Corkus の民はそんな俗な資本主義や野蛮さを超えている。国を挙げて皆のために働くのだ。
You have been a pawn your entire existence on this world. The worst part is you don't even know it.
お前はこの世界に生まれてからずっと駒だった。最悪なのは、それに気づいてすらいないことだ。
Do you, for example - Know the name of your ultimate enemy? The reason for the war on your land?
たとえば―究極の敵の名を知っているか？お前たちの土地で起きた戦争の原因は？
No? Didn't think so. I have no time for this. You served your purpose, even if you did try and redeem your barbaric behaviour... Kill them!
知らない？だろうな。付き合っている暇はない。役目は終わった、野蛮な振る舞いを償おうとしたとしてもな…殺せ！
Fight and evade the waves of mobs until the timer runs out.
タイマーが切れるまで、敵の群れと戦い、かわし続ける。
Tougher than I expected. You don’t mind if I interfere a bit, do you?
思ったよりしぶといな。少し手出ししても構わないだろう？
You may have won this fight, but you are still the loser in this situation.
この戦いには勝ったかもしれんが、この状況ではお前が敗者だ。
Your eyes are still closed to the greater picture of it all. Corkus is the only place safe from it. I will make sure of it!
お前の目はまだ全体像に閉ざされている。Corkus だけがそれから逃れられる地だ。私が必ずそうする！
There are still greater things in motion as we speak. Plans that will secure this island's safety.
こうして話す間にも、より大きな事が動いている。この島の安全を守る計画がな。
Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn… It’s all a joke. We all sit on the cusp of this reality, fighting only the prelude to the real war.
Fruma…Gavel…Wynn…すべては冗談だ。我々はこの現実の縁に座り、真の戦争の序章を戦っているにすぎない。
This is our farewell. I must depart before the short sighted government arrive. Good Luck with your struggle.
これでお別れだ。近視眼的な政府が来る前に去らねばならん。せいぜいあがくことだ。
Now look who we got over ‘ere! We were all wondering if you'd ever wake up.
おや、誰かと思えば！目を覚ますのかと皆で心配してたんだ。
Sorry we ever doubted ye. Weren't fair of us. What you drank was a rare brew designed to enrage and berserk someone.
疑って悪かったな。不公平だった。お前が飲んだのは、人を怒り狂わせる珍しい酒だったんだ。
Basically, it weren't yer fault lad. We never knew some Corkians were so closed minded.
要するに、お前のせいじゃなかったってことだ、坊主。あんな狭量な Corkus 人がいるとは知らなかった。
Anyways! Look at what we got, thanks to you I acquired this little place!
ともかく！見てくれ、お前のおかげでこの小さな店を手に入れたんだ！
By means of reparations have this on me. Yer always welcome round here.
お詫びにこれはおごりだ。いつでも寄ってくれ。
Go for a drink at the Corkus Docks Inn, [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}]にあるCorkus Docks Innで一杯呑みに行く
Talk to Javen to find out more about what happened.
Javenと話して何が起きたか詳しく知る
You should ask Javen about what happened.
何が起こったかJavenに尋ねるべきだ。
Talk to citizens around the docks to find out more about what happened.
埠頭周辺の市民と話をして、何が起こったのかさらに詳しく調べる
You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise!
お前はさっさと逃げ出して、あちこちで大暴れしたな！迷惑をかけた人たちを探して、ちゃんと謝ってこい！
Hurry, please! Just head into the big trapdoor by the bushes, the controls are in there.
早くしてくれ！茂みのそばにある大きな落とし戸の中に入ってくれ。制御装置はその中にある。
> Thank you for choosingsing CorkTech! Your company for a safe and trustworthy service.
> CorkTechをお選びいただき誠にありがとうございます。安全で信頼できるサービスをご提供いたします。
エレベーターを起動中…
You can push the button beside the crates to pick them up, and stand on the pressure plate to place them.
木箱の横にあるボタンを押すと木箱を持ち上げて、感圧板の上に立つと木箱を置ける。
It seems like all crates are balanced now.
すべての木箱のバランスが取れたようだ。
I learned about some rumours involving separatists. I should continue helping locals to find out more.
分離主義者が関与しているという噂について知った。地元の人々をさらに支援して、もっと情報を集める必要がある
Someone told you more about the patriots of Corkus. You should continue to find the missing clue.
誰かがあなたにCorkusの愛国者たちについてさらに詳しく教えてくれたはず。失われた手がかりを探し続けるべきだ
You manage to reach the chest safely, getting ready to jump through a hole the fire burned.
なんとか無事にチェストまでたどり着き、炎によって焼け穴が開いた場所を飛び越えようとした。
Follow the trail of blood close to the castle, [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
城の近くにある血痕を辿る[-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
You really don't see a reason to go in there at the moment.
今のところ、そこに入る理由がまったく見当たらない。
Use the balloon to enter the suspicious hideout.
飛行船を使い不審な隠れ家に入る。
Survive the fight against the drugged corkian
薬物を投与されたcorkianとの戦いを生き延びる
After witnessing your crash into the cliff, Corkian citizens informed the government.
あなたが崖に激突するのを目撃したCorkus市民たちが、政府に通報しました。
Shortly after your victory security forces found the hideout and arrested the remaining separatists.
あなたの勝利から間もなく、治安部隊が潜伏先を発見し、残りの分離主義者たちを逮捕した。
Their leader was nowhere to be found.
彼らのリーダーはどこにも見当たらなかった。
Always nice to see my favourite customer pay a visit!
お気に入りのお客様が遊びに来てくれるのは、いつだって嬉しい！
It's some kind of snake symbol, but it's probably not useful to you now.
何かの蛇の紋章だが、今の君にはおそらく役に立たないだろう。
If you find any more leads remember to come to me - and if you find the murder weapon, make sure to bring it to us immediately!
新たな手がかりを見つけたら、必ず私のところへ来てくれ。それと凶器を見つけたら、すぐに我々に届けるんだ！
Have you made any progress? There was a smashed window in there, it might be a good place to start.
進展はあったか？あそこに割れた窓があった。そこから始めるのがよいかもしれない。
It looks like the victim's head was somehow detatched from his body...
被害者の頭は、どうやってか胴体から切り離されたようだ……
The victim's book collection seems to be exclusively made up of dimestore romance novels.
被害者の蔵書は、どうやら安物の恋愛小説ばかりのようだ。
This painting doesn't seem to have anything to do with the murder, but its a nice landscape of {p}.
この絵は殺人とは関係がなさそうだが、なかなかよい {p} の風景画だ。
This half-finished letter seems to be asking for a loan to pay off some kind of debt...
この書きかけの手紙は、何かの借金を返すために金を貸してほしいと頼んでいるようだ……
It looks like the attacker managed to break in through the window.
襲った者は窓から押し入ったようだ。
It's a letter addressed to someone called Rohem in House No. {~} in {p}.
{p} の {~} 番の家に住む Rohem という者に宛てた手紙だ。
If you can find it, it will show you the way to get into the sewers. I'm sorry, I would tell you more if I knew more. But good luck with your investigation.
それを見つければ、下水道への道が分かるはずだ。すまないが、知っているのはここまでだ。捜査の幸運を祈るよ。
Some of those gamblers had a symbol built into their homes, shaped like a snake. If you find it, it'll show you the way into the sewers. Good luck, officer.
あの博徒たちの一部は、家に蛇のかたちをした印を仕込んでいた。それを見つければ、下水道への道を示してくれる。幸運を祈る、警官殿。
The barkeeper takes the snake symbol and examines it for a moment before nodding and giving it back to you.
酒場の主人は蛇の印を受け取り、しばらく眺めてからうなずいて、あなたに返した。
The barkeeper gestures down to the open trapdoor.
酒場の主人は、開いた跳ね上げ戸のほうを身ぶりで示した。
But the day he brought Eminar 'round, though, it got ugly fast. Kept borrowing Rohem's emeralds and losing, til neither of em had anythin' left.
だが Eminar を連れてきた日は、すぐ荒れた。Rohem のエメラルドを借りては負け、二人とも何も残らなくなるまで続けた。
Now get out of 'ere; there's a back exit in the wall over there. Though, if ya ever fancy a game of 'jack, come back 'n we'll be happy to serve ya!
さあ出てけ。あっちの壁に裏口がある。ブラックジャックをやりたくなったら、また来な、喜んで相手するぜ！
What are ya lingerin' around 'ere for? I've told ya all I know. Now either take a seat or get out.
何をうろついてるんだ？知ってることは全部話した。さあ、席に着くか、出て行くかだ。
Ya can then hit and get another card as many times as ya want, or stand and end ya turn. The aim is to get the value of your hand as close to {~} as possible!
好きなだけヒットしてカードを引くか、スタンドで手番を終える。手札の合計をできるだけ {~} に近づけるのが目的だ！
It seems like you better go have a chat with Rohem...
どうやら Rohem と話をしたほうがよさそうだ……
You should look around for clues that tie Rohem to the murder.
Rohem を殺人に結びつける手がかりを探し回るべきだ。
Get out of my house, officer, and don't you dare go rooting around in my property!
私の家から出て行け、警官。それに、私の持ち物を勝手に探るなど絶対に許さんぞ！
It's a dirty shovel - it must've been used recently to dig something up.
泥だらけのシャベルだ――最近、何かを掘り起こすのに使われたに違いない。
There's a trail of muddy footprints leading back into the house.
泥の足跡が家の中へ続いている。
Whatever, you pale-faced walking cowlick. You're headed to {p} with a charge of first-class murder. Guards, take him away.
何とでも言え、青白い歩くアホ毛め。第一級殺人の罪で {p} 刑務所行きだ。衛兵、連れて行け。
Thank you for your help in catching the perpetrator!
犯人を捕まえるのに力を貸してくれて、ありがとう！
Looks like the symbol has something carved in on the back...
紋章の裏に何か刻まれているようだ…
[-{~}, -{~}] にいる Lorias 探偵と話す。
Stand back, human! This is a crime scene, under my authority. I cannot let you inside.
下がりたまえ、人間！ここは私の管轄の犯罪現場だ。中には入れられない。
Although we are in need of some... assistance... and you are fairly experienced, are you not?
とはいえ、我々には少々…助けが必要でね…君はそれなりに経験豊富だろう？
Well, straight to the point... do you think I might be able to hire you as a private investigator?
では単刀直入に…君を私立探偵として雇えないだろうか？
To put it bluntly, the owner of this house, Eminar, was murdered a few days ago, and what few leads we had have all gone cold.
率直に言うと、この家の主 Eminar が数日前に殺された。わずかな手がかりも、すべて途切れてしまった。
This is acting outside protocol, of course... but if you manage to catch the killer, I'm sure I could pull some strings and pay you for your work!
もちろん規則違反だが…犯人を捕まえてくれれば、手を回して報酬を払うと約束しよう！
I'll make sure no one stops you inside the crime scene. Head inside the house and see if you can find anything helpful.
現場で誰にも止められないようにしておく。家に入って、役立つ物がないか調べてくれ。
My soldiers and I will keep watch outside the house, and make sure you're not disturbed. Be careful in there!
私と部下は家の外で見張り、邪魔が入らないようにする。中では気をつけたまえ！
Investigate the crime scene at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for clues.
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の犯罪現場で手がかりを調べる。
Ah, a human! A refreshing sight these days. You've come to see me, I presume? What brings you here?
おや、人間か！近ごろは珍しい。私に会いに来たのかね？何の用だ？
An investigation!? Eminar? That's... that's absurd. I've done nothing wrong.
捜査だと！？Eminar？そんな…ばかげている。私は何も悪いことはしていない。
Still, the poor man. Eminar and I were good friends, you know. If it could help find his killer, I may have some information for you... strictly off-record, of course...
とはいえ、気の毒な男だ。Eminar と私は親友だったのだよ。犯人探しの助けになるなら、情報を渡せるかもしれん…もちろん、完全に内密でだ…
Well. You see, there's an underground gambling den hidden in the city's sewers. Only the elite can get in, and Eminar happened to be a frequent visitor.
実はな、街の下水道に地下賭博場が隠れている。入れるのは上流の者だけで、Eminar はそこの常連だった。
Once, he even brought me along with him.
一度は私も連れて行かれた。
Eminar, though, he often tried to cheat the other gamblers. I suppose it was only a matter of time before they had enough; most do not take cheating lightly.
だが Eminar は、よくほかの客をいかさまで騙そうとしていた。我慢の限界が来るのは時間の問題だった。いかさまを軽く見る者はいない。
Back to the point, many of them, including poor Eminar, had a symbol built into the sides of their homes, shaped like a snake. A proof of membership, you could say.
話を戻そう。気の毒な Eminar を含め、多くの会員は家の側面に蛇の形の紋章を組み込んでいた。会員の証、とでも言おうか。
Return to the victim's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find a snake symbol.
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の被害者の家に戻り、蛇の紋章を探す。
Find the gamblers in the {p} sewers.
{p} の下水道で賭博客を見つける。
How did ya find us down 'ere? I don't remember you... you're with the police, aren't ya? Here after Eminar, I suppose?
どうやってこの下まで来た？見ねえ顔だ…警察の人間だろ？Eminar の件で来たってとこか？
Yeah, we've 'eard about what happened to him. Murders don't happen every day up there, ya know. And as it happened, I saw Eminar down here, not too long ago...
ああ、あいつに何があったかは聞いてる。上じゃ殺しなんて毎日あるもんじゃねえしな。それに、ついこの前ここで Eminar を見たんだ…
Well... as long as I get a guarantee I won't be shut down, I'll help ya. This is a very profitable place, as I'm sure ya might've guessed.
まあ…ここを潰さねえって保証してくれるなら、手を貸すぜ。察しの通り、ここはかなり儲かるんでな。
He was brought down here by his friend one day. Rohem, it was. A fine customer, you understand. Never failed to pay his dues...
ある日、あいつは友達にここへ連れてこられた。Rohem だ。上客だぜ、分かるだろ。払いを滞らせたことはねえ…
It was a good day for me, for obvious reasons, don'cha see! But Rohem was furious. Dead drunk, too, but what else is new!
俺にとっちゃいい日だったさ、言うまでもなくな！だが Rohem は激怒してた。泥酔もしてたが、いつものことだ！
Neither of 'em has been back since, though in Eminar's case, I can see why! And I hope that's enough for ya, 'cause that's all I got.
それ以来どっちも来てねえ。Eminar の方は理由が分かるがな！これで足りるといいが、知ってるのはこれだけだ。
Confront Rohem about the murder at house #{~} in {p}.
{p} の {~} 番の家で Rohem を殺人について問い詰める。
Ah... you again! You're back. I see that. I must admit, I did not expect you to return... so soon...
ああ…また君か！戻ってきたのだな。見れば分かる。正直、こんなに早く…戻るとは思わなかった…
You really did find your way down there? Oh, that's... excellent... I hope the investigation is going well. Now if you'll just leave me be-
本当に下まで行けたのか？ああ、それは…素晴らしい…捜査が順調だといいね。では、そろそろ放っておいて―
Valimare? Bah! Why would you trust anything he says? He's a criminal! A scam artist! I mean, I did direct you to him, but...
Valimare？ふん！なぜあいつの言うことなど信じる？犯罪者だぞ！詐欺師だ！確かにあいつを紹介したのは私だが…
He- He's the one you should be arresting. Eminar was a danger to society, got what he deserved, the fool-
あ、あいつこそ逮捕すべきだ。Eminar は社会の害だった、報いを受けたのさ、あの愚か者は―
Wait! No! Don't turn me in! Can't you let me finish my drink in peace? Get out, get out, you can't prove anything!
待て！やめろ！突き出さないでくれ！酒くらい静かに飲ませてくれないか？出て行け、出て行け、何も証明できんだろう！
Besides, have you ever heard of a little thing called evidence? You don't have any proof!
それに「証拠」というちょっとしたものを聞いたことはあるかね？証拠などないだろう！
Now, officer, if you don't have a proper warrant, I expect you to vacate my property immediately!
さて、刑事さん、正式な令状がないなら、ただちに私の敷地から出て行ってもらおう！
Find the murder weapon around Rohem's house at house #{~} in {p}.
{p} の {~} 番の家、Rohem の家の周りで凶器を探す。
Hi! I'm digging a hole in my garden, just like Mr. Rohem did last night!
こんにちは！庭に穴を掘ってるの、ゆうべの Rohem さんみたいに！
For the last time officer, would you either show me a warrant or get out of my- what are you doing in my garden?!
何度も言わせるな刑事さん、令状を見せるか私の―私の庭で何をしている？！
A... a hatchet? I don't know what you mean, I- I've never seen that before in my life!
て…手斧？何のことだか、わ、私は生まれてこのかた見たこともない！
Gah! Curse you, human! I might be headed to jail, but I can send you straight to hell!
ぐあっ！呪われろ、人間め！牢屋行きかもしれんが、貴様を地獄に送ってやる！
That's enough, Rohem! Stand down, or the guards will attack.
そこまでだ、Rohem！手を引け、さもなくば衛兵が攻撃する。
Augh! Fine, you've got me. But mark my words, this won't be the last you hear of me, human!
ぐうっ！いいだろう、捕まったよ。だが覚えておけ、人間、私の名を聞くのはこれが最後ではないぞ！
As for you, human, please accept my immense gratitude. We probably wouldn't have caught that rat without you.
さて人間、心から感謝する。君がいなければ、あのネズミは捕まえられなかっただろう。
On behalf of the city of {p}, please accept these emeralds as compensation for your services. You were a fine detective today!
{p} の街を代表し、働きへの報酬としてこのエメラルドを受け取ってくれ。今日の君は立派な探偵だった！
Heya there! Fancy a quick game of blackjack?
よう！ブラックジャックを一勝負どうだい？
よっしゃ、ブラックジャックだ！
Good stuff! Put ya money in the pot and I'll start the deal.
いいね！賭け金を置いてくれ、配り始めるぜ。
Not feelin' up to playin' right now? No worries, just drop by later!
今は気分じゃない？気にすんな、また寄ってくれ！
Not right now? No worries - come back another time!
今はいい？気にすんな、また今度な！
Ah, new to the game huh? No worries, lemme tell ya all about it!
おっ、初めてかい？気にすんな、全部教えてやるよ！
The rules are simple! I deal two cards face up to ya both face down, and two cards to me, one face up and one face down.
ルールは簡単！あんたにカードを二枚、どっちも伏せて配る。俺には二枚、一枚は表で一枚は伏せる。
Number cards are worth what they say, all picture cards are worth {~}, and an ace can be worth either {~} or {~}, whichever works best for ya hand.
数字札はその数字、絵札は全部 {~}、エースは {~} か {~} で、手札に都合のいい方になる。
Go over {~} and that's it - you're bust! Stand with your current hand and it's my turn to hit or stand to try and beat your hand.
{~} を超えたらそこまで、バーストだ！今の手札でスタンドしたら、俺がヒットかスタンドしてあんたに勝ちにいく。
And if ya get a blackjack - that's an ace and a picture card or a ten - ya automatically get double ya money back!
ブラックジャック、つまりエースと絵札か10が揃ったら、自動で賭け金が倍になって戻ってくる！
Sound fair enough? Alrighty, just right-click me again to play!
公平だろ？よっしゃ、もう一回右クリックで始めるぜ！
I'm sorry, recruit, but that passage is blocked. We used to use it, but not anymore...
すまないが新兵、その通路はふさがれている。昔は使っていたが、今はもう……
He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who we lost to spiders some time ago.
あの子は……扱いが難しい。少し前に蜘蛛に命を奪われた私の姉の息子なのだ。
With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken its toll on us both.
父親もいなくなっていたから、私が引き取るしかなかった。もう立派な大人だが……あの喪失が私たち二人に傷を残しているのだと思う。
I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
あの馬鹿げた悪ふざけを早くやめてくれることを心から願っている……だが厳しく言い聞かせる以上のことは、どうしてもできないのだ。
He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. I only wish he would show that side of himself to others.
あの子は本当に善い人間だ。心からそう信じている。ただ、その面を他人にも見せてくれたらと願うばかりだ。
{u}, hello! This place really is nice, isn't it? I'd like to stay a while longer before moving on towards {p}, but I'll be ready soon.
{u}、やあ！ここ、すごくいい所だよね？{p} に向かう前にもう少しいたいけど、すぐ準備できるよ。
You need to be Woodcutting Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.
このミニクエストを始めるには伐採レベル {~} が必要だ。
We can kill spiders! Right, {u}? Come on, this is what we're here to do! We became soldiers to help the people of Wynn, didn't we? We'll help you get your mushrooms back, sir.
蜘蛛なら倒せます！だよね、{u}？そのためにここへ来たんだ！Wynn の人々を助けるために兵士になったんだ。キノコは取り戻しますよ。
H-hm. Good. I can't m-make my soup without... mushrooms. F-follow me, I'll take you to the-... the spiders. B-bad spiders.
うん。いいね。キ、キノコがないと…スープがつ、つくれない！つ、ついて来てくれ！く、蜘蛛のところにあ、案内するよ。わ、悪い蜘蛛だ。
Ah, you two must be the the recruits Aledar has been telling us all about. It's good to finally meet you, though I can't help but notice you seem to have arrived in a rush.
ああ、君たちが Aledar が言っていた新兵か。ようやく会えて嬉しいが、ずいぶん急いで来たようだね。
O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushrooms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-why wouldn't it b-be?
お、おお！い、いや、何もないよ。な、何も。ぼ、僕のキ、キ、キノコは…だ、大丈夫だよ。そ、それがどうしたの？ぜ、全部…順調だよ。じゅ、順調にきまってるよ
Soon... s-soon I will have my m-mushrooms again...
もうすぐ…も、もうすぐまた俺のキ、キノコが…
G-gah! D-don't you know it's rude to-... to e-eavesdrop?
ひ、ひいっ！ぬ、盗み聞きは失礼だって…し、知らないのか？
I-... this is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
ま…まずい。本当にまずい。すぐ村長に知らせないと。
Right! Right. We've arrived from {p}, with bad news and a request for aid. The spiders of the forest have grown hostile, and threaten the town.
はい！そうです。{p} から来ました。悪い知らせと援助のお願いです。森の蜘蛛が凶暴になり、村を脅かしています。
And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with him.
それに Van 中尉が腐敗した拠点の襲撃を計画しています！人手が増えれば喜ぶはずです。
In the meantime, I've been thinking about what we could do to help this place... I've maybe got something.
その間、この場所のために何かできないか考えてたんだ…ひとつ思いついたかも。
Take a look at that villager over there. He's acting a little off, like he's got something going on. I wonder...
あそこの村人を見て。様子がちょっと変だよね、何かありそうだ。もしかして…
Alright, I've decided. I'm feeling a little restless, so let's go over there and see if there's anything we can help with!
よし、決めた。なんだか落ち着かないし、あっちに行って何か手伝えないか見てみよう！
Maybe we can leave this place better off than it was when we got here!
来た時よりもいい場所にして、ここを去れるかもね！
Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる奇妙な男と話す
G-... Hi! H-how can I help you on this... this p-perfectly fine and n-n-normal day!
や…やあ！こ、この…この完ぺきにふ、ふ、普通の日に、な、何かご用で！
Sorry to interrupt- we're soldiers traveling through this town, and you looked like the sort of person who might need the kind of help soldiers can provide. Anything we can help with?

Growing up, he told me stories of his trips... {p} was always the place that stood out the most, of the ones he described.
小さい頃から旅の話を聞かされてて…その中で一番印象的だったのが {p} なの。
It sounds like nothing you'd ever see anywhere else. Golden leaves, beautiful traditional architecture, and the kindest people...
他のどこでも見られない景色みたい。金色の葉、美しい伝統建築、それに一番やさしい人たち…
Needless to say, I've dreamed of going there my whole life. Of course, I also dreamed of going everywhere else, too. But Auburn most of all.
言うまでもなく、ずっとそこに行くのが夢だったの。もちろん他の場所にも行きたかったけど、一番は Auburn！
Ah, them. I've not really spoken to either.
ああ、あの人たち。どっちともあまり話してないの。
I tried talking to the one with the funny shirt, but they didn't seem much for conversation.
変なシャツの人に話しかけてみたけど、あまり話したくないみたいだった。
The other guy? He seems to be from around here, and, well...
もう一人？この辺の人みたいで、その…
...I don't have anything against the people of this District, but their attitudes differ from mine, and...
…この地区の人に恨みはないけど、考え方が私とは違ってて、それで…
...I'm just a little tired of being berated by them for coming here, okay?
…ここに来たことを責められるのに、ちょっと疲れちゃったの。
Oh! The train's here! ...Uh, Guess I should catch you later?
あっ！列車が来た！…えっと、また後でね？
You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.
話したい？はあ、いいよ。いいけどさ。
Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the Industrial Distict was like.
はあ。まあ、僕は {p} 出身なんだ。あそこは…好きじゃない。だから Industrial District がどんな所か見たかった。
Having been here yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
君もここに来たなら、どうなったかよく分かるだろ。で、今は帰るところ。
Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like this.
正直、今となっては、この州に見る価値のある場所なんてあるのか分からない。どこもこんな感じなんだろう。
...But enough about me. What do you want to say?
…僕の話はもういい。何が言いたいの？
Sorry about that, I got... Madder, than expected... Anything else you'd like to discuss?
ごめん、思ったより…イライラしちゃって…他に話したいことは？
I chose the {p} because it was the cheapest ticket... I had to exchange so many materials for those weird emeralds they use here.
{p}を選んだのは切符が一番安かったから…ここで使う変なエメラルドと交換するのに、材料をすごくたくさん手放したよ。
I had high expectations, thought seeing another part of the province might restore my hopes... It didn't.
期待してたんだ。州の別の場所を見れば希望を取り戻せるかもって…無理だった。
I didn't even want to witness whatever mess the Festival there was going to end up being. It couldn't possibly compensate for missing the one back home.
あそこの祭りがどんな大混乱になるか、見たくもなかった。故郷のフェスティバルを見逃したことを、それだけでは到底埋め合わせられないからだ。
I'm just heading home. I guess I'll have to just... learn to like Auburn. Ugh...
帰るだけだよ。…Auburn を好きになるしかないんだろうな。はあ…
This shirt? Ugh... I forgot about this stupid shirt.
このシャツ？はあ…このバカなシャツのこと忘れてた。
On the way here, some guy came up to me and begged on his knees for me to buy his shirt. It was hard to refuse... I felt bad...
ここに来る途中、ある男が寄ってきて、シャツを買ってくれって土下座で頼まれたんだ。断りづらくて…気の毒でさ…
I guess "TC" stands for {p} City. For the record, I do NOT love {p} City.
「TC」は {p} City の略かな。言っとくけど {p} City は全然好きじゃない。
In fact, this shirt doesn't even hold any value to me as a souvenier. I don't want to remember this trip.
それに、このシャツには記念品としての価値すらない。この旅のことは忘れたいんだ。
I'm going to have to destroy it, or perhaps trade it for something. I never want to see it again.
捨てるか、何かと交換するしかない。二度と見たくない。
It feels like we're living in squalor for no reason! You always hear these wonderful stories about other regions, like that the {p} have beautiful, huge lakes.
理由もなく不潔な暮らしをしてる気がするんだ！他の地域の素敵な話ばかり聞くだろ、{p} には大きくてきれいな湖があるとか。
If that's even true, why can't we get some of that water? Why must we put up with the pathetic trickle we get from the dam?
それが本当なら、なんでその水を少しも分けてもらえない？なんでダムから来るあんな情けない量で我慢しなきゃいけないんだ？
And yet, everyone back home is just so... Okay??? With it??? They think the government couldn't wrong them. They build shrines to the Queen in their homes!
なのに、地元のみんなは…平気なんだ？？？それで？？？政府が自分たちを裏切るはずないって思ってる。家に女王の祭壇まで作ってるんだ！
It's just so... Frustrating!!! Why can't they see things the way I do??? The region itself is mostly fine, it's the people I can't stand!
本当に…イライラする！！！なんで僕みたいに見られないんだ？？？地域自体はまあいい、我慢できないのは人間の方だ！
I don't even believe those stories anymore though... I think everywhere is just awful in its own way.
でも、もうそんな話も信じてない…どこもそれぞれにひどいんだと思う。
We were always sold this idea of the {p} as this beautiful place where proud workers labored for the Queen amidst beautiful crop fields... You've seen it, haven't you?
{p} は美しい農地で誇り高い労働者が女王のために働く、美しい場所だってずっと聞かされてきた…君も見ただろ？
I bet everywhere is just as bad. I just don't know what to think of anything anymore. It all feels like a lie. But maybe I'm just asking for too much, I don't know...
どこも同じくらいひどいんだろうな。もう何をどう考えればいいのか分からない。全部嘘みたいだ。でも、僕が求めすぎなのかも、分からないよ…
Other people? The girl tried talking to me, but she left me alone when she realized I didn't want to talk.
他の人？あの女の子が話しかけてきたけど、僕が話したくないって分かったら放っておいてくれた。
And that other guy? I didn't notice him until just now.
もう一人の男？今の今まで気づかなかった。
...Train's here. Stop talking to me, please...
…列車が来た。もう話しかけないで、頼むから…
Hey... Didn't I just ask you to not cause trouble? Could you stop that, please?
おい…さっき面倒を起こすなって言いましたよね？やめてもらえます？
Listen. I don't feel like calling the guards over, okay? I'm asking you to please stop.
いいですか。衛兵を呼びたくはないんです。お願いだからやめてください。
You're really annoying everyone here, including me. Thanks.
みんな本当に迷惑してますよ、私も。どうも。
Sigh... Whatever, it's not like they're paying me enough to care...
はあ…まあいいや、気にするほど給料もらってないし…
Step aside, citizens. We're here on important business.
下がれ、市民たち。重要な任務で来ている。
The general of the Constables Division..? I wonder what's going on...
警邏部隊の将軍…？何が起きてるんだ…
Keep your nose out of our matters, citizen. Our activities will have no impact on your trip.
我々のことに首を突っ込むな、市民。我々の行動が君たちの旅に影響することはない。
Hey! What's the holdup? All aboard! Come on!
おい！何をぐずぐずしてる？全員乗車！早く！
Hello passenger! I hope that the subway experience has been to your liking.
いらっしゃいませ、お客様！地下鉄の旅をお楽しみいただけていますか。
I am Telati, the attendant for your journey today. I am sorry I did not say hello when verifying your stamp, I was a little, uh, shocked by how many people were taking the train today.
本日の乗務員の Telati です。スタンプ確認の際にご挨拶できず申し訳ありません。今日の乗客の多さに、その、少し驚いてしまいまして。
We don't get passengers often, to be honest with you, so to have even this many... That was a surprise. Not to mention General Levi being here, too.
正直、普段はお客様が少ないので、これだけの人数でも…驚きでした。{c2}Levi 将軍{/}までいらっしゃいますし。
Anyway, we should be arriving in {p} in an hour or two. Until then, feel free to talk with your fellow passengers, or take a nap.
ともかく、一、二時間ほどで {p} に到着します。それまで{c2}他のお客様とお話しする{/}なり、{c2}お昼寝{/}するなりご自由にどうぞ。
I hope you have a good trip! And, if there's any issues, do not be afraid to speak with me.
よい旅を！何か問題があれば、遠慮なくお声がけください。
Explore the train. Return to your seat at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] when done.
列車内を探索する。終わったら [-{~}, {~}, {~}] の座席に戻る。
Oh, hello there, passenger. Is something the matter?
あ、こんにちは、お客様。どうかされましたか？
...You just want to chat? You know what, sure, it could be a nice break from my busywork.
…ただお話ししたいだけ？いいですよ、雑務のいい息抜きになりそうです。
As I told you before, my name's Telati. I'm... the only staffer on the train today. Besides the driver, Cusef, but he's busy, well, driving.
先ほど申し上げた通り、Telati です。今日の列車の唯一の乗務員で…運転士の Cusef を除けばですが、彼は、その、運転で忙しいので。
That means I'm the only person here to attend our many passengers today. Again, we don't usually get this many.
つまり、今日の大勢のお客様のお世話は私一人なんです。重ねて言いますが、普段はこんなに来ません。
It's... It's okay though. Everyone seems fairly content. Besides that Cemor guy, at least.
でも…大丈夫です。皆さんそれなりに満足されているようですし。少なくともあの Cemor 様以外は。
Enough about that though. What would you like to talk about?
それはさておき、何のお話をしましょう？
Anything wrong? Or do you just want to chat?
何か問題が？それともお話ししたいだけですか？
...It's okay. I can handle it... Anything else to say?
…大丈夫です。何とかなります…他に何か？
...Perhaps I shouldn't have let that slip... Uhm... Anything else to say...?
…口を滑らせるべきではなかったかも…えっと…他に何か…？
There aren't many of us, really. Each train usually has only {~} staffers- a driver and {~} attendants.
実は人数は少ないんです。列車ごとに通常 {~} 人だけ――運転士一人と乗務員 {~} 人です。
The team for this particular train is Cusef the driver, plus Zathie and I.
この列車の担当は運転士の Cusef、それに Zathie と私です。
This is typically enough, as the trains aren't very busy. Frankly, I don't know why they bother having this many carriages.
列車はあまり混まないので、普段はそれで足ります。正直、なぜこんなに車両があるのか分かりません。
It's usually only Aelumians and Highlanders who can afford trips, and, well... Most of those guys don't seem interested in seeing other regions.
旅行できるのはたいてい Aelumia 人か highland 人だけで、その…彼らの多くは他の地域を見ることに興味がないようで。
This time of year is actually the exception, since the Festivals are on. But, having spoken to a few passengers, none seem to be travelling for that at all.
この時期は例外なんです、お祭りの季節ですから。でも何人かのお客様に聞いても、お祭り目当ての方は一人もいませんでした。
For today's trip to have so many people - and such a diverse set too - is an anomaly. It's... unfortunate timing, too, since Zathie's on break.
今日これほど大勢、しかも様々な方が乗るのは異例です。Zathie が休暇中なので、間も悪くて。
We were dealing with all the expected extra traffic from the Auburn Festival being on, and she burnt herself preparing a meal, so she got a couple days off.
Auburn のお祭りで増えた乗客の対応をしていたら、彼女が食事の準備中に火傷をして、数日休みを取ったんです。
I thought it'd be fine since the Auburn Festival's wrapped up, but... I guess there's still a lot of interest in going there?
Auburn のお祭りも終わったから大丈夫だと思ったんですが…まだあそこに行きたい人は多いんですね？
Ah, my home. It may surprise you, but I'm from the Roughw- er- {p}.
ああ、故郷ですか。意外かもしれませんが、Roughw…いえ…{p} の出身です。
I'm lucky to have a job such as this, living where I do. The conditions aboard the train are heavenly compared to where my neighbors work.
私の住む所を思えば、こんな仕事に就けたのは幸運です。列車の環境は、隣人たちの職場と比べれば天国ですよ。
...I do wonder why they can't share this quality of life. I suppose there must be a reason for it; I trust Her Majesty's judgement.
…なぜこの暮らしの質を皆で分かち合えないのかと思うこともあります。きっと理由があるのでしょう。陛下のご判断を信じています。
Ah, him. Yes, he's the Highlander sat in the dining carriage.
ああ、あの方。食堂車に座っている highland 人の方です。
He seems... needy. No- maybe that's just selfish of me to say.
あの方は…手がかかる。いえ…そう言うのは私のわがままかも。
He keeps asking me to prepare him some specific meal, and... listen. The customer is always right, and all, but...
ある特定の料理を作れと何度も言われて…その、お客様は常に正しい、とは言いますが…
I'm not the chef on this train. That's Zathie. I'm scared of messing up the recipe, and also just generally dislike cooking.
私はこの列車の料理人じゃないんです。それは Zathie です。レシピを失敗するのが怖いし、そもそも料理が嫌いで。
So... I'm hanging out here as far away from him as possible, hoping he just... forgets about it.
だから…あの方からできるだけ離れてここにいるんです。そのまま…忘れてくれないかと。
Sigh... Maybe that's immoral of me, I don't know.
はあ…不道徳かもしれませんね、分かりませんけど。
The train's like a second home to me. Maybe more of a home to me than my real home...
列車は私の第二の家みたいなものです。本当の家より家らしいかも…
It's the most comfortable place I've ever been. I love it here.
今までで一番居心地のいい場所です。ここが大好きです。
Getting to travel all over Fruma for free is such a privilege, too, I've seen some beautiful stations...
Fruma じゅうを無料で旅できるのも特権ですね。きれいな駅もたくさん見ました…
Yes, just stations. They never let me go beyond. But there's some gorgeous sights to see from there alone up in {p} or at {p}.
ええ、駅だけです。外には出してもらえません。でも {p} や {p} なら、駅からの眺めだけでも見事ですよ。
...I've only been to {p} a couple of times. It's military-only and they typically use their own trains to travel there...
…{p} には数回しか行ったことがありません。軍専用で、普段は軍の列車で行き来するので…
...But sometimes, there are urgent matters that require the use of civilian trains. Today seems to be one such instance of this.
…でも時々、民間の列車を使う必要のある緊急事態があるんです。今日はまさにそれのようですね。
Oh! I'm so sorry! I must've forgotten to give you that.
あっ！申し訳ありません！お渡しし忘れていたようです。
I- I was in such a hurry to accomodate everyone, it must have slipped my mind... I sincerely apologize.
み、皆さんのご案内で慌てていて、うっかりしていました…本当に申し訳ありません。
Oh, alright then. Have a good trip!
あ、そうですか。よい旅を！
I TOLD you, idiot, ya need to wear Aelumia purple! Since we're not assigned to the Roughworks anymore!
言っただろ、バカ、Aelumia の紫を着ろって！もう Roughworks 担当じゃねえんだから！
Lighten up, Maury. At least I used the right colour for my sword's hilt.
落ち着けよ、Maury。少なくとも剣の柄の色は合ってるだろ。
NO, Harvin, that is NOT GOOD ENOUGH. We're already on thin ice after the sewage incident.
違う、Harvin、それじゃ足りねえんだ。汚水の件で俺たちはもう崖っぷちなんだぞ。
Bein' assigned to the General is a BIG DEAL! We can't screw it up, or we're OUT.
将軍付きになるのは大ごとだ！しくじったら俺たちはクビだ。
I still think the sewage incident was way overblown, but whatever.
汚水の件は大げさすぎたと今でも思うけどな、まあいいや。
I agree, but that's not the p- Oh, hey there, citizen.
同感だが、そういう問題じゃ――おっと、よう、市民。
Drop the act, Maury. They were there for like half the argument.
芝居はやめろ、Maury。口論の半分くらいから、そこにいたぞ。
WHAT? Why didn't ya tell me???
なに？なんで言わねえんだ？？？
いや、知ってると思って。
Ech... Whatever. You. Whaddaya ya want. You wanna chat? Got a problem to report? What's goin' on.
チッ…まあいい。おい。何の用だ。雑談か？通報か？どうした。
Got anythin' else you wanna say?
...We're movin' on before he says any more. Ask about somethin' else.
…こいつがこれ以上しゃべる前に次だ。他のことを聞け。
Me too, bud, me too... Ah, right. You. Anythin' else to say?
俺もだよ、相棒…ああ、そうだ。お前。他に言いてえことは？
That ain't fer your ears, kid.
お前が聞く話じゃねえ、坊主。
We're guarding General Levi on her trip to {p}, where she'll be helping investigate some kind of bre-
俺たちは Levi 将軍の {p} 行きを護衛してるんだ。何かの侵入の調査を手伝いに――
HARVIN, NO. She told us NOT to tell anyone what's goin' on. And this door's thin, what if she hears us?
Harvin、ダメだ。誰にも言うなって言われただろ。それにこの扉は薄い、聞かれたらどうする？
I do wonder what happened though. She said it's really bad there, ton of soldiers dead supposedly, plus a Comman-
でも何があったんだろうな。ひどい状況らしい、兵士が大勢死んだって話だ、それに司令――
Every division of the Guard has a General leading it; she's ours.
衛兵隊の各部隊には将軍がいて、あの人がうちの将軍だ。
おっかねえ人だぜ、ほんと。
We were just mindin' our business, roughin' up some... miscreants, and then she comes along an' drags us into bein' her guards for this whole shabang.
俺たちはただ自分の仕事をしてた、ちょっと…ならず者を締め上げてな。そしたらあの人が来て、この騒ぎの護衛に引っ張り込まれたんだ。
...Between you an' us... I don't think she woulda made us come along had she not been in a hurry...
…ここだけの話…急いでなかったら、俺たちを連れてこなかったと思うぜ…
Yeah, more likely, she would have just fired us on the spot.
ああ、むしろその場でクビにしてただろうな。
SHHH. What if she overhears? Don't give 'er any ideas.
シーッ。聞かれたらどうする。余計なこと思いつかせんな。
Stories? What am I, yer mother at bedtime? Why would I tell you sto-
話？俺はお前の寝かしつけの母ちゃんか？なんで話なんか――
We could tell them about the time we were assigned to {p}!
{p} に配属された時の話をしてやろうぜ！
Ohhh, yeah! I love that story. Great thinkin', Harvin.
おお、いいな！あの話は大好きだ。冴えてるな、Harvin。
So basically, there's this guy who comes up to us, an' he's all like "ooh i'm from house blahblah you must respect me..."
つまりだな、ある野郎が寄ってきて、「おお、我は何とか家の者、敬いたまえ…」って感じでよ。
Us, bein' from the Roughworks, don' give a damn about any 'a that. So he gets mad when we laugh in 'is face.
俺たちは Roughworks 育ちだから、そんなのどうでもいい。で、目の前で笑ってやったら怒り出してな。
...accidentally knocks over a stall and gets himself totally covered in dyes!
…うっかり屋台をひっくり返して、全身染料まみれになったんだ！
YEAH, haha, his fancy clothes were ruined! It was awesome.
そうそう、ハハ、高そうな服が台無しさ！最高だったぜ。
Sadly, I think he actually had some influence, cause we've not been assigned to {p} since...
残念だが、あいつはコネがあったらしい。それ以来 {p} には配属されてねえ…
Man, the {p} were beautiful, wish I could see them again.
ああ、{p} はきれいだったなあ。また見たいよ。
The sewage incident is not to be spoken of.
汚水の件は口にしちゃいけないんだ。
We are NOT tellin' you about that, kid.
その件は絶対に話さねえぞ、坊主。
Then go away, kid. We have important things to do.
なら失せな、坊主。こっちは大事な用があるんだ。
...You again? Was it not clear enough that I wanted to be left alone?
…また君？一人にしてほしいって、分からなかった？
Having been there yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
君もあそこに行ったなら、どうなったかよく分かるだろ。で、今は帰るところ。
Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like that.
正直、今となっては、この州に見る価値のある場所なんてあるのか分からない。どこもあんな感じなんだろう。
...But enough about me. What do you want to say?
…僕の話はもういい。何が言いたいの？
What do you want to say?
...I have a lot of thinking to do, basically. It would be easier to do that if you left me alone...
…要するに、考えることがたくさんあるんだ。放っておいてくれた方が考えやすいんだけど…
It's the same experience as before, just... different.
前と同じ体験なのに…何か違うんだ。
The first time, I was amazed... It's so comfortable and nice... I was so excited to see what awaited me in {p}...
初めての時は感動した…すごく快適で…{p} に何が待ってるか、すごく楽しみだった…
Now? It all just feels like a facade. I can't enjoy it the same way.
今は？全部見せかけに思える。同じようには楽しめない。
Oh, yeah, they're here, I guess.
ああ、いるね、あの人たち。
I don't really care, as long as they don't find some way to make my trip even worse...
どうでもいいよ、僕の旅をこれ以上ひどくしないならね…
They're agents of the Queen, and I don't really know what to think of that anymore. I can't tell if she hoards all the wealth for herself, or if she tells us everything's good just to make us happy.
女王の手先だし、それをどう考えればいいのかもう分からない。女王が富を独り占めしてるのか、僕らを満足させるために全部順調だと言ってるだけなのか、分からないんだ。
Oh, hey again, friend. Nice to see ya!
やあ、また会ったね。嬉しいよ！
The train's pretty nice, isn't it? If a bit... empty.
この列車、いいだろ？ちょっと…がらんとしてるけど。
I do wonder what was going on with the military presence... It's not every day that you see a General, after all.
軍のあの物々しさ、何だったんだろうな…将軍なんて毎日見られるもんじゃないし。
Oh, hey, stranger. Looking for a chat? Sure, it'll help kill some time on the ride, I guess.
やあ、見知らぬ人。話し相手を探してる？いいよ、道中の暇つぶしになるし。
The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm guessing you'll be going to the same stop as me? To {p}?
俺は Malic、よろしく。君も俺と同じ駅で降りるんだろ？{p} へ？
I'm pretty excited about it. In the Roughworks, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
けっこうワクワクしてるんだ。Roughworks の人間は女王線に乗る機会なんてまずない。俺たちには高すぎるからね。
Heh. Enough yammering from me, though. You probably have your own stuff you wanna talk about, right?
へへ。俺ばっかり喋りすぎたな。君も話したいことがあるんだろ？
...Anyway, what do you want to talk about?
It's, uh, a lot different to the trains back home. Nicer.
その、地元の列車とは大違いだよ。こっちの方がいい。
See, I commute to work on the Industrial Sector Loop, for which I am fortunate enough to have a free pass.
俺は工業区環状線で通勤してるんだ。運よく無料パスを持っててね。
The trains there are... not like this. The seats are uncomfortable, it's usually packed with people, and it's never as clean.
あっちの列車は…こんなんじゃない。座席は硬いし、たいてい満員だし、こんなにきれいだったためしがない。
Why... Why are ours different? Why can't this quality be afforded to us..?
なんで…なんで俺たちのは違うんだ？なんでこの質を俺たちには与えられない…？
I'm very curious about their "important matters," it's highly unusual for them to travel with this amount of urgency.
彼らの「重要な任務」がすごく気になる。あんなに急いで移動するなんて、めったにないことだ。
Typically, the military travel on their own trains, for safety and security. But for someone so important- the General of the Constables Division- to use a civilian train...
軍は普通、安全と機密のために専用の列車を使う。なのにあれほどの重要人物――警邏部隊の将軍――が民間の列車を使うなんて…
...the Constables Division... I'm... not fond of them, to be honest. I'm sure you've seen, but they patrol all over the Roughworks, and they're just... such bullies.
…警邏部隊か…正直、好きじゃない。君も見ただろうけど、Roughworks じゅうを巡回してて、とにかく…横暴なんだ。
They're always going around, roughing up people for not paying their rent, or stepping even slightly out of line...
いつもうろついては、家賃を払えないとか、少しでも道を外れたとかで人を痛めつけてる…
I know the General said her activities wouldn't impact the trip, but... I'm not convinced. I hope it'll be okay.
将軍は旅に影響しないって言ってたけど…どうかな。何事もなければいいけど。
I've not spoken to anyone else on the train, but maybe I should. Could hear some interesting things about their regions.
車内の他の人とはまだ話してないけど、話すべきかもな。それぞれの地域の面白い話が聞けるかも。
Besides the attendant, Telati, I seem to be the only Roughworker here. To be expected, of course, since none of us can usually afford such a privilege.
乗務員の Telati を除けば、Roughworks の人間は俺だけみたいだ。当然だけどね、俺たちにはこんな贅沢、普通は無理だから。
Hm. I'll think about socializing in a little bit. But for now, I'm pretty comfortable, honestly.
うーん。人付き合いはもう少ししたら考えるよ。でも今は、正直けっこう快適なんだ。
Oh, hello. Looking for a conversation to pass some time? Sure thing.
あら、こんにちは。暇つぶしのお話し相手をお探し？いいですよ。
My name is Demma, and I'm a student from the Aelumia University.
私は Demma、Aelumia 大学の学生です。
I'm travelling to Auburn for my study project... I can't wait!
研究課題で Auburn に行くところで…待ちきれません！
See, I'm from the Blossom House. We study biology, and one of the highlights of the course is getting to travel and do fieldwork.
私は花寮に所属していて、生物学を学んでいるんです。この課程の一番の楽しみは、旅に出て現地調査ができることなんですよ。
I'm conducting a study of Fruma's snails- they've always fascinated me... They come in so many different shapes and sizes...
Fruma のカタツムリを研究しているんです――昔から惹かれていて…形も大きさも本当に様々で…
Auburn forest has some of the greatest... I can't wait to see a Gigastropod in person!
Auburn の森にはとびきりの…Gigastropod を実際に見るのが待ちきれません！
Goodness, I must stop myself before I bore you with one of my rants. I do that all too often. What do you actually want to talk about?
まあ、長話で退屈させる前にやめないと。いつもこうなんです。本当は何を話したいんですか？
まだお話がありますか？
...Let's move on. Anything else to discuss?
…次の話にしましょう。他に話したいことは？
...Ah, sorry, I'm trailing off into tangents. Let's change topics.
…あ、すみません、話がそれてしまって。話題を変えましょう。
Gah! I need to stop going into tangents. Sorry. Let's change topics.
ああ！脱線癖を直さないと。すみません。話題を変えましょう。
...Let's just... Move on to another subject.
…ええと…別の話題にしましょう。
Have you not heard of it? It's the most prestigious educational institution in the province!
ご存じないんですか？州で最も権威ある教育機関ですよ！
For those who like learning, it's the best place in the world to be... We've got a huge library with books on just about any topic you can think of!
学ぶのが好きな人には世界一の場所です…ほとんどどんな分野の本もある、巨大な図書館があるんですよ！
You can only really study one set of topics at a time though, sadly, unless you're super dedicated.
残念ながら、よほど熱心でない限り、一度に学べる分野は一組だけなんです。
It's split into {~} different houses- Order, Crystal, Blossom, and Star- each with their own handful of subjects. I'm in Blossom, as previously stated.
{~} つの寮に分かれていて――秩序、水晶、花、星――それぞれにいくつかの学科があります。私は先ほど言った通り花寮です。
I chose Blossom for the biology, specifically. We also study history and fashion, but I care less about those.
花寮を選んだのは、まさに生物学のためです。歴史や服飾も学びますが、そちらはあまり興味がなくて。
Almost no-one has ever taken two courses at once. The only exception I can think of is Sovereign Majin, who studied in Order and Star.
二つの課程を同時に修めた人はほとんどいません。唯一思いつく例外が 君主 Majinで、秩序と星の両方で学んだんです。
He really can back up his big talk, huh...
大口を叩くだけのことはありますよね…
Honestly, I could care less about the culture there... It's cool and all, and learning the history of it has been fun, but...
正直、あそこの文化はどうでもよくて…素敵ですし、歴史を学ぶのも楽しかったですけど…
The fauna is what I'm really interested in seeing! There's so many fascinating creatures in the region!
本当に見たいのは動物相なんです！あの地域には魅力的な生き物がたくさんいるんですよ！
Snails aside, I've read so many interesting things about the region's wildlife. Elk that mimic trees, Beetles that hide amongst leaves, even fox-sized bats!
カタツムリは別にしても、あの地域の野生動物について面白い話をたくさん読みました。木に擬態するヘラジカ、葉に隠れる甲虫、狐ほどの大きさのコウモリまで！
It's been a joy reading about it, but it'll be even more amazing to see in person!
読むだけでも楽しかったけど、実際に見たらもっとすごいはず！
You know, I'd love to go on a field study to the {p} too, someday. My teacher, Professor Pestal, has been there a couple times.
いつか {p} にも現地調査に行きたいんです。私の先生の Pestal 教授は何度か行ったことがあるんですよ。
Apparently, it's so dangerous in there that you need to be constantly guarded by military professionals... But it would be so cool! I'd love to see a Kivaraptor in person!
あそこはとても危険で、常に軍の専門家に護衛してもらう必要があるそうです…でも絶対すごいですよ！Kivaraptor を実際に見てみたい！
From a young age, I've always loved animals, so joining Blossom House at the university just made sense.
小さい頃からずっと動物が好きで、大学で花寮に入るのは自然なことでした。
I grew up in {p}, so I've not seen much wildlife besides the limited amount that live in the city, plus some from travelling zoos.
{p} で育ったので、街に住むわずかな動物と移動動物園の動物以外、野生動物をあまり見たことがないんです。
It's been wonderful having the opportunity to go out and see more of it in person. We already did a field study in the {p}, which was amazing.
外に出て実物をもっと見られる機会があるのは素晴らしいです。{p} での現地調査はもう済ませて、最高でした。
Professor Pestal - my teacher - has been all over the place studying the province's fauna. I'd love to be like him someday.
私の先生の Pestal 教授は、州の動物相を研究するためにあちこち回っているんです。いつか先生のようになりたい。
Hey... On that note, see that girl sat over there? That's actually his daughter, Maddison. It's crazy running into her here.
あ…そういえば、あそこに座ってる女の子が見えます？実は先生の娘の Maddison なんです。ここで会うなんてびっくり。
I've spoken to her before- she's nice. Very curious, always wanted to explore the province, looks like she's finally gotten her wis-
前にも話したことがあって――いい子ですよ。好奇心旺盛で、ずっと州を探検したがってて、ついに夢が叶っ――
Oh, do NOT get me started on snails. I've always loved those little guys. They're so cute, and so interesting!
ああ、カタツムリの話を始めさせたら止まりませんよ。昔からあの子たちが大好きなんです。可愛くて、面白くて！
Did you know that they're not bugs as commonly ascribed, but rather, more related to aquatic creatures?
虫だと思われがちですけど、実は水生生物に近いって知ってました？
It's really fascinating! They're also so different to creatures as we tend to understand them.
本当に面白いんです！私たちが普通に考える生き物とは全然違うんですよ。
They're hermaphrodites, which means that any two snails can breed! And, they-
雌雄同体なので、どの二匹でも繁殖できるんです！それに――
Actually, maybe that's not an appropriate topic of conversation. Well, okay, I can think of something else...
あ、これはお話にふさわしい話題じゃないかも。ええと、じゃあ別のことを…
Did you know they have thousands of little teeth? They also can't hear!
何千もの小さな歯があるって知ってました？それに耳が聞こえないんです！
Yet, despite these differences, they like, understand us! They show signs of enjoying human contact!
なのに、こんなに違うのに、私たちのことを分かってくれるんです！人に触れられるのを喜ぶ様子を見せるんですよ！
There's also so many different species of snail, like the one I'm studying, the Gigastropod!!!
カタツムリの種類もすごく多くて、私が研究しているこの子、Gigastropod とか！！！
Did you know that Gigastropod shells are tougher than concrete? You can stand on them and the creature will be fine!
Gigastropod の殻はコンクリートより硬いって知ってました？上に立っても平気なんですよ！
...Though, I don't advise doing that- it's probably really scary for the poor snail.
…でも、おすすめはしません――カタツムリにはきっとすごく怖いので。
Apparently, back in the horrible Great Auburn Flood - you know - the one that kickstarted the New Age...
何でも、あの恐ろしい Auburn 大洪水――ほら――新時代の幕開けになったあの時…
...People survived by clinging onto the Gigastropods, because despite their hardy shells, they're also bouyant!
…人々は Gigastropod にしがみついて生き延びたそうです。殻は頑丈なのに、水に浮くんですよ！
Speaking of the dam, isn't it fascinating that Gigastropods are so closely related to the Murex Mollusc despite the sheer cliff between them?
ダムと言えば、切り立った崖を隔てているのに、Gigastropod が Murex Mollusc とこんなに近縁なんて面白くないですか？
Don't stand on Murex Molluscs though, they're toxic! Plus, their shells aren't as strong.
でも Murex Mollusc の上には立たないでくださいね、毒があるので！それに殻もそこまで硬くないです。
Did you know that their slime-
その粘液のことは知って――
OH, GOODNESS! I'm so sorry! I... I got carried away.
あっ、いけない！すみません！つい…夢中になってしまって。
I've got a really bad habit of just... infodumping. I'm so sorry.
情報をまくし立てる悪い癖があって…本当にすみません。
またあなた！こんにちは！
Gosh, we're going to arrive in {p} soon... It's quite exciting, isn't it?
わあ、もうすぐ {p} に着くね…ワクワクするよね？
I do wonder what was going on with the military activity back in the station... It was cool to see, but...
駅での軍の動き、何だったんだろう…見てる分にはかっこよかったけど…
I just hope it doesn't ruin our trip, somehow...
旅が台無しにならなきゃいいけど…
...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about?
…とにかく、何か話したいことある？
The train's really cool to ride around on. The spectacle of it hasn't worn off on me, and this is my third time experiencing it!
この列車、乗ってて本当に楽しいの。三回目なのに全然飽きないんだ！
In this area, I'm noticing a bunch of murals in the tunnels... It's fun to watch them, I just wish I could catch the details better.
この辺りのトンネルに壁画がたくさんあるの…見てて楽しいけど、細かいところまで見えないのが残念。
Can you imagine how beautiful it would be if the train was on the surface instead of underground? You'd get some amazing views of the province, I bet...
列車が地下じゃなくて地上を走ってたら、どんなにきれいか想像できる？きっと州のすごい景色が見られるよ…
I do wonder why the train only runs underground. Safety, maybe?
なんで地下しか走らないんだろう。安全のためかな？
Having grown up in Aelumia, I'm pretty familiar with the Guard's upper ranks. There's military parades all the time, you know!
Aelumia 育ちだから、衛兵隊の上層部には詳しいの。しょっちゅう軍事パレードがあるんだから！
That scary lady we saw back there? That was General Levi, the leader of the Constables Division.
さっきの怖そうな女の人？あれは{c2}警邏部隊の長{/}、{c2}Levi 将軍{/}よ。
She took on the role a few years ago, when the previous General, General Daimyo, stepped down. She's pretty cool, it was a nice surprise seeing her here!
数年前、前任の Daimyo 将軍が退任した時に就任したの。かっこいい人でね、ここで見られて嬉しい驚きだった！
I do wonder what calls for such urgency though... Usually, she has her Commanders handle most things. For her to need to handle something personally, and on a civilian train...
でも何がそんなに急ぎなんだろう…普段はほとんど部下の司令官たちに任せてるのに。自分で対応しなきゃいけないうえに、民間の列車でなんて…
...Well, she did ask that we stay out of it, so I guess I shouldn't get too curious.
…まあ、関わるなって言われたし、あまり詮索しない方がいいよね。
I talked to a few people when I first boarded, but now I'm just going to relax. I'll probably talk to more people later when I get bored.
乗った時に何人かと話したけど、今はのんびりするつもり。退屈したら後でまた話しに行くかも。
The first person I tried talking to was the attendant, Telati, but he seemed... stressed, so I just let him be.
最初に話しかけたのは乗務員の Telati さんだけど…ストレスが溜まってるみたいだったから、そっとしておいたの。
Then... See her over there? The girl with the glasses? That's Demma, one of my dad's students. We spoke for a bit, it was nice to see her!
それから…あそこの子、見える？眼鏡の女の子。パパの教え子の Demma よ。少し話したの、会えて嬉しかった！
Lastly, I tried speaking to the posh guy in the canteen, but... he said he was at a good part in his book, so I just left him alone.
最後に、食堂車の上品な男の人に話しかけたんだけど…本がいいところだって言われて、そっとしておいたの。
Sigh, what is it? You want to talk? To me?
はあ、何だね？話したい？この私と？
...Fine. I suppose I can indulge. But you had better leave me to read my book in peace when you're done.
…よかろう。付き合ってやってもいい。だが済んだら、静かに本を読ませてくれたまえ。
I am Cemor, of House Efelu, a noble house of small repute, though soon it shall surely rise.
私は Cemor、Efelu 家の者だ。名声こそ小さい貴族の家だが、いずれ必ずや名を上げよう。
I'm travelling from my home, the {p}, to Auburn. Why? Well, I booked a ticket to go to the Festival of the Queen, but... for the wrong date.
故郷の {p} から Auburn へ向かっている。なぜか？女王の祭りの切符を取ったのだが…日付を間違えてね。
I didn't want that money to go to waste, so I'm going to go and visit {p} anyway. There's probably some festival left to experience.
その金を無駄にしたくないので、とにかく {p} を訪れることにした。祭りの名残くらいはあるだろう。
But enough about little old me. What do you want to talk about?
だが、私の話はこのくらいにしよう。何を話したいのかね？
But let us move on from that. What else have you to discuss?
だがその話はここまでだ。他に何を話したい？
Let us move on. What else would you like to speak about?
次に移ろう。他に何を話したいかね？
Moving on. What else is there to speak of?
次へ。他に何か話すことは？
Ah, yes. The book. It's very good, I'm glad I chose to bring it with me.
ああ、そう。本だ。実によい本でね、持ってきてよかった。
It's called "The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Greenie S. Sweenville," which, I hope, speaks for itself.
題名は『Greenie S. Sweenville の冗長にして苦痛に満ちた死』、題名がすべてを物語っていると思う。
One of the members of my book club back in {p} recommended it to me. I'm glad they did- it's a beautiful story.
{p} の読書会の会員に勧められてね。勧めてもらってよかった――美しい物語だ。
It's a shame... The Auburn Festival is usually quite good. A few of us Highlanders go down to Auburn to see it.
残念だ…Auburn の祭りは普段なかなか良いのだ。我々 Highland 人も何人か Auburn まで見に行く。
They have games, beautiful cuisine, and a band... Who knew Auburn could put on such a wonderful show.
遊戯に、見事な料理に、楽団…Auburn があれほど見事な催しを開けるとは驚きだ。
I think it's that Sovereign Zhiraok- I hear he busies himself trying to atone for his family's failures. I'd feel bad, if not for him being a Nasin.
あの 君主 Zhiraokのおかげだろう――一族の失態を償おうと奔走していると聞く。Nasin 家の者でなければ同情もするのだが。
Our own festival is quite a sight to see, too. I'd recommend visiting, but they make those tickets too expensive for the lower regions, don't they?
我々の祭りもなかなかの見ものだ。訪れるよう勧めたいが、下の地域には切符が高すぎるのだろう？
Ah, the {p}. Gorgeous place, perhaps the real crown jewel of Fruma.
ああ、{p} か。見事な所だ、Fruma の真の至宝かもしれん。
I question why the Queen doesn't come and live amongst us. Perhaps she fears the people, hence her home being a fortress.
なぜ女王は我々の中で暮らさないのか。民を恐れているのかもしれん、だから住まいが要塞なのだ。
Our Sovereign, Majin... He spends far too much of his time trying to outcompete that Nasin, as would a Thalas.
我らが君主 Majin は…あの Nasin を出し抜こうとばかりしている。いかにも Thalas 家らしい。
He should keep his sights on his own region... The Nasins are already disgraced; what does he have to prove?
自分の地域に目を向けるべきだ…Nasin 家はすでに失墜している。今さら何を証明するというのだ？
It's... alright, I suppose. I've had worse train rides.
まあ…悪くはない。もっとひどい列車にも乗った。
I've also had better train rides, though... Usually, there is another caterer.
もっと良い列車にも乗ったがね…普段はもう一人給仕がいるのだ。
We'll see how the one caterer does preparing my meal. It's my favourite, whole roast Grookiva, and that's not particularly hard to prepare, so...
残った給仕一人が私の食事をどう用意するか見ものだな。私の好物、Grookiva の丸焼きだ。特に難しい料理でもないのだから…
Ugh. Then leave me to my book in peace, please.
はあ。では静かに本を読ませてくれたまえ。
...Oh, Harvin, GODDAMNIT HARVIN... We're NOT gettin' let off the hook for this one! We're SCREWED.
…ああ、Harvin、この野郎 Harvin…今度ばかりは見逃してもらえねえ！俺たちは終わりだ。
...God Maury, with a messup this bad, they'll send us to Deraj for sure! You know what they do to people in Deraj!!!
…なんてこった Maury、こんな大失態じゃ絶対 Deraj 送りだ！Deraj で何されるか知ってるだろ！！！
This is YOUR fault, ya idiot! Where the hell were YOU when I was takin' a nap?
お前のせいだぞ、このバカ！俺が昼寝してる間、お前はどこにいやがった？
Yeah? What were YOU doing napping on the job? What else was I supposed to do when I needed the bathroom?
はあ？勤務中に昼寝してるお前こそ何なんだよ？便所に行きたかったんだから、しょうがねえだろ？
If we catch the perpetrator, we'll be... redeemed! Yeah!
犯人を捕まえりゃ、俺たちは…名誉挽回だ！そうだ！
Good idea, but how the hell're we gonna catch them? That sounds... hard.
いい考えだけど、どうやって捕まえるんだよ？それって…難しそうだぞ。
Ye're under arrest for the murder of General Levi, punk!
Levi 将軍殺害の容疑で逮捕だ、このチンピラ！
Evidence? Heh. They'll believe it - ye're suspicious-lookin', and have some odd tools on yer person. Don't think we haven't seen 'em.
証拠？へっ、みんな信じるさ――お前は怪しい見た目だし、妙な道具を持ち歩いてる。見てねえと思うなよ。
Yeah, what region are you from, anyway? The Secret {p} Civilization? Ha! NOBODY goes around dressed like you.
そうだ、そもそもどこの地域の出だよ？{p} の秘密文明か？ハッ！そんな格好で歩くやつはいねえよ。
Hey! You can't just accuse them without evidence! That's not fair!
おい！証拠もなしに決めつけるなんてできないだろ！不公平だ！
Do ya wanna be put down as an accomplice in the murder? Shut yer trap!
殺しの共犯として扱われてえのか？黙ってろ！
But- but they were asleep the entire time! I saw it!
で、でも、その人はずっと寝てたんだ！俺が見てた！
...Egh... Fine... Tell ya what. New idea.
