よし、しっかりしろ、Maripe！今は少し休む時だ…深呼吸―あ、やあ！
Uh, I...I need a minute, eheh. How about...you, uh, talk to everyone else, first, and just...yeah?
あー、僕…ちょっと時間がほしいな、えへへ。先に…えっと、みんなと話してきたら、どう？
I'd say I barely recognize the place after all the renovations...but honestly, it feels like I'm right at home, like I'm that little fox kit I used to be.
改装ですっかり見違えました…でも正直、まるで我が家にいるような、昔の小さな子狐に戻ったような気分です。
Maripe tried to talk you up like you did all the work! I practically had to pry a confession out of him that you just came in at the end to help with the finishing touches.
Maripe ったら、全部あなたがやったみたいに持ち上げるんですよ！最後に仕上げを手伝っただけだと白状させるのに、ほとんど力ずくでした。
He's always been a humble sort, but I think that just shows his gratitude. And believe me, I'm grateful to you as well! I think you gave him the kick he needed.
昔から謙虚な子ですが、それこそ感謝の表れでしょう。私もあなたに感謝していますよ！彼に必要な一押しをしてくれたと思います。
Ohhhohoho that's the spot. Man...I never knew what I was missing. Sort of an old style name, Pishlas, but...
おおおほほ、そこそこ。いやあ…こんなにいいものを知らなかったなんて。Pishlas って古風な名前だけど…
Phew. I'm definitely going to be coming back here again. A long day of Liff hunting, then a long night's soak... Oh, that sounds like a satisfying routine...
ふう、絶対また来るぞ。一日 Liff を狩って、夜は長湯…ああ、最高の日課だな…
Maripe, hm. That boy has done good. Certainly couldn't have done better myself, at my age. He's got an eye for carpentry, for decoration, for the respect of his ancestors...
Maripe か、ふむ。あの子はよくやったよ。わしがあの歳でも、これ以上はできなかったね。大工の目も、飾り付けの目も、先祖への敬意もある…
And heck, he's even got free towels provided! I'll be a regular from now on, that's for sure! Hope he's prepared for daily business!
それに、なんとタオルまで無料だよ！これからは常連になるね、間違いない！毎日の商売の覚悟はできてるかね！
Wow... I'll have to tell Timot what he's missing out on. This is fantastic. Perfect view, perfect water, perfect service...
わあ…Timot に何を逃したか教えてやらなきゃ。最高だ。完璧な景色、完璧なお湯、完璧なもてなし…
Family concerns are definitely more important than a warm bath, but... I'll have to share some leaves with him, buy his ticket for next time. He deserves a free soak.
家族のことは温かい風呂より大事に決まってるけど…茶葉を分けて、次の分の券を買ってやろう。あいつにはタダで浸かる資格がある。
Ahhh, that hits the spot... Youngster, do yourself a favor- never get as old as I am. {~} years, I've got...and this... Goodbye, aches, my dear old enemies...
ああ、たまらん…若いの、悪いことは言わん、わしほど歳を取るな。{~} 年も生きてきて…これは…さらば痛みよ、わが旧敵よ…
It's heavenly to feel them wash away in the water, but boy would I love to not creak when I sit down to begin with. Good on you for helping out, by the way- especially for a tourist!
湯に流されていくのは極楽じゃが、そもそも座る時に体がきしまんでくれたらのう。ところで手伝ってくれてありがとうよ―観光客なのに感心じゃ！
After the community notice board got vandalized so badly a couple years ago, I thought not to trust it again. I'm quite glad I broke with that and gave it a look now.
数年前に地域の掲示板がひどく荒らされてから、もう信用しないと決めていたんだ。今回は破って見てみてよかったよ。
Have you seen the owner of the springs, by the way? He's had a few foxes around him all day- normally, they're not the ones doing the chasing like that!
ところで、温泉の主人を見たかい？一日中狐が何匹かついて回ってるんだ―普通、狐はあんなふうに追いかけたりしないのに！
Oh, it's lovely to be back. Having visited this place as a teenager, it had always saddened me that it closed. My heart really does go out to Maripe's mother.
ああ、戻ってこられて嬉しいわ。十代の頃に来たことがあって、閉まってしまったのがずっと悲しかったの。Maripe のお母さんには本当に同情するわ。
Honestly, if the Sovereign can manage all his business, his father should've been able to keep up. But either way, Maripe has outdone himself- and the Auburn Amaretto is such a fine vintage!
正直、君主様にあれだけの仕事ができるなら、Maripe のお父さんも続けられたはずよ。とにかく Maripe は見事にやり遂げたわ―この Auburn Amaretto、いい年代物ね！
I've enough years on me to remember how Maripe's grandparents used to run this place. Maripe has outdone himself- this is, at barest minimum, up to their standard. No one can say otherwise.
Maripe さんの祖父母がここを営んでいた頃を覚えている歳です。Maripe さんは見事でした―少なくとも、お二人の水準には達しています。誰も否定できません。
It always was something of a...blemish, on his family's name, this place. I understand his mother fell ill, and that's certainly no one's fault, but abandoning a family business for any reason...
この場所は、ご家族の名に付いた…汚点のようなものでした。お母様が病気になったのは誰のせいでもありませんが、理由はどうあれ家業を放り出すのは…
People judged them all, whether they realized it or not. Hopefully now with Pishlas open, that will end. It feels as if a cloud has lifted, really. Hmhm, or maybe that's just the tea.
本人たちが気づいていたかどうかはともかく、人々は彼らを批判していました。Pishlas が開いた今、それも終わるでしょう。本当に雲が晴れたようです。ふふ、お茶のせいかもしれませんが。
Either way, this is marvelous work. And I can take my harvest without having to worry about disgusting cockroaches crawling all over me! So thank you for that, as well.
何にせよ、素晴らしい仕事です。それに、気持ち悪いゴキブリに這われる心配なく収穫できるようになりました！そのことにもお礼を申し上げます。
I think I said earlier- with so many different little things piling up, I just couldn't think straight. i've been stuck at 'almost done' for a while now.
前にも言ったと思うけど―細かいことが山積みで、頭が回らなくて。ずっと「もうすぐ終わる」で止まってたんだ。
You showing up, offering to take care of all the little things cluttering up my brainspace...that made this...possible! I don't think I could've done it without you!
君が来て、頭の中を埋め尽くしてた細かいことを引き受けてくれたから…これが…実現できた！君がいなかったら無理だったと思う！
It really is just like I remembered it being. Everyone getting together and relaxing, talking about whatever strikes their fancy, just letting their woes disappear...
本当に記憶の通りだ。みんなが集まってくつろいで、好きなことを話して、悩みを忘れて…
It even feels like I've got my grandparents right here with me. ...though, maybe that's just these two. These foxes have been following me all day...I hope they'll stick around.
祖父母がすぐそばにいるような気さえする。…まあ、この二匹のせいかもしれないけど。この狐たち、一日中ついてくるんだ…このまま居てくれるといいな。
It's this feeling of...a weight off my chest, but the knowledge there's a new task ahead of me- keeping up with this place. With Pishlas. It's...refreshing, I think.
この気持ちは…肩の荷が下りたけど、新しい仕事が待ってるってわかってる感じ―この場所を、Pishlas を守っていくこと。なんだか…清々しいな。
Do... I know you're just a tourist, but...do you think... Do you think my grandparents would be proud of me? For all this?
その…君がただの観光客なのはわかってるけど…どう思う…祖父母は僕を誇りに思ってくれるかな？これ全部のこと。
...oh gosh, I promised myself I wouldn't cry...a-and here I am doing it anyways. Haha... Stars, I'm tired after all this. So, so tired...but. But the good kind of tired, you know?
…ああもう、泣かないって決めてたのに…け、結局泣いてる。はは…はあ、全部終わって疲れた。すごく、すごく疲れた…でも。いい疲れなんだ、わかる？
You might need to go home soon, since you're just visiting...but come back any time. It'll be free, for you- and these should go pretty far in the {p}, I think. I just- Thank you...so much.
旅行中だから、そろそろ帰らなきゃいけないよね…でもいつでも来て。君は無料だよ―それとこれ、{p} でけっこう役に立つと思う。僕―本当に…ありがとう。
...you know...you might have a point. I've been so weighed down by what everyone might think, that I could barely focus on the work. I should try and let that go, shouldn't I?
…そうだね…一理あるかも。みんなにどう思われるかに押しつぶされて、作業に集中できなかった。そういうのは手放すべきだよね？
You know, for a tourist, you sure are generous with the help. So, I should be generous too! How's free access for life...and a personal gift from me sound? Again...thank you, so much!
観光客なのに、本当に気前よく手伝ってくれるね。だから僕も気前よくしなきゃ！生涯無料入場と…僕からの贈り物でどう？改めて…本当にありがとう！
...heh. I guess that would make sense. But...I'd like to think they would be. I really would.
…へへ。それもそうか。でも…誇りに思ってくれるって信じたいな。本当に。

So... For one thing. You get free access! For another...here's a personal gift from me! After all, you didn't HAVE to help...but you did! You'll get a lot more use out of these than I will. SO...thank you, so much!
それじゃ…まず一つ。君は無料で入れる！もう一つ…僕からの贈り物だよ！だって、手伝う「義務」はなかったのに…手伝ってくれた！これは僕より君のほうが役立てられる。だから…本当にありがとう！
You should release the Frogs at the pond in the back.
裏の池にカエルを放してあげよう。
You should head back to clean up the pools now.
プールを掃除しにいこう。
You should head back to Maripe.
Yes indeed. I'm far from the first to run the teahouse, though.
その通りです。とはいえ、この茶屋を経営しているのは私が初めてというわけではありません。
My family has always been in the business of running this place- I do believe this building has stood since the very beginning of our written history.
私の家族は昔からこの場所を経営してきました。この建物は、記録に残る歴史が始まった当初から建っていたのだと私は信じています。
Of course, it is only right that someone take in our parents' footsteps and continue the work. Not all my siblings were enthused with the job, but I've taken to it quite smoothly, I think.
もちろん、誰かが両親の足跡を継ぎ、その仕事を続けていくのは当然のことです。兄弟姉妹全員がその仕事に熱意を持っていたわけではありませんが、私はかなりスムーズにその仕事に馴染めたと思います。
It would have been unthinkable to leave the teahouse empty. After all, there have been no great tragedies preventing me from putting my attention to the work.
茶屋を空っぽのままにしておくなど考えられないことだった。何しろ、私がこの仕事に専念することを妨げるような大きな悲劇は、何一つ起きていなかったのだから。
I do hope they all have found their different pursuits to be as fulfilling as I find following in my family's footsteps to be.
彼ら全員がそれぞれの道において、私が家族の足跡をたどることと同じくらい充実感を見出せていることを心から願っています。
A good question. Mine is far from the only teahouse in the forest, after all. All of them have their own specialties... Sampling from different houses is fantastic for gaining new ideas.
いい質問ですね。何しろ、森には私の店以外にもたくさんの茶屋がありますから。どの店にもそれぞれの名物がありますし……いろんな店で味見をするのは、新しいアイデアを得るのに最高ですよ。
I bother by the most traditional methods- there's a particular type of tea leaf I grow here, of course, but my other chief brewing ingredient consists of local mushrooms.
私は最も伝統的な方法で茶を作っています。もちろん、ここで栽培している特定の種類の茶葉もありますが、もう一つの主な材料は地元産のキノコです。
Many tourists have expressed disbelief at this idea- apparently, mushrooms don't sound palateable or usable for tea, but that isn't true!
多くの観光客がこのアイデアに懐疑的な反応を示しています。どうやら、キノコは美味しそうにも思えないし、お茶の材料としても使えそうにないようですが、それは間違いです！
I think it's simply the idea that some mushrooms are poisonous that warns people away, but I assure you, if what I cultivated was poison I wouldn't be alive to provide it.
単に「キノコの中には毒のあるものもある」という認識が、人々を遠ざけているのだと思いますが、断言します。もし私が育てたものが毒だったなら、今こうしてそれを提供できるほど生きてはいなかったでしょう。
Other teahouses prefer different specialties. I have, for example, had some fantastic ginger tea from this small village by a manor...but I stand by the most traditional methods.
他の茶屋では、それぞれ異なる特産品を扱っています。例えば、ある荘園のそばにある小さな村で、素晴らしいジンジャーティーを飲んだことがあります……しかし、私はやはり最も伝統的な製法にこだわっています。
There is a tea for every occasion, so I don't believe there is a best one to choose always. However, there is a worst tea. There is...certainly...a worst tea.
どんな場面にもふさわしいお茶があるので、常に「これ」という最高のお茶があるとは思いません。しかし、最悪のお茶は存在します。確かに……最悪のお茶は存在します。
今でも悪夢を見るんだ……
I'm curious. What's your opinion on the teas around here?
ちょっと気になっているんですが、この辺のお茶についてどう思う？
I'm curious. What's your opinion on the teas around here?
ちょっと気になっているんですが、この辺のお茶についてどう思う？
Maripe sent me. He's reopening the hot springs and needs to stock the teahouse with a bulk order.
Maripe が私を遣わしました。彼は温泉を再開する予定で、茶屋に大量注文の商品を仕入れる必要があるそうです。
You should bring the ingredients back to Marseled.
Marseled の所に材料を持ち帰ろう。
Job's done- The cockroaches are dead, and I have the ingredients for you.
作業は終わったよ。ゴキブリは全滅したし、あなたに持ってくるべき材料も用意したよ。
Plenty of papers have been posted over, and there's a weathered old advertisement in the middle. Surely it's lost relevance by now, so...
その上にはたくさんの紙が貼り付けられていて、真ん中には色あせた古い広告が貼ってある。今となっては、もう意味をなさなくなっているに違いないから……
There. That should be a good spot for it. How much effort did Maripe put into the poster? It really stands out from the rest of the notices.
ほら。そこならちょうどいい場所だろう。 Maripe はあのポスターにどれほど力を入れたんだろう？他の告知とは一線を画している。
There isn't a world that exists where someone doesn't see this advertisement.
この広告を誰一人として目にしないような世界など存在しない。
You're now tracking the Lone Person at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]!
You're now tracking the Group at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]!
That's everyone! You may as well head back and join in on the fun.
これで全員だ！さあ、戻って一緒に楽しもう。
There's so many people here! It'd be a shame to not talk to a few of them.
ここには本当にたくさんの人がいる！何人かと話さないと、もったいない。
Maripe's waving in your general direction. He must've calmed down enough to talk coherently now.
Maripe が君の方に向かって手を振っている。もう落ち着いて、まともに話せるようになったんだろう。
Surely they would be. You've done a great job.
きっとそうだろう。君はよくやった。
It's really all here again. It really is. I...I did this. All my work's finally born fruit!
本当に、またすべてがここにある。本当にそうだ。私…私が成し遂げたんだ。私のこれまでの努力が、ついに実を結んだ！
Soldier! Have you been explorin' the sewers? I hope you're well prepared.
兵士！下水道を探索してきたのか？しっかり準備できているといいが。
Soldier! Good timing. We've been requestin' help for ages.
兵士！いいところに来た。ずっと援軍を要請していたんだ。
With the corrupted hordes terrorisin' the Plains, more and more people are moving to {p}.
腐敗した群れが平原を荒らしているせいで、{p} に移る者が増えている。
Issue is, a major sewer pipe's been blocked up. No wonder nobody wanted the job.
問題は、主要な下水管が詰まったことだ。誰もやりたがらないのも当然だな。
I'm going to need ya to get your hands dirty. I'll need some assistance with the blockage.
手を汚してもらうぞ。詰まりの処理を手伝ってほしい。
Here's the brief. We get in, deploy small explosives to dislodge the blockage, and get out.
作戦を説明する。中に入り、小型爆薬で詰まりを吹き飛ばし、脱出する。
We're usin' this side pipe. The larger one down the hill, well... ya don't want to stray too far into that one.
使うのはこの脇の管だ。丘の下の大きい方は…あまり奥まで行かない方がいい。
Keep your wits about you in there. All sorts of things could be lurkin'. Ready? Let's go!
中では気を抜くな。何が潜んでいてもおかしくない。準備はいいか？行くぞ！
New Quest Started: The Sewers of {p}
新しいクエスト開始: {p} の下水道
Good, ya caught up. Watch your step around this place, soldier.
よし、追いついたな。ここでは足元に気をつけろ、兵士。
Our scouts've confirmed that this area is clear, but a wrong turn could lead you into the old prison complex.
偵察兵がこの区域の安全を確認したが、道を間違えれば古い監獄に迷い込むぞ。
I... we really don't want t' end up there.
俺…俺たちは、あそこには絶対に行きたくない。
Here's a small explosive. I placed one at the blockage already, if that alone doesn't work, use this.
小型爆薬だ。詰まりにはもう一つ仕掛けてある。それで駄目なら、これを使え。
柱がひどく不安定なようだ…
Ah, you're alive! Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.
ああ、生きていたか！汚水の量を甘く見ていたようだ。
... ah. This sewer has some history, y'know. Back durin' the {p} Raids, they used to hide civilians here, in the old prison.
…ああ。この下水道には歴史があるんだ。{p} 襲撃の時代、古い監獄に市民を匿っていた。
Let's get out of here. D'you still have the explosive I gave you?
ここを出よう。渡した爆薬はまだあるか？
Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, the {p} citizens are going to be happy.
ふう！最初の爆発で管が通ったようだ。{p} の住民も喜ぶだろう。
... I don't know exactly what's in there, soldier.
…中に何がいるのか、俺にもよくわからん、兵士。
I can't stop you from explorin' the dungeon, but I recommend you gear up first.
ダンジョンに挑むのは止めないが、先に装備を整えることを勧める。
Legend has it that Bob, the legendary warrior, was born in 'em durin' a raid on {p}.
伝説の戦士 Bob は、{p} が襲撃された時にあの中で生まれたという話だ。
His mother died in childbirth, but some people say she lay down there for years. Rotting. Waiting.
母親は出産で死んだが、何年もあそこに横たわっていたと言う者もいる。腐りながら。待ちながら。
But that's just a story! Thanks for your help, soldier, an' good luck.
まあ、ただの噂だ！助かったぞ、兵士。幸運を。
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の中尉が助けを求めている。
Enter the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the blockage.
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] から下水道に入り、詰まりを見つける。
Explore the sewer and find the blockage.
下水道を探索し、詰まりを見つける。
Anyway, I've found the blockage. It's right up ahead.
ともかく、詰まりを見つけた。すぐこの先だ。
Find a way to fix the blockage.
詰まりを解消する方法を見つける。
Find a way out of the spooky sewer.
不気味な下水道から出る方法を見つける。
I lost you for a bit back there. It's lucky we found each other, to be honest.
さっきは一時はぐれたな。正直、また会えたのは運が良かった。
I lost you for a bit back there. 's lucky we found each other, t' be honest.
さっきは一時はぐれたな。正直、また会えたのは運が良かった。
Sometimes... sometimes it wasn't enough. Some say there are still... things roaming there. Left over from the slaughters.
時には…時にはそれでも足りなかった。今もあそこを…何かがうろついていると言う者もいる。虐殺の名残がな。
Good, let's use it on this wall, it looks like we can break right through...
よし、この壁に使おう。そのまま突き破れそうだ…
And count yourself lucky we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some of the stories...
それに、中で厄介なものに出くわさなかったのは運が良かったと思え。噂の中には…
Did you feel like there was
何かがいるような気がしなかったか
An' count yourself lucky that we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some o' the stories...
それに、中でたいして厄介なものに出くわさなかったのは運がよかったと思え。噂の中には…
... I don't exactly know what's in there, soldier.
…中に何がいるのか、俺にもよくわからん、兵士。
See the blood on the ground? That stuff is fresh. Follow it, see where it leads, and hunt that beast before it does something terrible!
地面の血が見えるか？まだ新しい。たどって行き先を突き止めて、ひどいことをする前にその獣を狩ってくれ！
The blood trail ought to lead you to wherever the beast went. Hunt that thing down for us all!
その血の跡をたどれば、獣の行き先がわかるはずだ。みんなのために仕留めてくれ！
If you are done fixing my house, it looks like there're tracks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
家の修理が終わったなら、東の方に足跡があるようじゃ…でかい足跡がな。追跡の幸運を、気をつけてな！
Looks like there's tracks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
東の方に足跡があるようじゃ…でかい足跡がな。追跡の幸運を、気をつけてな！
Aah, there's so many people hurt already, don't make it worse, please!
ああ、もうこんなに怪我人がいるの、これ以上悪くしないで！
Ugh, think Rileen! You have the herbs, what else goes into those poultices...
もう、考えて Rileen！薬草はある、湿布に他に何が要る…
She just keeps worrying over what she can do. Seems like getting the oil might help her calm down.
彼女は自分に何ができるかを気にし続けている。油を手に入れれば落ち着く助けになるかもしれない。
She's still freaking out. She mentioned needing [{~} Salmon Oil] for medicine, and a pond out back full of fish...
彼女はまだ慌てている。薬のために [{~} Salmon Oil] が必要だと言っていた。それに裏手に魚でいっぱいの池があるとも……
I think it went into the cave east of here. Go for it! Stop that thing before it causes any more damage!
たぶんここの東の洞窟に入っていった。行って！これ以上被害が出る前にあれを止めて！
Talk to Dereg in his house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の家にいる Dereg と話す。
Oh, you look tough. You must be one of those humans I keep hearing about, right? People talk about your kind all the time.
おっ、強そうだな。噂の人間ってやつだろ？みんなしょっちゅうお前らの話をしてるぜ。
You know, that you're all scrappers. Tough as nails, and willing to kill all sorts of beasts, you know?
ほら、お前らは喧嘩屋だってな。釘みたいに頑丈で、どんな獣でも平気で殺すんだろ？
I think you know what I'm getting at. I saw some massive thing lumbering around the swamp one night! Tall as the trees, it was.
言いたいことはわかるだろ。ある晩、沼をのしのし歩くデカいのを見たんだ！木くらいの背丈だった。
I couldn't make out the details, but if its size was any indication, it could just step over the {p} walls and wreck the whole town!
細かいとこは見えなかったが、あの大きさなら {p} の壁をまたいで町ごと壊しちまう！
Of course, there's so many scam artists around here trying to sell anti-monster underwear or whatever that no one believes me.
もちろん、この辺じゃ怪物よけの下着だの何だのを売る詐欺師だらけで、誰も信じちゃくれない。
So, that means it's up to you! Ehm, supposing that you're willing to help out, at least... The one thing I know for sure is that it was eating something.
だから、お前の出番だ！えー、手伝ってくれるならだけどな…確かなのは、そいつが何かを食ってたってことだ。
Follow the trail of blood left by the beast.
獣が残した血の跡をたどる。
Oh, this is such a mess! And my axe is busted, too...how am I going to get this fixed?!
ああ、めちゃくちゃだ！しかも斧も壊れた…どうやって直せっていうんだ？！
I can't pay for- AAAH! H-Human! What do you want?! Not a good time!
払えな―うわあああ！に、人間！何の用だ？！今は取り込み中だ！
Something destroyed my cow pen and wrecked up my entire farm!
何かに牛小屋を壊されて、農場ごとめちゃくちゃだ！
And they were solid, good-quality Willow, too...uff...
しかも頑丈な上等の Willow 材だったのに…はあ…
Wait, what? You're hunting the thing? Well, that's fine and dandy, but do you think you could help here first?
待て、何？そいつを狩ってるのか？結構なこった、でも先にこっちを手伝ってくれないか？
I have an idea of where it went, so...you scratch my back, I scratch yours?
行き先に心当たりはある、だから…持ちつ持たれつでどうだ？
Okay, this can work, this can work! I have to figure out how to fix this, and some of my cows ran off in a panic.
よし、これならいける、いける！直し方を考えなきゃならないし、牛が何頭か慌てて逃げちまった。
So, you can take care of them while I re-plan my fencing. Simple enough, right?
俺が柵の計画を練り直す間、牛の件を頼む。簡単だろ？
Three of my cows ran off. Look around the farm for them. They were eating, so look for fallen wheat on the ground!
牛が三頭逃げた。農場の周りを探してくれ。餌を食ってたから、地面に落ちた小麦を目印にしろ！
Go on, hop to it! I'm waiting for you right here!
さあ、急げ！俺はここで待ってる！
Deal with the three escaped cows near the house and in the cave under the farm.
家の近くと農場の下の洞窟で、逃げた三頭の牛に対処する。
Oh, back aleady? I haven't even finished my stuff, where are the cows?
お、もう戻ったのか？こっちはまだ終わってないぞ、牛はどこだ？
...eheh. You. You're. This is a joke, right? We're having a chuckle?!
…へへ。お前。お前それ。冗談だよな？笑うとこだよな？！
WE'RE JOKING, RIGHT?! FOR THE LOVE OF ALL THAT'S HOLY TELL ME THIS IS A JOKE!
冗談だよな？！頼むから、神聖なもの全部に誓って冗談だと言ってくれ！
WHAT IS THIS?! ARE YOU BRAINDEAD?!
何だこれは？！脳みそ死んでんのか？！
NO, WAIT, YOU'RE HUMAN, THAT'S THE PROBLEM! IDIOT THUGS, ALL OF YOU!
いや待て、お前は人間だ、それが問題だ！お前らみんな脳筋の暴漢だ！
DID I NEED TO SPECIFY THAT I WANTED THEM BACK ALIVE? WAS THAT NOT OBVIOUS TO YOU?!
「生きたまま」連れ戻せって言わなきゃわからなかったのか？当たり前だろうが？！
Hff...haah...hrrgh...I...I can't bellevue...bellevue? Believe! I can't believe this!
ふう…はあ…ぐぬ…し、しんじゅ…真珠？信じ！信じられない！
Uff, settle down, Tolem, settle down...you can still salvage this...
はあ、落ち着け Tolem、落ち着け…まだ取り返せる…
Alright, two things. Your new name is Idiot, and I'm changing our deal. You owe me [{~} Willow Planks].
よし、二つだ。お前の新しい名前はバカ、そして取引は変更だ。[{~} Willow Planks] を用意しろ。
You're going to help me get at least one thing around here working. You get the wood, I'll keep looking over the fencing.
ここの何か一つでも使えるようにするのを手伝え。お前は木材を取ってこい、俺は柵を見直す。
Tolem のために [{~} Willow Planks] を集める。
Oh lovely. Idiot's back! Joy of joys. Willow planks, please.
おお素敵。バカが戻ってきた！なんてめでたい。Willow の板をよこせ。
Good. Even if you've got murder on the mind constantly, you have decent woodcutting arms.
よし。頭の中が殺しのことばかりでも、木こりの腕はまあまあだな。
I'll sell the remainder of these planks to try and recoup the money for my cows you mulched.
残りの板は売って、お前がミンチにした牛の損を取り返す。
So go on, get out of here now. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
さあ、もう行け。役に立ちたきゃ地面のでかい足跡をたどれ。牛じゃなく「狩るべき」ものを狩ってこい！
Go on, get out of here. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
さあ、ここから出てけ。役に立ちたきゃ地面のでかい足跡をたどれ。牛じゃなく「狩るべき」ものを狩ってこい！
Follow the footprints from Tolem's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Tolem の家から足跡をたどる。
Oh, I'll never be able to fix this with my back in this state...
ああ、この腰じゃいつまで経っても直せんわい…
Oh, look at this...all my years of carpentry and my bad back does my poor house in.
ああ、見てくれ…長年大工をやってきたのに、腰を痛めて自分の家がこの有様じゃ。
What on earth could have done this?! It must be the biggest beast in the swamp!
一体何がこんなことを？！沼で一番でかい獣に違いない！
I was just sitting inside having some dinner, I hear some rumbling, and suddenly my house is falling apart!
中で夕飯を食べとったら、ゴロゴロと音がして、いきなり家が崩れたんじゃ！
You human folk are good with physical labor, I hear? Do you think you could help me out here?
人間は力仕事が得意と聞くが？ちょっと手を貸してくれんかね？
There's a mine just over there. Think you can get [{~} Cobblestone] out of it?
すぐそこに鉱山がある。そこから [{~} Cobblestone] を取ってこれるか？
I'll go find someone who's selling any spare wood for the roof...
わしは屋根用の余った木材を売っとる者を探してくる…
Think you could help fix my house? You'll need [{~} Cobblestone] to do it.
家の修理を手伝ってくれるか？[{~} Cobblestone] が必要じゃ。
Enter Kroac's mine and gather [{~} Cobblestone].
Kroac の鉱山に入り、[{~} Cobblestone] を集める。
Did you get enough cobblestone? I found a guy down the street selling this top-quality Willow...
丸石は足りたか？通りの先で、この極上の Willow 材を売っとる男を見つけてな…
Good, perfect. That should be enough. Though, I do have one other thing to ask you, soldier.
よし、完璧じゃ。これで足りるはず。だが兵士さん、もう一つ頼みがある。
My back's already screaming at me just from lugging the wood over here, there's no way I can climb up there and fix the roof like this.
木材をここまで運んだだけで腰が悲鳴を上げとる。こんな状態で上って屋根を直すなど無理じゃ。
I can compensate you for the trouble, but d'you think you could do some patchwork for me with that cobble?
手間賃は払う。その丸石で、ちょっと補修してもらえんかね？
Oh, you're a saint. Can't imagine why the guy was grumbling about humans... Just climb right on up the ladder!
おお、あんたは聖人じゃ。あの男が人間に文句を言っとった理由がわからん…はしごを上ってくれ！
Repair Kroac's house using the cobblestone from the mine.
鉱山の丸石で Kroac の家を修理する。
I'm sorry, but your patchjob fell apart. You'll need something like {~} cobblestone to help fix this.
すまんが、補修が崩れてしもうた。直すには丸石が {~} 個ほど要るじゃろう。
That'll do just fine, kind soldier! You're a lifesaver, really, you are.
それで十分じゃ、親切な兵士さん！本当に命の恩人じゃよ。
Wait, you're going after the thing that did this? Really?! Fantastic! That's a load off my mind.
待て、これをやった奴を追うのか？本当に？！素晴らしい！肩の荷が下りたわい。
Keep following the tracks of the beast.
獣の足跡を追い続ける。
EVERYONE, MOVE! THE BEAST IS ON A RAMPAGE!
みんな、逃げて！獣が暴れてる！
Aah, no! There were people in that house!
ああ、だめ！あの家に人がいたのに！
Wah! H-Human! Get away, there's nothing you can help with here!
わっ！に、人間！離れて、ここであなたにできることはない！
All your type does is break and hurt! You have more in common with the giant there than any of us!
あなたたちは壊して傷つけるだけ！私たちより、あの巨獣との方がよっぽど似てる！
We don't even have any medicine...
Oh, right! Fish oil...but I don't have a rod, gah!
そうだ！魚の油…でも釣り竿がない、ああもう！
There's no way I can get [{~} Salmon Oil], even if that pond out back is teeming with fish...
裏の池に魚がたくさんいても、[{~} Salmon Oil] なんて手に入らない…
Rileen のために [{~} Salmon Oil] を集める。
No, there's no time to make a fishing spear- AAH! You're still here? What do you WANT?!
だめ、銛を作る時間なんて―きゃあ！まだいたの？一体何が「目的」なの？！
W-wait, what's...is this... This is salmon oil! Ten bottles of it! You...you heard me talking?
ま、待って、これ…まさか…鮭の油！十本も！あなた…私の話を聞いてたの？
And you went out of your way to... What kind of a human are you? I've only ever heard horror stories about your kind.
それでわざわざ…あなた、どういう人間なの？人間については怖い話しか聞いたことがない。
...maybe you're not so bad. I don't have anything that I can give you in return, but thank you, still.
…そんなに悪い人じゃないのかも。お礼にあげられる物はないけど、それでもありがとう。
Wait, you were chasing the giant? That's why you were here? That...that's amazing news!
待って、あの巨獣を追ってたの？だからここに？それは…すごい知らせだわ！
Find the cave of the beast by following the footprints behind Rileen's house.
Rileen の家の裏の足跡をたどり、獣の洞窟を見つける。
Kill the beast and return to Dereg with proof of its death at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
獣を倒し、死の証を持って [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Dereg の元へ戻る。
You're back! Any luck hunting the thing down?
戻ったか！あいつは狩れたか？
What? You actually found the beast?! Heck of a hunting job, human!
何？本当に獣を見つけたのか？！見事な狩りだぜ、人間！
You wouldn't be back here if you didn't manage to kill it...which means our problems are solved, right?
仕留めてなきゃ戻ってこないよな…ってことは、俺たちの問題は解決だろ？
Heheh! That bone powder looks giant enough to me! Great job, bucko!
へへっ！その骨粉は十分デカいぜ！よくやった、相棒！
Y'know, come to think of it, I remember something that might be interesting to your sort.
なあ、そういや、お前みたいな奴が興味を持ちそうなことを思い出したぜ。
The weapon merchant in {p} researches cryptids as a hobby, and that beast seemed one-of-a-kind to me.
{p} の武器商人は趣味で未確認生物を研究してる。あの獣は唯一無二に見えたからな。
You should show him that bone powder! He might have some good gear for you.
その骨粉を見せてやれよ！いい装備をくれるかもしれないぜ。
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で何が起きているか確かめる。
I am disappointed in you Perin.
When I meet new recruits, I expect them to look at least somewhat in shape!
新兵には、せめて多少は鍛えた体を期待しているのだ！
Yet here we are... Have you even done any training since we sent you the letter?
なのにこれだ…手紙を送ってから、少しは鍛えたのか？
I have been training! I swear!
鍛えてたよ！本当だって！
Oh really, has a mentor been preparing you? Surely your family could afford one.
ほう、師匠に鍛えてもらったのか？君の家なら雇えるだろうしな。
Mentor? Y-yeah, of course I have one!
師匠？う、うん、もちろんいるさ！
They're right there! We were just about to start my training for the day actually.
ほら、あそこに！ちょうど今日の訓練を始めるところだったんだ。
So you're Perin's mentor huh? There's no other way to say this, but you must be terrible at your job...
君が Perin の師匠か？はっきり言うが、指導の腕はひどいものだな…
You certainly look fit to be a soldier though. Perhaps training isn't your strong suit.
だが君自身は兵士に向いていそうだ。教えるのが苦手なだけかもな。
So how about I take you to join the Fruman military instead of Perin?
では Perin の代わりに、君を Fruma 軍に連れていくのはどうだ？
That sounds great! Meet us near the south {p} entrance, then we will take you to {p}.
それはいい！{p} の南入口近くで落ち合おう、そこから {p} へ連れていく。
Oh, and don't keep us waiting. Or it might end up on your record.
ああ、待たせるなよ。経歴に傷がつくかもしれんぞ。
I hope you enjoy MY spot at Tericen!
Tericen の「僕の」席を楽しめよ！
Meet the recruiter near the south entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} 南入口近くで募兵官と落ち合う。
There you are! Didn't I tell you not to keep us waiting?
来たか！待たせるなと言っただろう？
Get into the carriage, we'll take you to {p}.
馬車に乗れ、{p} へ連れていく。
You don't want to miss the opening speech from the famed Sovereign Majin!
名高き 君主 Majinの開会演説を聞き逃したくはないだろう！
Watch out for the horses, they can be a bit nippy.
馬に気をつけな、ちょっと噛み癖があるんでね。
Head into the carriage and then we'll go to {p}.
馬車に乗れ、そうしたら {p} へ出発だ。
The carriage is ready to go, we're just waiting on you.
馬車の準備はできてる、あとはあんた待ちだ。
Don't keep us waiting, get into the carriage.
待たせるな、馬車に乗れ。
You shouldn't worry about Perin anymore. Trust me, I am doing him a favour by taking you instead.
もう Perin の心配はいらん。信じたまえ、君を連れていくのは彼のためでもあるのだ。
Although, he will surely be shamed by his community for not becoming a soldier, but frankly, he deserves it.
もっとも、兵士になれなかったと地元で笑い者にはなるだろう。だが正直、自業自得だ。
You must be very excited to become a recruit, I can see it on your face!
新兵になれてさぞ嬉しいだろう、顔に書いてあるぞ！
But let me warn you, the process is not all sunshine and rainbows.
だが警告しておく、楽しいことばかりではないぞ。
The training is grueling and competitive, every single facet of your physical ability will be tested!
訓練は過酷で競争も激しい、身体能力のあらゆる面が試される！
Think you're up for it? Well, I think you could manage. You'd certainly do better than Perin!
やれそうか？まあ、君ならやれるだろう。少なくとも Perin よりはましだ！
{p} is run by the esteemed Commander Ferreo. When you meet him, it's very important that you show him his due respect.
{p} を率いるのは尊敬すべき Ferreo 司令官だ。会ったら、しかるべき敬意を示すことが何より大事だぞ。
The Commander's been serving since as long as I can remember. He's probably the most accomplished man in the {p}, aside from Sovereign Majin of course!
司令官は私の知る限りずっと軍に仕えている。{p} で最も功績ある人物だろう、もちろん 君主 Majinは別だがな！
Ah, I hope you're ready, we should be arriving soon.
ああ、準備はいいか、そろそろ着くぞ。
We're here, just head on in and I'll meet you up ahead inside!
着いたぞ、そのまま中へ入れ、奥で落ち合おう！
I don't mind, but did we really need to take the carriage?
別に構わないが、本当に馬車で来る必要あったか？
Thank the Queen, I won't have to follow this idiot around anymore, now that the recruiting process is done.
女王に感謝だ、募兵が終わったからもうこの馬鹿の後をついて回らなくて済む。
Return to the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Tericen の入口へ戻る。
Talk to the Uniform Tailor, then go see Commander Ferreo.
制服の仕立て屋と話し、Ferreo 司令官に会いに行く。
This is where you will be staying until you become a soldier.
兵士になるまでは、ここで過ごしてもらいます。
Please see the tailor across from me to get your uniform, then see Commander Ferreo in the next room.
向かいの仕立て屋で制服を受け取ってから、隣の部屋の Ferreo 司令官に会ってください。
I can't let you enter until you get your uniform, speak with the tailor.
制服を受け取るまで通せない、仕立て屋と話せ。
Are you also here as a recruit?
君も新兵として来たの？
I'm Arnol, it seems like we've made it just in time!
僕は Arnol、ぎりぎり間に合ったみたいだね！
I'll let you get your uniform. We should talk after the speech.
制服を受け取っておいでよ。演説のあとで話そう。
Welcome to {p}! Congratulations on getting accepted to become a soldier!
{p} へようこそ！兵士として合格おめでとう！
You must be from the {p}. The rest of the recruits have already gotten their uniforms.
{p} から来たんだね。他の新兵はもう制服を受け取ったよ。
Your uniform colour will be yellow.
君の制服の色は黄色だ。
What is your name? I need to write it on your uniform.
名前は？制服に書かなきゃならないんだ。
Very funny... Now tell me what your real name is.
面白い冗談だ…で、本当の名前は？
Alright, this will only take a second or two.
All done, here is your uniform recruit!
できた、新兵さん、君の制服だ！
Now go see Commander Ferreo, he is waiting for you in the next room.
さあ Ferreo 司令官に会っておいで、隣の部屋で待ってるよ。
Go see Commander Ferreo, he's in the next room.
Ferreo 司令官に会っておいで、隣の部屋だ。
I see you've been given your uniform. It looks good on you!
制服を受け取ったんですね。よく似合ってますよ！
Commander Ferreo is waiting for you in the next room.
Ferreo 司令官が隣の部屋でお待ちです。
Once you are done speaking with him, you'll be hearing a speech from Sovereign Majin in the stage room!
司令官とのお話が済んだら、講堂で 君主 Majinの演説を聞くことになります！
Recruits are separated by their divisions, their uniform colours reflect this.
新兵は部隊ごとに分かれていて、制服の色がそれを表しています。
Those with red uniforms are from Auburn, cyan uniforms are from the Industrial district, white uniforms are in the Wings division...
赤い制服は Auburn 出身、シアンは工業地区、白は翼部隊です…
Green uniforms are in the {p} division, they are recruits selected from other regions based on a test that decides if they are suited for the dangerous conditions in the {p}...
緑の制服は {p} 部隊。各地方から試験で選ばれた、{p} の危険な環境に向く新兵たちです…
Since you are in the {p} division, your group leader is Recruiter Effal.
{p} 部隊のあなたの班長は、Effal 募兵官です。
{p} is the largest and most prestigious military training camp in Fruma, headed by the equally prestigious Commander Ferreo.
{p} は Fruma で最大かつ最も名高い軍事訓練所で、同じく名高い Ferreo 司令官が率いています。
Many of the most famous soldiers of Fruma have originated from here, you should be proud to be a part of our program!
Fruma の名だたる兵士の多くがここ出身です、この課程に加われたことを誇ってください！
Most recruits already know this before coming to {p}... I suppose there is no shame in asking if you don't know.
たいていの新兵は {p} に来る前に知っているんですが…知らないことを聞くのは恥ではありませんよね。
The Fruman military is composed of nine divisions, being seven regional divisions, the Constable division, and the Wings division.
Fruma 軍は九つの部隊からなります。七つの地方部隊、警邏部隊、そして翼部隊です。

Yes, you heard that right, seven regional divisions not six. The seventh being the Xima division which recruits soldiers directly from the Auburn division, which is why most people lump them together.
そう、聞き間違いじゃありません、地方部隊は六つでなく七つ。七つ目は Xima 部隊で、Auburn 部隊から直接兵を取るので、たいてい一緒くたにされます。

The Constable division has an authority level higher than all the regional divisions, and the Wings division has authority over both of them. Be careful not to step on their toes when you become a soldier!
警邏部隊は全地方部隊より権限が上で、翼部隊はその両方より上です。兵士になったら、彼らの機嫌を損ねないよう気をつけて！

Within each division is a ranking system used to separate leadership roles. In ascending order of authority; there are soldiers, captains, commanders, and finally a single general that manages the commanders.
各部隊には指揮系統を分ける階級制度があります。権限の低い順に兵士、隊長、司令官、そして司令官たちを束ねる将軍が一人です。
The Wings division has some additional positions within it, like the Gendarmes. They're a group of Wings soldiers that only operate within Aelumia.
翼部隊には憲兵などの特別な役職もあります。Aelumia 内でのみ活動する翼部隊の兵士たちです。
Don't worry, this question is more common than you'd think.
ご心配なく、この質問は意外と多いんですよ。
In about a month, if everything goes to plan, you and the rest of the recruits will attend a ceremony and officially become Fruman soldiers!
一か月ほどで、順調にいけば、あなたも他の新兵と式典に出て、正式に Fruma の兵士になります！
From there, you'll work in a group with other {p} soldiers. If you are able to impress your superiors, you can be promoted to captain or even commander!
その後は他の {p} の兵士と班を組みます。上官に認められれば、隊長や司令官にだって昇進できますよ！
Another thing that can happen if you demonstrate exception abilities is promotion to the Constable division or maybe even the Wings division!
並外れた能力を示せば、警邏部隊や、もしかすると翼部隊への昇格もありえます！
There truly is fame and glory waiting ahead of you. If you are able to prove yourself.
名声と栄光があなたを待っています。自分の力を証明できれば、ですが。
Alright, good luck on your training!
では、訓練がんばってください！
Speak with the secretary if you're lost.
You may not enter yet, talk to the commander and then enter the stage room across from us.
まだ入れない。司令官と話してから、向かいの講堂に入れ。
You may not enter yet, talk to Commander Ferreo.
まだ入れない、Ferreo 司令官と話せ。
I can't let you enter until you talk to Commander Ferreo.
Ferreo 司令官と話すまでは通せない。
You have you brought me Effal, this is not Perin.
Effal、連れてきたのは Perin ではないな。
You will have to excuse me Commander, but I did not deem Perin as fit to be a recruit.
失礼ながら司令官、Perin は新兵にふさわしくないと判断いたしました。
The boy had done no training, he would not have lasted a day here!
あの子は何の訓練もしておらず、ここでは一日ももたなかったでしょう！
I told him this myself, and while I was reprimanding him... Erm...
本人にもそう伝えまして、叱っているところへ…その…
... Had overheard our conversation and begged that I take them instead.
…この者が話を聞きつけ、代わりに連れていってくれと頼んできたのです。
Seeing that they looked more suitable than Perin, and hearing their reasoning as to why they should be a recruit, I decided to adhere to their request.
Perin より適任に見え、新兵になるべき理由も聞いたうえで、願いを聞き入れることにしました。
So you deliberately acted against the directions given to you?
つまり、与えられた指示に故意に背いたと？
Well... Yes... I-I truly apologize for violating the orders given to me...
その…はい…め、命令に背いたこと、心よりお詫びいたします…
Do not go against what you are told to do again.
Nevertheless, if what you say about Perin is true, perhaps it is for the best that he does not become a recruit.
とはいえ、Perin のことが本当なら、彼が新兵にならないのはかえって良かったのかもしれん。
Welcome to {p}, recruit. Enter the room to the right so that we may begin the opening speech.
{p} へようこそ、新兵。右の部屋に入りたまえ、開会演説を始める。
Thank you Commander! Now, let me lead you to the stage!
ありがとうございます司令官！では、講堂へ案内しよう！
Listen to the speech from Sovereign Majin.
君主 Majinの演説を聞く。
Shouldn't you be listening to a speech right now?
今は演説を聞いているはずでは？
You may not enter yet, enter the stage room across from us.
まだ入れない、向かいの講堂に入れ。
You may only enter after Sovereign Majin's speech.
君主 Majinの演説が終わるまで入れない。
There's no time for chit-chat, the speech is about to start!
無駄話してる暇はない、演説が始まるぞ！
Welcome recruits, to the start of your training in becoming a Fruman soldier.
ようこそ新兵諸君、Fruma の兵士となる訓練の始まりだ。
You have all been carefully chosen by a group of experienced recruiters.
諸君は皆、熟練の募兵官たちに厳選された者だ。
They have closely reviewed your performances in physical tests of strength and agility since you were children, and have decided that you belong here.
彼らは諸君が子供の頃から筋力と俊敏さの試験の成績を見守り、ここにふさわしいと判断した。
Do not prove to me that they were wrong.
彼らが誤っていたと、私に証明してくれるな。
Use the opportunities given to you to show us that you deserve to be amongst your superiors.
与えられた機会を活かし、上官と肩を並べるにふさわしいと示せ。
Your instructors will expect the best from you, so you must show them the best. Those who refuse or are unable to do this have no place here.
教官は諸君に最高を求める、ならば最高を示せ。それを拒む者、できぬ者に居場所はない。
Your role will be the most important in Fruma. Ensuring the safety of the population is no small task, trust me.
諸君の役目は Fruma で最も重要なものだ。民の安全を守るのは容易なことではない、本当だ。
So, like I have, each of you must prove yourself worthy of being called a soldier of Fruma.
ゆえに、私がそうしたように、諸君一人一人が Fruma の兵士と呼ばれるにふさわしいと証明せよ。
Let my words serve as motivation for you during your training.
私の言葉を、訓練の糧としてほしい。
We are thankful to Sovereign Majin for taking time out of his responsibilities to deliver the opening speech.
ご多忙の中、開会演説をしてくださった 君主 Majinに感謝申し上げる。
Now we will be bringing you to your first training session of the day, I hope you all are ready.
これより本日最初の訓練へ案内する、皆、準備はいいな。
Each of you will be separated into groups depending on your division. For each challenge, your group will be paired with another group.
諸君は所属部隊ごとに班分けされる。試練ごとに、各班は別の班と組むことになる。
The leaders of each region grouping will be the recruiter who originally sent you the invitation letter.
各地方の班長は、諸君に招待状を送った募兵官が務める。
They will be the ones leading you to where you're supposed to be for the first couple of days here, following an assigned schedule.
最初の数日は、彼らが決められた日程に従い、諸君を所定の場所へ導く。
You are expected to be at your designated area, on time and ready.
指定の場所に、時間通り、準備を整えて来ること。
However, if for whatever reason you get lost, go to the secretary at the main lobby desk and she will tell you where to go.
だが、何らかの理由で迷ったら、ロビーの受付の秘書に聞け、行き先を教えてくれる。
Now, go convene with your recruiters in the main room to your left, then they will take you to your first training session.
では、左の大部屋で募兵官と合流せよ。彼らが最初の訓練へ連れていく。
That was a pretty good speech, I was a bit nervous, but now I am ready to start the training!
いい演説だったね。少し緊張してたけど、これで訓練を始める準備ができたよ！
I'm Arnol, I come from the nobel {p} Tasa family, Fruma has done so much for us, so I am ready to help her.
僕は Arnol、{p} の名家 Tasa 家の出なんだ。Fruma には恩があるから、力になりたいんだ。
I'm glad that you're from the {p}. That means we're in the same group!
君も {p} 出身でよかった。同じ班ってことだね！
How about you and I stick together during our training?
訓練の間、一緒に行動しない？
My family tells me that recruits often end up very... competitive...
家族が言うには、新兵同士ってすごく…張り合うらしくて…
So I think we can both benefit from sticking together, and watching each others' backs.
だから一緒にいて、互いの背中を守れば、お互いのためになると思うんだ。
Anyways, we should head to our group's leader, I think his name is Effal?
とにかく、班長のところへ行こう。名前は Effal だったかな？
Talk to Recruiter Effal then head to the challenge room at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Effal 募兵官と話し、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] の試練の間へ向かう。
Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
こんにちは新兵さん！何かお困りですか？
After corresponding with you recruiter, head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room then go down the stairs on the right.
募兵官と合流したら、次の部屋に入ってすぐ正面の部屋へ進み、右の階段を下りてください。
From there, head into the challenge room your team leader told you about.
そこから、班長に言われた試練の間に入ってください。
Good luck on your first challenge, I believe in you!
最初の試練、がんばって、応援してます！
Good luck with your training, recruit. But I'll warn you, Commander Ferreo is no pushover.
訓練がんばれよ、新兵。だが言っておく、Ferreo 司令官は甘くないぞ。
Do you need help with something recruit? Your team leader is Recruiter Effal, go see him for instructions.
何か用ですか新兵さん？あなたの班長は Effal 募兵官です、指示は彼に。
You know it's not too late to turn back. You risk losing more than just your pride here.
今なら引き返せるぞ。ここで失うのはプライドだけじゃないかもしれない。
Definitely not going to happen. After hearing that speech from Sovereign Majin, I feel like I could take on the entire resistance!
絶対にありえない。君主 Majinの演説を聞いたら、レジスタンス全部を相手にできる気がする！
Are you nervous like me? We're about to start the training and I still don't feel ready.
君も私みたいに緊張してる？もう訓練が始まるのに、まだ心の準備ができてないの。
I shouldn't worry, if anything goes wrong, I know Recruiter Alena will be there to help.
心配しなくていいよね、何かあっても Alena 募兵官が助けてくれるもの。
But at the same time, It's hard not to be scared...
でもやっぱり、怖いものは怖い…
Ugh... How did Arnol end up here?...
はあ…なんで Arnol がここにいるの？…
That speech from Sovereign Majin was amazing...
君主 Majinの演説、素晴らしかった…
I was almost brought to tears... I wish with all my heart that I may serve under him one day!
泣きそうになったわ…いつかあの方の下で仕えたいと心から願ってる！
Sorry, but I'm not your team leader, since your in the {p} group, your team leader is uhmm... Ah, it's Recruiter Effal.
悪いが班長は私じゃない。{p} 班だから、班長は、ええと…ああ、Effal 募兵官だ。
I'm so glad to finally be out of the Roughworks. Although, after the training, we will have to go back...
やっと Roughworks を出られてうれしい。訓練が終わったら戻らなきゃだけど…
I figured you'd be used to it after spending your whole life living there.
一生あそこに住んでたんだから、慣れてると思ってた。
I think Holger is just impressed by the luxuries of the {p}. I'd imagine even the slums here are fancier than the Roughworks.
Holger は {p} の贅沢さに圧倒されてるだけだろ。ここのスラムだって Roughworks より上等そうだし。
Excuse me, Ezero sir, is it true the soldiers around here call Commander Ferreo 'The Iron Commander'?
すみません Ezero 殿、この辺の兵士が Ferreo 司令官を「鉄の司令官」と呼ぶって本当ですか？
I believe he used to go by that nickname in his younger years, he was quite the fearsome leader.
若い頃はそのあだ名で呼ばれていたらしい、なかなか恐ろしい指揮官だったそうだ。
You should be careful not to get on his bad side... The last guy that did got exiled to Wynn...
機嫌を損ねないよう気をつけろよ…最後にそうした奴は Wynn に追放された…
ほ、本当ですか？何をしたんです？…
Heh, I'm just messing with oyu kid, you don't have to worry about him, he's softened up a lot over the years.
へへ、からかっただけだ坊主、心配いらん、年を重ねてずいぶん丸くなったよ。
I am not your team leader. Go find Recruiter Effal, the person wearing the same coloured clothes as you.
私は班長ではない。Effal 募兵官を探せ、君と同じ色の服を着た者だ。
Shouldn't be too hard to do, I'd think.
そう難しくはないだろう。
Alright, time to put these skills to use! Are you ready for this, Katze?
よし、腕の見せどころだ！準備はいいか、Katze？
I'm ready! Let's show everyone we're the best!
いいよ！私たちが一番だってみんなに見せよう！
Are you from the {p}? I recognize everyone in that group except you, strange...
{p} 出身か？あの班は全員知ってるが、君だけは知らない。妙だな…
Well, just a word of advice, be careful when picking your friends, it means everything here.
まあ、一つ忠告だ。友人は慎重に選べ、ここではそれがすべてだ。
If you know the right people, you can climb the ranks quickly. But you must also have to have the abilities to go along with it of course.
然るべき人脈があれば、すぐに出世できる。もちろん、それに見合う実力も必要だがな。
You look lost, don't worry, I can help you! Go find Recruiter Effal, he's wearing a yellow headband and is near the center of the room.
迷ってるみたいね、大丈夫、手伝うよ！Effal 募兵官を探して、黄色いハチマキで部屋の中央あたりにいるわ。
How do you feel about being accepted into the {p} division? I am pretty excited about it, glad Recruiter Olissy noticed my value.
{p} 部隊に選ばれてどう？私はけっこうわくわくしてる、Olissy 募兵官が私の価値に気づいてくれてうれしい。
As someone from Auburn, I'm a bit unsure still, but the recruiters know what they are doing, so I will trust their judgement.
私は Auburn 出身だから、まだ少し不安。でも募兵官たちは分かってやってるはずだし、判断を信じる。
I don't know much about the {p} either, but I guarantee we will be ready for whatever is in store for us there!
私も {p} のことはよく知らないけど、何が待っていても準備万端で臨むって約束する！
I'm not the person you're looking for, go see Recruiter Effal.
私は探してる相手じゃない、Effal 募兵官のところへ行け。
I have spent nearly my entire life training to become a soldier. I wonder how many other recruits here could say the same.
兵士になるため、ほぼ生涯を訓練に費やしてきた。同じことを言える新兵がここに何人いるだろうか。
The Fruman military is in somewhat of a dire state right now, with resistance attacks becoming more brazen than seemingly ever.
Fruma 軍は今、かなり苦しい状況にある。レジスタンスの攻撃はかつてないほど大胆になっている。
The duty will fall to us to return things back to normalcy. I am up to the task, and I hope you are too.
事態を正常に戻す務めは我々に回ってくる。私は務まる。君もそうであってほしい。
Oh hey, you're from the {p}! I'm from Aelumia but I grew up in {p}.
おっ、{p} 出身なんだ！僕は Aelumia 生まれだけど、{p} 育ちなんだ。
I was assigned to the Wings group though, I'm a bit worried about meeting those expectations...
でも翼班に配属されてさ、期待に応えられるかちょっと不安なんだ…
Heh, Oh well, that's what training is for, right?
へへ、まあいいか、そのための訓練だよね？
There you are. Didn't I tell you? Ah, never mind...
来たか。言っただろう？ああ、もういい…
Listen, remember that talk we had with Ferreo, how about that just stays between us ok?
いいか、Ferreo とのあの話は、私たちだけの秘密だ、いいな？
I better not see you gossiping to other recruits about it, that would make me very upset!
他の新兵に言いふらしているのを見たら、ただではおかんぞ！
The first test for our group is the shield challenge, everyone follow my lead.
我が班の最初の試験は盾の試練だ、全員私についてこい。
This area is only for soldiers and injured recruits, and well... You don't look injured.
ここは兵士と負傷した新兵専用だ、そして…君はけがをしているようには見えないな。
Sorry recruit, only soldiers are allowed to enter this area.
すまないが新兵、ここは兵士しか入れない。
Welcome recruits to the shield challenge.
新兵諸君、盾の試練へようこそ。
Defense is one of the most important aspects of combat. You should not expect yourself to be able to dodge every incoming attack.
防御は戦闘で最も重要な要素の一つだ。あらゆる攻撃をかわせるなどと思わないことだ。
A shield can be an incredibly useful tool for a soldier, but holding them up constantly can often interfere with your mobility.
盾は兵士にとって非常に役立つ道具だが、常に構えていると機動力を損なうことが多い。
Knowing when to hold up your shield to defend yourself against incoming arrows or attackers, is thus, a vital skill to learn.
ゆえに、飛んでくる矢や敵に対していつ盾を構えるかを見極めることは、必須の技能だ。
Your training today will revolve around holding up a shield against arrows that are being fired from turrets.
今日の訓練は、発射台から放たれる矢を盾で防ぐことだ。
The turrets will give an indication of when they are about to fire, however, the shields provided to you have many weights embedded into them.
発射台は撃つ直前に合図を出す。ただし、支給する盾には重りがたくさん埋め込まれている。
Most of you will only be able to hold your shield up for a second or two at a time, so you must do so wisely.
ほとんどの者は一度に一、二秒しか盾を構えられない、だから賢く使え。
I have set up a turret here that you can use to practice getting used to handling the weighted shield.
ここに発射台を一つ設置した。重い盾の扱いに慣れる練習に使うといい。
Simply stand where I am now, then click the button behind me. Face the turret and hold up your shield when, or just before, it fires an arrow.
今私がいる場所に立ち、後ろのボタンを押せ。発射台に向き、矢を放つ瞬間か直前に盾を構えろ。
Good luck recruits, I will be judging you from an overlook point. If you haven't already, take a shield from the shield rack next to Recruiter Effal.
健闘を祈る新兵諸君、私は見晴らし台から採点する。まだなら、Effal 募兵官の横の盾掛けから盾を取れ。
When you're ready to start the challenge, enter the large door behind me.
試練を始める準備ができたら、後ろの大扉から入れ。
Enter the next room and complete the challenge.
次の部屋に入り、試練を完了する。
Stop lingering around. The sooner you get this challenge done, the sooner I get to have lunch.
ぐずぐずするな。お前たちが早く終われば、私も早く昼飯にありつける。
That's it, holding up a shield against turrets? What a bore.
それだけか、発射台相手に盾を構える？退屈だな。
It seems like the instructors are basing these challenges off of the idea that we haven't done any training beforehand.
教官たちは、我々が事前に何の訓練もしていない前提で試練を組んでいるようだ。
They are wasting our time. Anyone who would struggle in a challenge like this has no hope of amounting to anything.
時間の無駄だ。こんな試練で苦労する奴に、大成する見込みなどない。
These shields are really heavy, it feels like I can only hold them up for around half a second...
この盾、本当に重いね、半秒くらいしか構えていられない気がする…
There's no point in overthinking this, I'm sure we'll both do well!
考えすぎても仕方ない、きっと二人ともうまくいくよ！
Don't worry {u}, this one is the easiest of the three challenges.
心配するな {u}、これは三つの試練で一番簡単だ。
Or was it the endurance challenge that was the easiest? Hmmm, I forget.
いや、一番簡単なのは持久の試練だったか？うーむ、忘れた。
It's your turn {u}, stand on that plate to start the test.
{u}、君の番だ。プレートに乗って試験を始めろ。
Well done, now exit through the door across from you.
よくやった、向かいの扉から出ろ。
Head to the second challenge room after you speak to Arnol.
Arnol と話したあと、二つ目の試練の間へ向かう。
You've really made a habit of testing my patience...
君は本当に私の忍耐を試すのが癖になっているな…
Your performance better make up for it. Now, follow me to the next challenge.
その分、成績で挽回してもらうぞ。さあ、次の試練についてこい。
Hey {u}, I am ashamed to say it, but things didn't go well for me...
やあ {u}、恥ずかしいけど、僕はうまくいかなかったんだ…
I wasn't able to complete the challenge...
試練をやり遂げられなかった…
I couldn't even manage to raise the shield up to block a single arrow! After a while, the instructor just told me to move on.
盾を上げて矢一本防ぐことすらできなかったよ！しばらくしたら、教官にもう行けって言われた。
I should have seen this coming... What about you, how did things go for you?
こうなるって分かってたはずなのに…君はどうだった？
Good job ! I am glad that one of us was able to do well. I'd like to learn about how you did it later.
すごいよ！少なくとも一人はうまくいってよかった。あとでどうやったのか教えてほしいな。
I'd like to learn about Beac
ビーコンについて知りたい
Good job ! I am glad that you managed to finish. We should talk more about it later.
すごいよ！やり遂げられてよかった。あとでもっとその話をしよう。
Well, maybe you just had more strength training than me. The shield was just too heavy to hold up, I don't know what else to say.
まあ、君のほうが筋力トレーニングを積んでたんだろうね。あの盾は重すぎたよ、他に言いようがない。
We should go to our next challenge now, let's hope Effal doesn't erupt at us for being late.
次の試練に行かなきゃ。遅れて Effal が爆発しないといいけど。
Listen to the challenge instructions then enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
試練の説明を聞き、次の部屋に入って二つ目の試練を完了する。
Now that everyone's here, we may finally begin.
全員そろったな、ようやく始められる。
As a soldier, you will be defined by your endurance, it is your will to carry on through the fight!
兵士の真価は持久力で決まる、戦いを続け抜く意志だ！
The terrain you battle on will never be optimal, so you must be able to adapt to it to ensure your success.
戦う地形が理想的なことはまずない、勝つには適応できなければならない。
As part of this training exercise, you will be jumping from platforms until you reach the end of an endurance course.
この訓練では、持久コースの終点に着くまで足場から足場へ跳んでもらう。
If you fall, you will have to go back to the start and continue from there.
落ちたらスタート地点に戻り、そこからやり直しだ。
We have installed jump pads on the platforms to help ease you into making riskier leaps.
危険な跳躍に慣れやすいよう、足場にジャンプ台を設置した。
To use the jump pads, simply stand on them and jump. The mechanism will detect the sudden weight loss and boost you.
ジャンプ台は上に立って跳ぶだけでいい。装置が急な重さの変化を感知して押し上げてくれる。
I've installed a jump pad in this room to the right of me if any of you want to practice before starting the course.
コースの前に練習したい者のため、この部屋の私の右にジャンプ台を設置した。
Soon you'll all hopefully be able to complete a course similar to this one but without the crutch.
いずれは皆、こうした補助なしで同様のコースを踏破できるようになってほしい。
You may enter the large door behind me to begin. Oh, and your performance will be judged on how quickly you reach the exit.
後ろの大扉から入って始めろ。ああ、成績は出口に着くまでの速さで評価する。
I'm going to take my time on the jumps. After what happened in the first challenge, there's no point in rushing through.
跳躍はじっくりやるつもり。最初の試練のことがあったし、急いでも意味ないよ。
Alright, I think I'm ready, let's sit together in the cafeteria after this.
よし、準備できたと思う。終わったら食堂で一緒に座ろう。
Yeah, it was this one that was the easiest challenge for me!
そう、私にとって一番簡単だったのはこれだ！
Just get through the platforms as quickly as you can and you'll be fine.
足場をできるだけ速く抜ければ問題ない。
What is it, do you want advice?
何だ、助言がほしいのか？
Well, I can recommend that you go quickly, but you must also be aware of your surroundings.
まあ、速く進むことは勧めるが、周囲にも気を配らねばならん。
The rest is up to you, think carefully about how you want to approach this.
あとは君次第だ、どう攻めるかよく考えろ。
I am surprised by the amount of recruits who rush head first into these challenges.
これほど多くの新兵が試練に突っ込んでいくとは驚きだ。
Why not think about your approach beforehand? They are all setting themselves up for failure.
なぜ事前にやり方を考えない？皆、自ら失敗への道を敷いている。
Find the cafeteria and sit next to Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
食堂を見つけ、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] で Arnol の隣に座る。
Not a bad time, of course, not as good as mine, but it's fine since you're still learning.
悪くないタイムだ。もちろん私ほどではないが、まだ学んでいる最中だからな。
Wow, you really took your time in there, don't worry, you'll get better... You, will get better? Right?
おお、ずいぶんゆっくりだったな、心配するな、上達するさ…君は、上達するよな？そうだろう？
It's time to head to the cafeteria for lunch with the other recruits. Follow me, I'll show you where it is.
他の新兵と食堂で昼食の時間だ。ついてこい、場所を教える。
Go through that corridor and then enter into the room on the right. Try not to eat too much, alright?
あの廊下を抜けて右の部屋に入れ。食べすぎるなよ？
It's lunch time recruit, your food and the other recruits are in the cafeteria. It's the room to the left as soon as you enter the next room.
昼食の時間ですよ新兵さん、食事と他の新兵は食堂です。次の部屋に入ってすぐ左の部屋です。
Enjoy your meal, you deserve it!
召し上がれ、がんばったごほうびです！
There you are {u}, come sit next to me so we can talk about the second challenge.
来たね {u}、隣に座ってよ、二つ目の試練の話をしよう。
The chef did a great job with these meals. They must be from Aelumia!
シェフの料理は見事だな。きっと Aelumia の出だ！
It's a shame that the lesser recruits also get to have it. I would have had them eating from a trough with the horses!
劣った新兵どもまで食べられるなんて残念。私なら馬と一緒に飼い葉桶で食べさせるわ！
I certainly don't look forward to having to sleep in the same room as the Auburn recruits...
Auburn の新兵と同じ部屋で寝るなんて、まったく気が進まないわ…
I can't stop thinking about Sovereign Majin's speech, it was just... Perfect!
君主 Majinの演説が頭から離れない、あれはまさに…完璧！
We must remember those words, especially the part about the importance of proving ourselves.
あのお言葉を忘れちゃだめ、特に自分を証明することの大切さのところ。
So, the challenges, how did they go for you?
Well! Things went well! They were a bit difficult but I managed.
よ、よかった！順調だった！少し難しかったけど何とかなった。
That's good to hear, we want to make sure everyone in our circle does well on them, so try to keep it that way.
それは何よりだ。我々の仲間は全員が好成績を収めないとな、その調子で頼む。
I hope our training gets tougher, I'd hardly call them challenges given their current difficulty.
訓練がもっと厳しくなるといいな。今の難易度じゃ試練とは呼べないよ。
We were accepted into the {p} division, it makes sense that these challenges are easier for us.
私たちは {p} 部隊に選ばれたんだから、試練が簡単に感じるのは当然よ。

Yeah, you're right, Recruiter Olissy told me herself that she sees great potential in us. We should try our best to live up to her expectations, and the expectations set for us as future {p} soldiers as well!
そうね、Olissy 募兵官が私たちには大きな可能性があるって直接言ってくれたの。その期待にも、未来の {p} の兵士への期待にも応えられるよう全力を尽くさなきゃ！
I have been watching many of the recruits, seeing how they act and communicate with each other, and frankly, it worries me.
多くの新兵の振る舞いや互いの話し方を観察してきたが、正直、懸念している。
Many of them are treating {p} like some sort of children's school, they do not seem to understand what awaits them.
多くの者が {p} を子供の学校か何かのように扱っている。何が待ち受けているか分かっていないようだ。
Of course, it is still only the first day, so hopefully this behaviour does not persist.
もちろん、まだ初日だ。この態度が続かないことを願う。
And if it does. I trust that Commander Ferreo will deal with it.
続くようなら、Ferreo 司令官が対処してくださるだろう。
Commander Ferreo has been working for the Fruman military for a long time, we're lucky to be training under him.
Ferreo 司令官は長く Fruma 軍に仕えてきた人だ、あの人の下で訓練できるなんて幸運だよ。
I hear he was offered a blessing early on in his service, back when he was still in the {p} division. He was very famous back then, everyone in {p} and Aelumia knew him!
聞いた話じゃ、まだ {p} 部隊にいた軍歴の初期に祝福を持ちかけられたんだって。当時はすごく有名で、{p} でも Aelumia でも知らない人はいなかった！
I hope I can accomplish ending up as half the soldier he was!
あの人の半分でも立派な兵士になれたらいいな！
None of my friends ended up being chose to become a recruit like I was, I feel like a complete stranger here.
私みたいに新兵に選ばれた友達は一人もいなくて、ここじゃまるでよそ者の気分。
But that's fine, we aren't here to socialize, we are here to prove ourselves worthy of the title of soldier!
でもいいの、仲良くするために来たんじゃない。兵士の名にふさわしいと証明しに来たんだから！
I didn't do too well on the first two challenges, I hope I can make up for it on my last one.
最初の二つの試練はあまりうまくいかなかった。最後ので挽回できるといいな。
Really Holger? You get access to a giant buffet and all you get is a salad and a small fish?
本気か Holger？巨大なビュッフェがあるのに、サラダと小魚だけ？
You idiot, not everyone needs to stuff their face with food like you! This is why mom says I'm the smarter one.
馬鹿ね、誰もがあんたみたいに食べ物を詰め込むわけじゃないの！だから母さんは私のほうが賢いって言うのよ。
Well who does she say the stronger one is? That's what really matters!
じゃあ母さんは強いのはどっちだって言ってる？大事なのはそこだろ！
Can you two go five minutes without arguing with each other?
あんたたち、五分でいいから言い争わずにいられない？
It's nice to finally eat something. I skipped breakfast today, I was too worried that I'd end up hurling it back up.
やっと何か食べられてうれしいよ。今朝は朝ごはんを抜いたんだ、戻しちゃいそうで心配で。
Anyways, about the endurance training. It took some time, but I figured out the perfect strategy to get through the course!
ともかく、持久訓練のことだけど。時間はかかったけど、コースを抜ける完璧な作戦を見つけたんだ！
I definitely am better at agility tests, I wonder if the instructors will take that into account when grading us.
僕はやっぱり俊敏さの試験のほうが得意だな。教官は採点のときそこを考慮してくれるかな。
How about you, did you struggle with the jumps, or finish the course quickly?
君はどう？跳躍に苦戦した、それともすぐにゴールした？
やったね！君ならきっと――
It sure was tricky, but at least-
たしかに難しかったけど、少なくとも――
Oh... Well, I guess you don't-
You are Arnol, yes? You must come with me.
お前が Arnol だな？一緒に来てもらう。
I am in the middle of eating, can't I go after I finish my meal?
今食事中なんです、食べ終わってからじゃだめですか？
You're not sitting with anyone? You're a strange one, {u}.
誰とも座っていないのか？変わった奴だな、{u}。
The last challenge of the day will be dueling, the other {p} recruits are already heading there, follow me.
今日最後の試練は決闘だ。他の {p} の新兵はもう向かっている、ついてこい。
What was that about, where do you think that guy took Katze?
今のは何だ、あの男は Katze をどこへ連れていったと思う？
No clue, but it seems like that Arnol kid was also asked to go with them.
さっぱりだ。でもあの Arnol って奴も一緒に呼ばれたみたいだな。
Whatever it is, it doesn't seem good...
何にせよ、良い話ではなさそうだ…
Go to the challenge room and receive instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
[-{~}, {~}, {~}] の試練の間へ行き、今日最後の試練の説明を受ける。
If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
昼食が済んだら、食堂で Effal 募兵官が次の試練へ迎えに来るのを待ってください。
And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
Effal 募兵官がもうあなたの班を迎えに来たなら…彼と一緒に決闘の間にいるはずですよ。
Your final challenge today will be singular combat against another recruit.
本日最後の試練は、他の新兵との一騎打ちだ。
When up against the enemy, you may find yourself in a similar situation. You must be prepared for when this happens.
敵と相対すれば、同じような状況に置かれることもある。その時に備えておかねばならん。
This test serves as a way to further gauge your skills, as well as an opportunity to show off the strategies you have developed in melee.
この試験は諸君の技能をさらに測るものであり、近接戦で培った戦術を披露する機会でもある。
The most important skill to have in a duel is patience, to know when you have an opening to attack. But of course, agility and strength are also deciding factors.
決闘で最も重要な資質は忍耐、攻める隙を見極めることだ。もちろん、俊敏さと筋力も勝敗を分ける。
Use your agility to avoid attacks, but if you find yourself unable to dodge, you must stand on guard and block incoming attacks.
俊敏さで攻撃をかわせ。かわせないなら、構えて攻撃を受け止めねばならん。
Blocking precisely as your opponent strikes may catch them off guard, allowing you an opportunity to retaliate.
相手の打ち込みに合わせて正確に防げば、隙を突いて反撃の機会を得られる。
You weapon is a wooden training estoc. The edges are dulled, so you will not need to hold back your strength.
武器は訓練用の木製エストックだ。刃は潰してあるから、力を抑える必要はない。
Your performance will be judged by me, if I see one side clearly winning over the other I will declare a victor.
成績は私が判定する。一方が明らかに優勢と見れば勝者を宣言する。
Make sure to get yourself an estoc before entering the challenge room, I will oversee the challenges shortly, so do not start until I get there.
試練の間に入る前にエストックを取っておけ。私はまもなく監督に行く、到着するまで始めるな。
Complete the final challenge of the day.
今日最後の試練を完了する。
It seems like the commander wants to see you, just look at how he's staring at you...
司令官が君に会いたいようだ、あの睨み方を見ろ…
Well whatever it's about, try not to make me look bad, ok?
まあ何の用であれ、私に恥をかかせるなよ？
I hope your talk with Ferreo went well.
Ferreo との話がうまくいったならいいが。
I'll just assume things went well, based on the fact that you're still in this room.
まだこの部屋にいるところを見ると、うまくいったと思っておこう。
Sorry recruit, there's not much advice I can give you here, I wasn't that good at this challenge during my training.
ごめんね新兵さん、ここでは大した助言はできないの。訓練中、この試練は苦手だったから。
I just could never bring myself to go all out on a fellow recruit, what if I accidentally hurt them?
仲間の新兵に全力でかかるなんてどうしてもできなくて。うっかりけがさせたらどうするの？
Ah, here's some advice! Don't do what I did, and you'll do fine!
あ、助言があったわ！私の真似をしなければ、うまくいくよ！
Dueling against other recruits seems strange to me... Won't we be working together when we become soldiers?
他の新兵と決闘するなんて変な感じ…兵士になったら一緒に戦うんじゃないの？
It's fine, I don't want to question Commander Ferreo. He's dedicated his life to protecting others, I trust his opinion more than mine.
まあいいわ、Ferreo 司令官を疑いたくない。人を守ることに生涯を捧げた方だもの、自分より彼の判断を信じる。
So, it looks like your buddy Arnol quit early, what else is new?
あんたの友達の Arnol、早々に脱落したみたいね。いつものことでしょ？
From the moment I saw him here, I knew he wouldn't be able to last a day.
ここで見た瞬間から、あいつは一日ももたないって分かってたわ。
But, if it turns out that he didn't leave, I wouldn't stick with him, if I were you.
でも、もしあいつが辞めてなかったとしても、私なら一緒にいないわね。
You don't want his weakness to rub off on you.
あいつの弱さがうつったら困るでしょ。
I would like a word with you first.
I've been looking forward to speaking with you, one on one.
君と一対一で話すのを楽しみにしていた。
I want you to remember that the only reason you're here is because I allowed you to be here, and because I see some potential in you.
覚えておけ、君がここにいられるのは、私が許したから、そして君に多少の見込みがあるからにすぎん。
If you are unable to realize this potential fully, or become more trouble than you're worth, I won't hesitate to have you kicked out.
その見込みを十分に発揮できないか、手間ばかりかかるようなら、迷わず追い出す。
So, for your sake, I hope you do well on these challenges.
だから、君自身のためにも、試練で好成績を収めることを願っている。
Step up, and the duel may begin.
前へ出ろ、決闘を始める。
Now, both of you, exit the room and take a look at your final rankings of the day.
では二人とも部屋を出て、本日の最終順位を見てこい。
Leave the challenge room and check your ranking, then talk to Arnol.
試練の間を出て順位を確認し、Arnol と話す。
That was the last training exercise for the day.
以上で本日の訓練は終了だ。
Your ranking can be found on the board over there. Be sure to take a look, I hope it can serve as motivation.
順位はあちらの掲示板で確認できる。必ず見ておけ、励みになることを願う。
Once you're done here, head up to the recruit barracks and rest for the night.
済んだら新兵宿舎へ上がり、今夜は休め。
The barracks are up those stairs in the room directly across from the staircase.
宿舎はあの階段を上がり、階段の正面の部屋だ。
What a day huh? I hope you ended up with a ranking that you're proud of.
大変な一日だったね？誇れる順位だったらいいけど。
If, like me, you didn't do well, don't think too hard about it. A good night's rest will cheer you up.
私みたいにうまくいかなかったなら、深く考えないで。一晩ぐっすり眠れば元気になるよ。
It's not as big of a deal as the other recruits will lead you to believe, trust me.
他の新兵が言うほど大した事じゃないって、本当だよ。
Could be better, but after all, training is supposed to reveal our weaknesses.
もっとやれたはず。でも結局、訓練って弱点をあぶり出すためのものだし。
Wow, that Adder guy sure is something...
おお、あの Adder って奴は大したもんだ…
I shouldn't be surprised though, him and Saldin are on a different level from the rest of us.
まあ驚くことでもないか、あいつと Saldin は俺たちとは格が違う。
I too will reach that level soon, I will prove my worth to the Commander!
俺もすぐにあの域に達して、司令官に価値を証明してみせる！
Look at that disappointment moping in the corner, I think {~}th place suits him well.
隅っこでいじけてるあの期待外れを見て。{~} 位がお似合いね。
Arnol? Well... It was only the first day. He could improve...
Arnol？その…まだ初日だもの。伸びるかもしれないわ…
What?! Oh wait... You didn't do too well either, did you?
はあ？！あ、待って…あんたも大した成績じゃなかったんでしょ？
How could I have ranked so low? I must try harder to show my worth as a soldier!
どうしてこんなに低い順位なの？兵士としての価値を示すため、もっと頑張らなきゃ！
I hope Recruiter Olissy will forgive me for this...
Olissy 募兵官が許してくれるといいけど…
Looks like brawn beats brains again, huh sis?
また筋肉が頭脳に勝ったな、姉ちゃん？
More like luck beats brains! If our training was more realistic then everyone would see that I am clearly better.
運が頭脳に勝った、でしょ！訓練がもっと実戦的なら、私のほうが上だってみんな分かるのに。
It is just as I expected. Despite it being the first day, many recruits struggled catastrophically in their training.
予想通りだ。初日にもかかわらず、多くの新兵が訓練で散々な結果だった。
Their scores will only go down from here. I doubt any of them have the will to dig themselves out from the dirt.
奴らの点数はここから下がる一方だ。泥から這い上がる意志のある者などいないだろう。
I wonder how long it will be until something is done about this.
これに手が打たれるまで、どれほどかかるだろうな。
Hey . It feels like it's been a while since we've last seen each other.
やあ。最後に会ってから、ずいぶん経った気がするよ。
It's been a long day, I feel so tired already. Heh, it's pathetic...
長い一日だった、もうくたくただよ。はは、情けないな…
I've been avoiding it because it's embarrassing, but I think you deserve to know.
恥ずかしくて避けてたけど、君には知る権利があると思う。
Regarding what happened in the cafeteria, another recruit and I were taken to the guard's barracks.
食堂でのことだけど、僕ともう一人の新兵は衛兵の宿舎に連れていかれたんだ。
They wanted the room to be spotless before the end of the day... It was a punishment for not doing well enough on the training.
一日が終わるまでに部屋を塵ひとつなくしろって…訓練の成績が悪かった罰だったんだ。
After that, they took me to the dueling room, an instructor hastily explained what to do. And, well... The duel didn't last very long...
そのあと決闘の間に連れていかれて、教官が慌ただしくやり方を説明した。それで、まあ…決闘はすぐ終わったよ…
I just wished they would give me more of a chance to prove myself. I know I can do better!
自分を証明する機会をもっとくれたらよかったのに。もっとやれるって分かってるんだ！
This isn't what I expected Tericen to be like. It feels absurd to subject your recruits to that on the first day!
Tericen がこんな所だとは思わなかった。初日から新兵にこんな仕打ちなんて、どうかしてる！
There's something I want to tell you in a more private area . Before you go to bed, talk to me in the barracks.
もっと人目のない所で話したいことがあるんだ。寝る前に、宿舎で声をかけて。
Speak to Arnol in the barracks, then go to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
宿舎で Arnol と話し、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] で眠る。
You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
今日の予定は終わりです、もう試練はありませんよ。
Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
さあ、ゆっくり休んでください。次の部屋に入ってすぐ正面の部屋へ進み、そこから左の部屋に入ってください。
おやすみなさい、ゆっくり休んで！
So how do you feel about all of this after the first day?
で、初日を終えてどう思う？
It was alright, I don't see the point in the ranking system though, we're all going to become soldiers in the end.
まあまあかな。でも順位制度の意味が分からない、結局みんな兵士になるんだし。
It's just something to keep us engaged, to make sure everyone is doing their best in the training I think.
やる気を保たせて、訓練で全員が全力を出すようにするためのものだと思うよ。
You lied to me... Don't ever think about talking to me again until you get at least {~}rd place in the rankings!
嘘をついたな…順位で最低でも {~} 位に入るまで、二度と話しかけるな！
I'm sorry! I was just too embarrassed to tell you the truth!
ごめん！恥ずかしくて本当のことが言えなかったんだ！
I-I can make up for this! Please! I don't want to be alone here!
つ、償うから！お願いだ！ここで一人ぼっちは嫌なんだ！
Are you here to humiliate me further? Go ahead, laugh, I don't care!
もっと辱めに来たの？どうぞ、笑えばいいわ、気にしないから！
I'll make you and everyone else who mocked me east their words!
あんたも、私を笑った連中も、みんな前言撤回させてやる！
I'll become stronger, stronger than all of you! I-I just need more time.
強くなってやる、あんたたちの誰よりも！も、もう少し時間があれば…
I want to apologize to you . Earlier today, when I told you my reason for wanting to become a soldier, I lied.
君に謝りたいんだ。今日、兵士になりたい理由を話したとき、僕は嘘をついた。
I didn't come to {p} out of any noble duty to serve Fruma. I came here because it was a last resort for me.
Fruma に仕えるなんて立派な使命で {p} に来たんじゃない。ここが僕の最後の頼みの綱だったんだ。
I originally wanted to become a scholar at the royal university. If I were a member of a more powerful house, I would have been accepted in, no question.
本当は王立大学で学者になりたかった。もっと力のある家の者なら、間違いなく入れていたはずなんだ。
They made me take a test to be let in, and I failed it. On top of that, they refused to let me retake it.
入学試験を受けさせられて、落ちた。しかも再受験も認めてくれなかった。
My father was furious with me, he was concerned with how I could bring honour to our house. So he turned to his friends in the military.
父はひどく怒った。僕がどうやって家に名誉をもたらせるかが心配だったんだ。それで軍の友人を頼った。
He pulled some strings, and here I am, becoming a soldier in order to bring more respect to house Tasa.
父が裏で手を回して、僕はここにいる。Tasa 家の評判を上げるために兵士になるんだ。
I am not telling you this because I want you to pity me. I want you to know why this is so important to me.
同情してほしくて話してるんじゃない。なぜこれが僕にとってそんなに大事か知ってほしいんだ。
If word went around that a member of house Tasa was forced to clean the guard barracks as a punishment...
Tasa 家の者が罰として衛兵の宿舎を掃除させられたなんて噂が広まったら…
Well... Everything my father has done for me could be wasted, and I would be an even bigger failure than before...
そうなったら…父が僕のためにしてくれたことが全部無駄になって、僕は前以上の落ちこぼれだ…
That's all I wanted to tell you. I hope you can understand why I lied to you, I just didn't know if I could trust you with this, but now I do.
話したかったのはそれだけ。なぜ嘘をついたか分かってほしい。君を信じていいか分からなかったけど、今は信じてる。
Sneak around to find information on the Fruman military.
こっそり動き回り、Fruma 軍の情報を探る。
さっさと寝床に戻れ、新兵！
So how did it go, is Verdi alright?
それで、どうだった。Verdi は無事か？
I'm afraid not Commander, his injuries are severe. I recommend sending him home to recover.
残念ながら違います司令官、重傷です。療養のため帰郷させることを勧めます。
Maybe after he regains his former strength, he will be able to rejoin the program, but it's difficult to say...
元の体力を取り戻せば課程に復帰できるかもしれませんが、何とも言えません…
To think that this damage was done with a training sword... It's... Incredible.
訓練用の剣でこれほどの傷とは…まったく…驚くべきことだ。

どうなさいますか司令官、仲間の新兵を傷つけた Adder を処罰すべきでは？

いや。これは好機だ、Strumon、逃したくはない。Verdi は帰郷させ、君の新兵は罰するのではなく称える。
If Majin wants better results, this is how we do that... Just make sure to keep Adder in line, we don't want him going too far.
Majin がより良い成果を望むなら、こうするまでだ…ただ Adder の手綱は握っておけ、やりすぎては困る。
Who is that? Is someone watching us?...
誰だ？誰かに見られているのか？…
Quickly run back to your bed at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Tell Arnol what you heard last night.
昨夜聞いたことを Arnol に伝える。
Hey, {u}, are you awake? You slept through the alarm bell.
やあ {u}、起きてる？起床の鐘で起きなかったね。
Everyone has already gone to start the training for today, I told Effal that I'd wake you up.
みんなもう今日の訓練に行ったよ。Effal には僕が起こすって言っておいた。
What! A recruit was injured so badly during the dueling training they had to be sent home?!
何だって！決闘訓練で新兵がひどいけがをして、帰郷させられた？！
It must have been an accident, maybe Adder forgot to hold back? I've heard people say that the strength of one Wings soldier is equal to three regional soldiers.
事故だったに違いないよ、Adder が加減を忘れたのかも？翼部隊の兵士一人の力は地方の兵士三人分だって聞いたことがある。
This doesn't seem right, {u}... Why would Commander Ferreo see that as an "opportunity"? What could that mean...
何かおかしいよ {u}…なぜ Ferreo 司令官はそれを「好機」なんて思うんだ？どういう意味だろう…
We have to get down to the bottom of this. How about we confront Adder during lunch, and ask him what happened during his duel on the first day.
真相を突き止めなきゃ。昼食のときに Adder を問い詰めて、初日の決闘で何があったか聞いてみよう。
But we need to get going now, I imagine Effal and the other recruits aren't happy waiting for us. Follow me, I'll lead you to the training room.
でも今は急がないと。Effal も他の新兵も待たされて不機嫌だろうし。ついてきて、訓練室へ案内するよ。
Go to your first challenge, then listen to the challenge instructions at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
最初の試練へ向かい、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] で試練の説明を聞く。
All of the other recruits are probably in their challenge rooms right now.
他の新兵はたぶん今、それぞれの試練の間にいますよ。
You should join them. Head to the endurance training room, it's the same one as yesterday.
合流してください。持久訓練の間へどうぞ、昨日と同じ部屋です。
Things aren't going to be as easy today, good luck!
今日は昨日ほど楽ではありませんよ、がんばって！
Well, it looks like we can start now that everyone's here.
さて、全員そろったようだから始めよう。
Most of you did well on the first course, so we're going to be upping the difficulty this time. I trust that you're all ready.
最初のコースはほとんどの者がよくできていた、だから今回は難易度を上げる。皆、準備はいいな。

足元をよく見ろ。このコースには偽の足場があり、注意を怠れば引っかかるぞ。

前回と同様、コースを踏破し出口に着くまでの速さで評価する。
I left the jump pad in here in case you want to get used to the feeling again. Enter the large door behind me to start the course when you're ready.
感覚を取り戻したい者のためにジャンプ台はここに残した。準備ができたら後ろの大扉から入って始めろ。
Complete the first challenge of the day.
今日最初の試練を完了する。
You realize your bad behaviour makes me look even worse for bringing you in, right?
君の素行の悪さのせいで、君を連れてきた私の評判がさらに落ちるのは分かっているな？
If I catch you sleeping in, going where you're not supposed to, or doing anything out of line again... You'll come to regret it...
また寝坊したり、行くべきでない所へ行ったり、何か規律に反することをしたら…後悔することになるぞ…

昨日順位が低くて友達に見放された…もう何もする気が起きない…

じゅ、順位を上げたら、また信用してもらえるかな？いや…僕はまだ弱すぎる…
This is the challenge I did the best on yesterday. It should be mostly the same, hopefully. Slow and steady wins the race.
昨日一番よくできた試練だ。ほとんど同じだといいけど。急がば回れ、だね。
I'm not going to rush into these challenges like yesterday, I need time to think about what I am going to do.
昨日みたいに試練に突っ込んだりしない。どうするかじっくり考える時間が要るんだ。
Took you a while to find your way here, did you get lost or something?
ここに来るのにずいぶんかかったな、迷子にでもなったか？

Effal が甘くて運がよかったな。私の班だったら、とっくに迷わず追い出している。
Enter the next room and receive instructions for the next challenge.
次の部屋に入り、次の試練の説明を受ける。
Not a bad time you had there. Keep this up and you might end up making me no longer regret letting you in here.
悪くないタイムだ。この調子なら、君を入れたことを後悔しなくて済むかもしれん。
Up next is shield training, you're still not out of the woods yet. We are expecting big things from you.
次は盾の訓練だ、まだ安心はできんぞ。大いに期待しているからな。
Well... That was a disappointment. You've been given many second chances and this is what you do to give thanks>
はあ…失望した。何度も機会を与えてやったのに、その恩返しがこれか。
If your mediocrity persists, I'll have no choice but to let you go, for both of our sake's. Now follow me to the next training room.
この凡庸さが続くなら、お互いのために辞めてもらうしかない。さあ、次の訓練室についてこい。
Hey {u}, I think the challenge went well. I managed to complete it at least, although I can't say for certain if I made a good time.
やあ {u}、試練はうまくいったと思う。少なくともやり遂げたよ、タイムがよかったかは分からないけど。

コースを始めるときの教官の言葉が引っかかって…「幸運を、Arnol…どうせ意味はないがな…」って。

どういう意味だろう？教官って僕らを励まして、訓練で上達させるものだと思ってた。

この訓練課程は、兵士に育てるより僕らに恥をかかせるためのものに思えてきた。他の新兵もそう感じ始めてるのかな…
Welcome recruits to day two of your training in the shield challenge.
新兵諸君、訓練二日目の盾の試練へようこそ。
I'll keep the summary short since I'm sure most of you remember the gist of the test from yesterday.
昨日の試験の要点は大半が覚えているだろうから、説明は手短にする。
This time, instead of three turrets shooting at you, the number has been upped to five.
今回は、君たちを狙う発射台を三基から五基に増やした。
On top of that, the three central turrets have been elevated. You'll have to aim your shield higher to block arrows coming from them.
さらに、中央の三基は高い位置に上げてある。そこからの矢を防ぐには盾を高く構える必要がある。
I've also adjusted the turret timings a little. Two turrets are now able to fire at you in quick succession, you must be ready to block the arrows from both of them.
発射台のタイミングも少し変えた。二基が立て続けに撃てるようになったから、両方の矢を防ぐ準備をしておけ。
I noticed that some of you struggled with lifting the shield on the first day...
初日、盾を持ち上げるのに苦労していた者がいたな…
Perhaps those people would like some sort of crutch to help them perform better, but I must say that no such thing will be granted.
そういう者は上手くやるための補助が欲しいかもしれんが、そんなものは与えないと言っておく。

失敗は優れた教師になりうると私は信じている。失敗したら自分を変えるべきだと、まだ学ぶ必要がある者もいるようだ。
For those recruits, until this lesson is fully learned, continued failure will be far more valuable than success.
そういう新兵にとっては、この教訓を学び切るまで、成功より失敗し続けるほうがはるかに価値がある。

というわけで、皆の健闘を祈る！まだなら、Ezero 募兵官の横の盾掛けから盾を取れ。

準備ができたら、後ろの大扉から入って試験を始めろ。ああ、練習用の発射台も必要ならまだここにある。
Enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
次の部屋に入り、二つ目の試練を完了する。
Five turrets already? Seems like they're doing things a bit quicker than usual.
もう五基か？いつもより進みが少し早いようだな。
Just don't look at it as increased difficulty, instead, look at it is an increased chance to show your might!
難易度が上がったと思うな、力を示す機会が増えたと思え！
That wretch... Looking directly at me while he talks about failure...
あいつめ…失敗の話をしながら、まっすぐ僕を見てた…
I'll make him eat those words... Maybe not today, but eventually... I'm done with letting people walk all over me!
あの言葉を撤回させてやる…今日じゃなくても、いつか必ず…もう人に踏みつけにされるのはごめんだ！
Thank you for being here to listen to me, {u}, I don't know where I'd be right now without you...
話を聞いてくれてありがとう、{u}。君がいなかったら、今ごろどうなってたか…
After this, we'll meet in the cafeteria, and discuss what you saw last night with Adder.
これが終わったら食堂で落ち合って、昨夜 Adder について見たことを話し合おう。
Heh... It seems like the instructor had a specific person here in mind when he talked about failures!
ふふ…教官が失敗の話をしたとき、特定の誰かを思い浮かべてたみたいね！
When will Arnol realize he can't keep playing pretend soldier?
Arnol はいつになったら兵士ごっこを続けられないって気づくのかしら？
Not this again... I think I can already guess how this will go for me...
またこれか…自分がどうなるか、もう予想がつくよ…

当時とはずいぶん違うが、評判はあまり変わらんらしい。ちょっとした面白い偶然だな。

よし {u}、目の前のプレートに乗って試験を始めろ。
Good job recruit, exit through the door across from you.
よくやった新兵、向かいの扉から出ろ。
Leave the challenge room then talk to Arnol and Adder in the cafeteria at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
試練の間を出て、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] の食堂で Arnol と Adder と話す。

あれは兵士のすべき振る舞いでは断じてない、私でも分かる！昼食の時に礼儀を教えてやったらどうだ。

まあ、もう段取りは分かっているだろう。食堂へ上がって食事を楽しんでこい。

あの翼班の新兵、Adder について何か知っているか？なぜ我々と同席を断った？

ああ…女王陛下…どうか訓練でうまくやれる力をお与えください。あの人たちみたいになるわけにはいかないの！

どうやって翼部隊に入れたんだ？翼部隊の兵士になるのが俺のここでの目標なんだ！

正直、よく分からないんだ。Strumon 募兵官が僕に何か見出したのかな？友達より力も強かったし、それかも。

ふむ…じゃあ Strumon 募兵官に認められれば、お前の班に入れるかもしれないのか？

いや、ちょっと違う。Strumon 募兵官が選ぶのは新兵だけなんだ。Aelumia の兵士として翼部隊に昇格したいなら、翼部隊の司令官か、君主 Majinに認められないと…

くそ…思ってたより難しそうだ…

昨日の訓練の順位のこと、Olissy 募兵官と話した？何て言ってた？

大したことじゃない、上達する時間はたっぷりあるって言ってくれたわ。私、少し大げさだったみたい…

Fruma 軍から見れば、私たちはもう試験に合格してる。訓練後はみんな兵士になるの、順位は常に上達を促すためのものよ。

そうね、低い順位は伸びしろがたくさんある証として受け止める。今日は必ず順位を上げてみせる！

君はよく Arnol と一緒にいるな。彼のどこがいいのか分からない。家名のためか？

そうなら、もっといい選択肢があると断言する。君の足を引っ張らない相手がな。

そっか…昼食を一人で食べるってこういう感じなんだ…嫌だな…
These challenges have been so difficult... I wonder if my performance will end up on my record, I hope not...
試練がほんとに難しい…私の成績、経歴に残るのかな、残らないといいけど…
Ha! What am I worried about, this is only the second day of a month of training! I'm sure I will get better before then.
はは！何を心配してるんだろ、一か月の訓練のまだ二日目だよ！それまでにはきっと上達する。

これで三杯目だ、このビュッフェは利用しなきゃ損だぞ！うっ…腹がつらないといいけど…

なあ、お前らの班にもう一人いなかったか？そいつはどうした？

え？さあ、すごくびくびくしてたし、プレッシャーに耐えられなくて帰りたくなったんじゃない？

It seems like things are starting to look better for me in these challenges! Maybe if I keep this up, I can manage a spot in the top five!
試練、だんだん調子が上がってきたみたい！この調子なら上位五人に入れるかも！

ああ、来たね {u}、さあ、Adder に昨日の決闘のことを聞きに行こう…

やあ、君が Adder だよね？昨日の順位で一位だったね、すごいよ！
and I were wondering how the duel went for you yesterday. We erm... Both did poorly on it and wanted to know how you won yours, just tell us what happened during the fight.
と僕で、昨日の君の決闘がどうだったか気になってて。僕らえっと…二人ともうまくいかなくて、君がどう勝ったのか知りたいんだ、戦いで何があったか教えてよ。
