昨日の決闘がどうだったか知りたいと？始まってもすぐには仕掛けず、相手の力量を測った。
Despite leaving myself open for attack many times, my opponent couldn't even land a single hit on me. When I grew tired of that farse, I brutally retaliated...
何度も隙を見せてやったのに、相手は一撃すら当てられなかった。その茶番に飽きたところで、容赦なく反撃した…
Even after he was yelling for me to stop, yelling "I yield!" at the top of his lungs, I continued. People like that should not become soldiers.
やめてくれと、声を限りに「降参だ！」と叫んでも、私は続けた。ああいう者は兵士になるべきではない。
I stopped after he finally finished yelling, he had to be carried out by two guards. Commander Ferreo was watching the whole time, and did not intervene.
奴が叫び終えてようやく手を止めた。衛兵二人に運び出されていったよ。Ferreo 司令官はずっと見ていたが、止めなかった。
You wanted to know how the duel went, that is how. He never should have been here in the first place, and I did the Fruman military a favour by making sure he will never come back.
決闘がどうだったか知りたいと言ったな、そういうことだ。奴はそもそもここにいるべきではなかった。二度と戻れぬようにして、Fruma 軍に貢献したのだ。
You monster... He wanted to dedicate his life to serving the Queen and the people he loved, and you took that all away from him...
この怪物め…彼は女王と愛する人々のために生涯を捧げたかったのに、君はそれを全部奪ったんだ…
The will to do something means nothing, no matter how strong it is, if you do not have the ability to do it.
何かを成そうとする意志など、どれほど強くても、成す力がなければ無意味だ。
He would have just gotten himself killed, or worse, gotten others killed. What I did was serve Fruma to the best of my ability, I am no monster.
奴は自分が死ぬだけだった、悪くすれば他人を死なせていた。私は力の限り Fruma に尽くしたまでだ、怪物ではない。
No true soldier would ever intentionally injure an ally... Let's go, this conversation is over.
本物の兵士なら、仲間をわざと傷つけたりしない…行こう、話は終わりだ。
Are you the one who told him to ask me about that? Who are you exactly?
あの件を聞けと彼に言ったのは君か？君は一体何者だ？
Come sit next to me, I want to discuss what just happened.
隣に座ってよ、今のことを話し合いたいんだ。
I expected the worst yet was still surprised by that... That fiend really did it on purpose, and Commander Ferreo let it happen...
最悪を覚悟してたけど、それでも驚いたよ…あの悪党は本当にわざとやったんだ、しかも Ferreo 司令官はそれを許した…
I suppose we should talk about how the shield challenge went. That might end up making me angrier, but I should tell you...
盾の試練がどうだったか話そうか。余計に腹が立つかもしれないけど、話しておくべきだと思う…
I started the test, confident, ready to make that instructor eat his words, show him that I am not a failure. And I still couldn't block a single arrow.
自信満々で試験を始めたんだ、あの教官に前言撤回させて、僕が落ちこぼれじゃないと示してやるって。なのに、やっぱり矢を一本も防げなかった。
He wouldn't even let me retry it, just told me to leave the room. I protested, I said that wasn't fair, but he insisted...
やり直しもさせてくれず、部屋を出ろと言われただけ。不公平だと抗議したけど、聞き入れてもらえなかった…
And what about you, how did the shield challenge go?
君はどう、盾の試練はどうだった？
That's great to hear, maybe you can show me how you did it sometime-
それはよかった、今度どうやったのか教えて――
I'm sorry to hear about that, we're in this together-
それは残念だったね、僕らは一緒に――
I-I was just wondering... No need to get-
ぼ、僕はただ気になって…そんなに――
Ah, you again... I've decided that I won't be going with you, I have done nothing to deserve such punishment, and will not stand to be treated like this.
ああ、またあなたですか…決めました、一緒には行きません。こんな罰を受ける覚えはないし、こんな扱いは我慢できません。
Don't talk to him like he's one of your servants, Arnol. Your family name means nothing here, if he asks you to go with him, you must go!
Arnol、彼を使用人のように扱うな。ここでは家名など何の意味もない、ついてこいと言われたら行くのだ！
This childish tantrum of yours will be noted. Now come with me before you start a scene. You are here to serve us, not the other way around.
この子供じみた癇癪は記録しておく。騒ぎになる前についてこい。お前は我々に仕えるためにいるんだ、逆じゃない。
Wow, I didn't think Arnol had it in him to talk back to someone like that... Anyway, are you ready for dueling? Follow me.
おお、Arnol があんな相手に口答えする度胸があるとは…ともかく、決闘の準備はいいか？ついてこい。
Poor Arnol, he's going to become a soldier and yet he still can't control his temper tantrums.
哀れな Arnol、兵士になろうというのにまだ癇癪を抑えられないとはな。
What's next? Is he going to ask Commander Ferreo if he can change his diaper for him?
次は何だ？Ferreo 司令官におむつを替えてもらえるか頼むのか？
Head to the challenge room and recieve instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
[-{~}, {~}, {~}] の試練の間へ行き、今日最後の試練の説明を受ける。
This will be the last of your training for today. Singular melee combat against another recruit.
本日最後の訓練だ。他の新兵との一対一の近接戦である。
The rules are the same as the day prior. Grab a training sword if you have not from the table and enter the large door when you are ready.
規則は前日と同じだ。まだなら台から訓練用の剣を取り、準備ができたら大扉から入れ。
I will be unable to oversee your challenges today as there is somthing I must attend to. I have asked another instructor to do so, they are waiting in the dueling rooms.
本日は所用があり、試練を監督できない。別の教官に頼んである、決闘の間で待っている。
Now go start the duels, good luck recruits.
では決闘を始めよ、健闘を祈る新兵諸君。
Enter the next room and complete the final challenge of the day.
次の部屋に入り、今日最後の試練を完了する。
Remember not to take things too seriously here. Being a good soldier is not always about winning.
ここではあまり深刻に考えすぎないで。良い兵士とは、勝つことだけじゃないのよ。
Commander Ferreo wants to speak with you, don't keep him waiting.
Ferreo 司令官が君と話したいそうだ、待たせるなよ。
Don't tell him I said this, but my brother, Robin, has the advantage over me in this challenge.
本人には内緒だけど、この試練では弟の Robin のほうが有利なの。
As long as I never go up against him though, he won't realize that, that's why I am letting him go on ahead without me.
でも私が一度も当たらなければ、あいつは気づかない。だから先に行かせてるの。
Maybe if I win against my opponent and he loses, he might be convinced that I am stronger!
私が相手に勝って、あいつが負ければ、私のほうが強いって納得するかも！
I don't want you to start the duel yet, your opponent has yet to arrive. Let's wait together for him.
まだ決闘は始めるな、相手が来ていない。共に待とう。
There you are, Arnol. I was told that you had an outburst during lunch. You will come to know that such things are unacceptable here.
来たか、Arnol。昼食時に騒ぎを起こしたそうだな。ここではそのような真似は許されんと知ることになる。
This is who you'll be dueling against Arnol. You two are friends, yes? Well this duel will surely teach both of you a valuable lesson.
Arnol、これが君の決闘相手だ。二人は友人だな？ならばこの決闘は、二人に貴重な教訓を与えるだろう。
Valuable lesson? What is that supposed to mean Commander? Is this a trick? What is the point of me dueling my friend?
貴重な教訓？どういう意味ですか司令官？罠ですか？友達と決闘させて何になるんです？
You should know better than to question the orders of your superior, Arnol. Now both of you, into the dueling room.
上官の命令に疑問を挟むものではないぞ、Arnol。さあ二人とも、決闘の間へ入れ。
あの小僧に思い知らせてやれ。
Step up, and the duel may begin. If either of you hold back, I will make you start the duel again, as many times as is needed.
前へ出ろ、決闘を始める。どちらかが手加減すれば、何度でも決闘をやり直させる。
You did better than expected Arnol. Yet the result was still what I imagined it would be.
予想以上だったぞ、Arnol。だが結果はやはり思った通りだ。
Then what was the point of this duel, if you knew I would lose! Were you trying to humiliate me further? Haven't you done that enough already?!
負けると分かっていたなら、この決闘に何の意味が！もっと辱めたかったんですか？もう十分でしょう？！
Your arrogance truly has no bounds. How many punishments will I have to give you until you start to take things here seriously?
君の傲慢さは本当に際限がないな。どれほど罰を与えれば、ここを真剣に受け止めるようになる？
You're becoming a lost cause, Arnol. Now go, there is something I would like to discuss with in private.
もう見込みがなくなりつつあるぞ、Arnol。行け、内密に話したいことがある。
Your kindness towards him is doing him no favour. Arnol must know what pain is like before he can become stronger, and your friendship is preventing that.
君の優しさは彼のためにならん。Arnol は強くなる前に痛みを知らねばならず、君との友情がそれを妨げている。
For both of your sakes, I insist you sever your bond with him.
二人のためにも、彼との縁を切るよう求める。
Leave the dueling room, then go to the barracks to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
決闘の間を出て、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] の宿舎で眠る。
Do not take my advice for granted.
私の忠告を軽んじるな。
Am I the only one who is unimpressed with these challenges? They don't seem that related to being a soldier.
この試練に感心してないのは俺だけか？兵士になることとあまり関係なさそうだけど。
Eh, oh well. At least they're kind of fun, I'll give them that. I just wish the other recruits took them less seriously.
まあいいか。少なくとも結構楽しいのは認めるよ。他の新兵がもう少し気楽に構えてくれたらな。
Well done, you kept your promise to get a better ranking! I am sure Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Olissy are proud.
よくやったわ、順位を上げる約束を守ったわね！Ferreo 司令官も Olissy 募兵官もきっと誇りに思ってる。
I used my shame from my first ranking as a driver to try harder on today's challenges. I am happy that I did poorly initially, because now I know must be constantly trying to improve!
最初の順位の恥を原動力に、今日の試練をもっと頑張ったの。最初に失敗してよかった、常に上達を目指さなきゃいけないって分かったから！
I will set the same promise now, tomorrow my ranking will be higher than it is now!
また同じ約束をするわ、明日の順位は今より上よ！
I've failed... Now I'll never be able to become a Wings soldier...
失敗した…これでもう翼部隊の兵士にはなれない…
Don't you think you're being a bit over dramatic? I think you did great, it's not like you're at the bottom of the ranking.
ちょっと大げさじゃない？よくやったと思うよ、順位が最下位ってわけでもないし。
Easy for you to say... You're already in the Wings group, you didn't have to work for anything, you were just born good! You'll never know what it's like to be a failure!
お前は気楽に言えるよな…もう翼班にいて、何の苦労もせず、生まれつき優秀なんだ！落ちこぼれの気持ちなんて一生分からないさ！
I can't believe we're done with the second day already. Enjoy being a recruit while it lasts, it won't get any easier from here.
もう二日目が終わったなんて信じられない。新兵の今を楽しんでおけ、ここから楽にはならないぞ。
You're on thin ice, Priscilla... You didn't improve at all from yesterday! What will people think if I let a weakling follow me around?
崖っぷちよ、Priscilla…昨日から全然伸びてないじゃない！弱い子を連れ歩いてたら、みんなにどう思われるか！
Please Lynn! Just give me a second chance! I promise I will get into the top {~} tomorrow!
お願い Lynn！もう一度だけ機会をちょうだい！明日は上位 {~} 位に入るって約束する！
Make it top {~}! And if you fail... I'll never speak to you again!
上位 {~} 位にしなさい！できなかったら…二度と口をきかないから！
Top {~}!? That's... Eh... Fine, I will make it into the top {~} tomorrow, I promise!
上位 {~} 位！？それは…ええと…分かった、明日は上位 {~} 位に入る、約束する！
You're not worth my time. Do me a favour and buzz off.
お前に割く時間はない。頼むから消えてくれ。
I am willing to put the incident at lunch today aside. You just need to tell me how you or Arnol discovered what happened in my duel on the first day.
今日の昼食の件は不問にしてもいい。君か Arnol が、初日の私の決闘で何があったかをどう知ったのか、話してくれればな。
I'm not easily fooled, I don't buy the made up story that you two were looking for advice.
私は簡単には騙されない。二人が助言を求めに来たという作り話など信じん。
You should take this proposition seriously. I am not the type of person you would want as your enemy.
この提案は真剣に受け止めたほうがいい。私は敵に回したい類の人間ではない。
It was a fluke, that's the only explanation of how you were able to beat me by one singular point! It means nothing!
まぐれだ、たった一点差で俺に勝てた理由はそれしかない！何の意味もない！
Right... Keep telling yourself that, but in the back of your mind you know that I beat you. I'll never make you forget that fact!
はいはい…そう言い聞かせてれば？でも心の底では私に負けたって分かってるくせに。絶対に忘れさせてあげない！
They've been at it for a while now. Which one do you think will beat the other tomorrow?
あの二人、ずっとああだよ。明日はどっちが勝つと思う？
I'm not sure... What do you think will happen if they tie?
さあ…引き分けたらどうなると思う？
I hope that doesn't happen, they would probably be up all night arguing about who's better.
そうならないといいな、どっちが上か一晩中言い争いそうだ。
Could this day have gone any worse?
これ以上悪い日ってある？
The honourable Commander Ferreo did nothing as Adder beat a fellow recruit to a pulp...
あの立派な Ferreo 司令官は、Adder が仲間の新兵をめった打ちにしても何もしなかった…
The instructors of the esteemed {p} recruit program seem to have no interest in actually training us...
名高い {p} の新兵課程の教官たちは、本気で僕らを鍛える気なんてないみたいだ…
And I am starting to doubt the idea of bringing honour to my house...
家に名誉をもたらすってことにも、疑問を感じ始めてる…
At least I'm not alone though...
でも少なくとも、僕は一人じゃない…
Sneak around to find more information on Commander Ferreo's plans.
こっそり動き回り、Ferreo 司令官の計画についてさらに情報を探る。
You found all of my diary entries, well done.
私の日記を全部見つけたか、大したものだ。
It's been so long since I've hid them, I was beginning to forget about them ever existing.
隠してからずいぶん経つから、あったこと自体忘れかけていた。
Don't expect a medal or anything, I can answer some questions that you may have about them though.
勲章なんか期待するなよ。ただ、日記について聞きたいことがあれば多少は答えられる。
It was Commander Ferreo's final insult. That's the reason I am here, as a guard in {p}.
Ferreo 司令官の最後の侮辱さ。だから私はここ、{p} で衛兵をやっている。
After I graduated from the recruit program, my average rankings were seen as too low to join a field Captain or Commander's service.
新兵課程を修了したとき、平均順位が低すぎて、前線の隊長や司令官の下には就けないとされた。
So Ferreo himself stepped up and took me in, stationing me here to waste away. I think it's some form of punishment...
そこで Ferreo 自ら私を引き取り、ここに配置して腐らせた。一種の罰なんだろう…
I'm not sure to be quite honest. Maybe I was hoping for a sly recruit like yourself to find them, and not make the same mistakes I did.
正直よく分からない。君みたいな抜け目ない新兵に見つけてもらって、私と同じ過ちを避けてほしかったのかもな。
It may have just been out of boredom though. I can't remember what thoughts were going through my head back when I hid them, after I became a soldier.
ただの退屈しのぎだったのかもしれない。兵士になって、あれを隠したとき何を考えていたか、もう思い出せない。
Deep down... Maybe I wanted Commander Ferreo to find those notes. I wonder what he would have though after reading them...
心の底では…Ferreo 司令官にあの記録を見つけてほしかったのかもな。読んだら何を思っただろうか…

I had a feeling you'd ask me that. And surprisingly, yes, I did discover the truth about Commander Ferreo's success. There is no secret. He did it all through a fierce determination to become greater.
そう聞かれると思っていた。そして意外にも、ああ、Ferreo 司令官の成功の真相は突き止めた。秘密なんてない。偉くなるという激しい決意だけで成し遂げたんだ。
When Commander Ferreo was young, he had nothing, he was a vagabond in {p}. Not living, just, surviving.
若い頃の Ferreo 司令官は何も持っていなかった。{p} の浮浪者でね。生きるというより、ただ生き延びていた。
Sometimes the Fruman Military would come to visit, and everyone in the town gathered together to see them. Ferreo saw how everyone loved and praised them for their valiance.
時々 Fruma 軍が訪れると、町中の人が集まって見物した。皆が彼らの勇敢さを愛し讃えるのを Ferreo は見ていた。
He desperately wanted to be praised and loved like that too. So he made it his goal to reach that position, overcoming the countless obstacles in his way.
自分もあんなふうに讃えられ、愛されたいと切望した。だからその地位を目指し、行く手の無数の障害を乗り越えた。
Through sheer strength and expertise, he quickly became a Wings Commander, breaking military records in the process.
純粋な力と技量で、瞬く間に翼部隊の司令官となり、その過程で軍の記録を塗り替えた。
There were rumours that he would push further and attempt to become a Sovereign, even though all the positions were full at the time...
さらに上を目指して君主になろうとしている、という噂もあった。当時は全ての座が埋まっていたのにな…
He had finally reached the level of fame and admiration that he had set out for. But I imagine the potential for even greater heights tormented him.
ついに望んだ名声と称賛を手にした。だが、さらなる高みの可能性が彼を苦しめたのだろう。
Not many know this, but just before he was given his current position, Commander Ferreo had a meeting with Sovereign Majin and The Queen.
知る者は少ないが、今の地位を与えられる直前、Ferreo 司令官は 君主 Majinと女王と会談している。
We can only speculate at what the discussed, but quickly after said meeting, Majin appointed Commander Ferreo as head of {p}. My guess is that he was punished for his ambition...
何が話されたかは推測するしかないが、その会談の直後、Majin は Ferreo 司令官を {p} の長に任じた。私の推測では、野心の罰だったんだろう…
Good luck on your training recruit. I recommend you take it more seriously than I did.
訓練がんばれよ、新兵。私よりは真剣に取り組むことを勧める。
Sorry, but I still can't let you enter.
悪いが、まだ通すわけにはいかない。
I grew suspicious of you when I heard you get up in the middle of the night yesterday to sneak around.
昨夜、君が夜中に起き出してこそこそ動き回る音を聞いて、怪しいと思った。
And somehow you were able to discover the results of my first duel... The only conclusion I can come to is that you have been spying on Commander Ferreo.
しかも、どうやってか私の初戦の結果を突き止めた…導ける結論は一つ、君は Ferreo 司令官を探っていたということだ。
For this, you deserve to be exiled, executed, or imprisoned.
それだけで、追放か処刑か投獄に値する。
But... I have been looking to challenge myself, so far the training has been underwhelming. I would like to see what a resistance spy is capable of.
だが…私は自分を試す相手を探していた。これまでの訓練は物足りない。レジスタンスの密偵に何ができるのか見てみたい。
If you can best me in a duel, I won't report you to Commander Ferreo. The first person to land {~} hits on the other shall be declared the victor.
決闘で私に勝てたら、Ferreo 司令官には報告しない。先に相手に {~} 回当てた方が勝者だ。
As a show of good faith, I will let you land the first hit on me.
誠意の証として、最初の一撃は当てさせてやる。
Telegraphed by a grunt and angry particles, Adder will swipe his estoc at you. Perfect blocking this attack will stun him, allowing you to counterattack.
うなり声と怒りのパーティクルが予兆。Adder がエストックで薙ぎ払う。この攻撃を完璧に防ぐとひるみ、反撃の隙ができる。
Telegraphed by a grunt without angry particles, Adder will hop to the side.
怒りのパーティクルなしのうなり声が予兆。Adder が横へ跳ぶ。

Telegraphed by a grunt and angry and blue particles, Adder will lunge forward and charge with his estoc. This attack deals damage twice, once at the start and once at the peak of the lunge. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
うなり声と怒り・青のパーティクルが予兆。Adder がエストックを構えて前方へ突進する。突進の開始時と頂点で2回ダメージ。最後の一撃を完璧に防ぐとひるむ。
Telegraphed by angry and green particles, Adder will continuously swipe his estoc in front of him while running towards the {u} for several seconds. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
怒り・緑のパーティクルが予兆。Adder が数秒間 {u} に向かって走りながら、前方でエストックを連続で薙ぎ払う。最後の一撃を完璧に防ぐとひるむ。
Absurd... Even after everything I have been through, I still am not strong enough...
馬鹿な…あれだけの経験を積んでも、まだ力が足りないのか…
Make your way through the vents.
We've found ourselves in a terribly difficult situation, Strumon...
実に厄介な状況になったな、Strumon…
We have a spy amongst our recruits and know who they are, yet that messenger expects us to not do anything about it until Sovereign Majin gets here!?
新兵の中に密偵がいて、正体も分かっている。なのにあの伝令は、君主 Majinが着くまで何もするなと！？
I think it is important to be cautious here Commander, if this spy is as powerful as the messenger implied... This could spell the end for all of us...
ここは慎重になるべきかと、司令官。あの密偵が伝令の言うほど強大なら…我々全員の破滅になりかねません…
Yes, you're probably right. Nevertheless, once Sovereign Majin arrives and sees that I let a spy into the recruit program... I fear that all that I have worked for will be lost...
ああ、おそらく君の言う通りだ。だが 君主 Majinが到着し、私が密偵を新兵課程に入れたと知れば…これまで築いたもの全てを失いかねん…
I will not give up so easily, nor will I do nothing while we wait for Sovereign Majin to arrive...
そう簡単に諦めはせん。君主 Majinの到着を待つ間、何もしないつもりもない…

I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
Effal を反逆罪で直ちに Wynn へ追放しろ。密偵を入れたのは奴だ、罰を受けねばならん。代わりの募兵官は衛兵から探せ、誰でも奴よりはましだ。
Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
これを他の衛兵と募兵官に伝えろ。Effal は明日までに Fruma から出ていくことになる！
Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
それで司令官、もう一つお話ししたい件がございます。こんな夜更けに執務室へ伺ったのはそのためです。
Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
昨日の計画は完璧に運びました。医師に確認したところ、Katze は帰郷させる必要があるそうです。
Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
素晴らしい。明日は Adder を Arnol と戦わせる。もはや家名では彼の弱さを補えん！
Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
司令官…本当にそれが最善でしょうか？密偵は Arnol に好意を抱いているようです。報復を招くおそれが…
Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
呪われし者一人を怒らせるのがそんなに怖いのか、Strumon？それに、その頃には 君主 Majinが到着しているはずだ、君の懸念は杞憂だ。
Commander, Recruiter, there is an urgent matter that requires attending to. Please, follow me!
司令官、募兵官、至急対処すべき事態です。どうか、ついてきてください！
Unscrew the vent, then head back to the barracks to wake Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
通気口のネジを外し、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] の宿舎へ戻って Arnol を起こす。
What is this about, {u}? Why are you waking me up so early in the morning?
どうしたの、{u}？なんでこんな朝早くに起こすのさ？
What!? I'd stand no chance against Adder! He might even end up killing me if I face him! I guess I should have expected Commander Ferreo would do something like this though...
何だって！？Adder 相手じゃ勝ち目なんてない！戦ったら殺されるかもしれない！でも Ferreo 司令官ならこういうことをすると予想すべきだったか…
If you're telling me this now, you must have some idea on how to help me with this mess. What is your plan, {u}?
今それを話すってことは、この窮地を切り抜ける考えがあるんだね。どういう計画、{u}？
Hmmm... Ok, I trust you. Let's go before anyone wakes up.
うーん…分かった、君を信じる。誰かが起きる前に行こう。
Hmmm... Ok, I'll go with you.
うーん…分かった、一緒に行くよ。
[-{~}, {~}, {~}] から Tericen を脱出する。
Escape through the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Tericen の入口から脱出する。
We're leaving through the main entrance? What if a guard spots us?
正面入口から出るの？衛兵に見つかったらどうするの？
Alright, I'll try to stay close.
分かった、離れないようにするよ。
Weird... There seems to be no guards on duty...
変だな…見張りの衛兵が一人もいないみたいだ…
これはどこから来たんだ！？
Where are you off to? I don't remember dismissing either of you.
どこへ行く？二人とも下がってよいと言った覚えはないが。
I would have thought that by now you'd both know insubordination isn't tolerated here. Neither is treason...
もう分かっていると思っていたがな、ここでは命令違反は許されん。反逆もだ…
Does Arnol know you're a spy? Imagine what his family would think, if they found out he's conspiring with the resistance.
Arnol は君が密偵だと知っているのか？彼がレジスタンスと共謀していると知ったら、家族はどう思うだろうな。
I'll let them deal with him. But you... the responsibility of prosecuting you has been lended to me.
彼の処分は家族に任せよう。だが君は…君を裁く責任は私に委ねられている。
There is no hope for you or your kind in Fruma!
Fruma に君や君の同類の望みはない！
I've never lost a duel, don't fool yourself into thinking I'd let you change that!
私は決闘で負けたことがない、それを君が覆せるなどと思い上がるな！
I won't die here! Not to the likes of you!
ここで死んでたまるか！貴様ごときに！
That's enough Commander, you're clearly outmatched.
もう十分です司令官、明らかにあなたの負けだ。
Thank you... For looking out for me after everything, even though you had no reason to...
ありがとう…あんなことがあったのに、理由もないのに僕を気にかけてくれて…
I've spent my whole life drifting, aimless... But now I know what my purpose is, thanks to you...
ずっと目的もなく流されて生きてきた…でも君のおかげで、自分の目的が分かったよ…
My purpose is to make sure that tyrants like Commander Ferreo meet their just end. It seems like this may be your goal as well.
僕の目的は、Ferreo 司令官のような暴君に相応の末路を迎えさせること。君の目標もそうみたいだね。
I must go out on my own now, I hope that one day we meet again. I promise you I'll be stronger by then!
これからは一人で行かなきゃ。いつかまた会えるといいな。その時にはもっと強くなってると約束するよ！
I was raised to believe that the cursed ones were wicked, yet you've been nothing but helpful. Seems like that was just another lie...
呪われし者は邪悪だと教わって育ったけど、君は助けてくれてばかりだった。あれも嘘の一つだったんだね…
Are you a recruit as well? You certainly look strong. I imagine you must have a lot of experience.
君も新兵か？確かに強そうだ。さぞ経験豊富なんだろうな。
I am a bit newer to this than you, but I may still be able to offer you some insights if you're curious.
私は君より少し新米だが、興味があれば何か教えてやれるかもしれん。
Well... A carriage rode me halfway to {p}, then it broke down and I had to walk the rest of the way. When I finally arrived the King himself was there to greet me and made me a recruit.
そうだな…馬車で {p} への道の半ばまで来たが、壊れて残りは歩きだった。ようやく着いたら国王陛下自ら出迎えて、私を新兵にしてくださった。
I can't seem to remember anything before that though... It probably wasn't too important, what's important is my new job as a recruit!
その前のことはどうも思い出せんが…大して重要じゃないだろう、大事なのは新兵という新しい仕事だ！
I wonder if the King will give me a promotion soon...
国王はそろそろ私を昇進させてくださるだろうか…
No... I can't say I have ever seen you before... Are you a fan or something?
いや…君には会った覚えがないな…ファンか何かか？
I didn't imagine having fans already but that's great! I'm already on the path of becoming the most famous person in Wynn!
もうファンがいるとは思わなかったが、素晴らしい！私はもう Wynn で一番有名な人物への道を歩んでいるのだ！
Waiting? I'm not waiting for anything! I'm just resting... That's all!
待つ？何も待ってなどいない！ただ休んでいるだけだ…それだけだ！
It's tiring doing so much work out there. Plus I need to give the other recruits and guards a chance to prove themselves, I shouldn't hog all of the glory!
外であれだけ働くと疲れるんだ。それに他の新兵や衛兵にも自分を証明する機会をやらんとな、栄光を独り占めしてはいかん！
You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine out there. Just because you look stronger doesn't mean I'm weak!
私の心配はいらん、外でも大丈夫だ。君が強そうに見えるからといって、私が弱いわけではない！
You're the one who should be worried... Worried about me surpassing you of course!
心配すべきは君のほうだ…もちろん、私に追い抜かれる心配をな！
But hey, we're on the same side, so let's both keep fighting out there! For the King!
だがまあ、我々は同じ側だ、お互い外で戦い続けよう！国王のために！
Thank you again...soldier. For helping us make peace...
改めてありがとう…兵士さん。和平に力を貸してくれて…
Please take a track controller before entering the rail line.
線路に入る前に線路コントローラーを持っていってください。
[{~}, {~}, -{~}] で何が起きているか調べる
This is just a disaster... I pray nothing goes awry with the recovery team.
まったくの惨事だ…回収隊に何事もないよう祈るばかりだ。
I'd never be able to live it off if I'm responsible for more deaths.
これ以上死者を出す責任を負ったら、一生立ち直れん。
But I must do what it takes to protect {p} from any more disaster.
だが {p} をこれ以上の災いから守るためなら、何でもせねば。
Atila, you're back! Give it to me straight, did they succeed? We can't afford any more losses.
Atila、戻ったか！はっきり言ってくれ、成功したのか？もうこれ以上の損失は許されんのだ。
The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble.
昇降機は竜の寝床に直結しています。いつ眠っているか分からない以上、賭けです。
The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble...
エレベーターは竜が横たわる場所に直結しています。いつ眠っているかわからない以上、賭けですね…
It's a great feat what you've accomplished. The dwarven defense system was thought to be impeccable. We'll need to rethink our security!
見事な偉業だ。ドワーフの防衛システムは完璧だと思われていた。警備を考え直さないとな！
So we truly do need to go through the vault. But with the defense systems gone haywire...
やはり金庫を通るしかないか。だが防衛装置が暴走している今…
申し訳ありません、閣下…
Think nothing of it, let's get back to the drawing board.
気にするな。一から練り直そう。
Yes, I'll get to it immediately.
はっ、すぐに取りかかります。
You there, human! What's your business here? Come speak to me.
そこの人間！ここに何の用だ？こっちへ来て話してくれ。
What's your business here? This place is off limits, the vault is very dangerous right now.
ここに何の用だ？立入禁止だぞ、金庫は今とても危険なのだ。
Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high-quality, yeah? What's your name?
おや、よく見ればその装備、なかなかの上物じゃないか？名は何という？
Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high quality, yeah? What's your name?
よく見ると、その装備、かなりの上物じゃないか？名前は？
... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're that guy who defeated that Qira woman, yeah?
…その名、どこかで聞いたような…そうだ！あの Qira という女を倒した者だな？
... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're the one who helped resolve the whole Dogun thing, right?
…その名、どこかで聞いたような…そうだ！Dogun の一件を片付けてくれた者だな？
I see, I haven't seen you around before.
そうか、この辺りでは見ない顔だな。
{u}..? I see, I haven't seen you around before.
{u}…？そうか、この辺りでは見ない顔だな。

ともかく、{p} は危機にある。手短に言うと、竜が勝手に我らの保管庫に住み着いたのだ。

街の上にある巣を見たかもしれんな。普段は我らに害をなさんが、ある日突然この金庫に入り込んだのだ。

我が友 Atila が偵察隊を率いて調べたところ、奴は卵を温めているらしい。

我らは多大な犠牲を払って卵を盗み出し、巣へ戻そうとした。そうすれば出て行くかもと…だが、聞いての通り、うまくいっていない。

普段はよそ者に頼まんのだが、もう手が尽きた。手を貸してくれるか？骨折りには必ず報いよう。
So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
手伝ってくれるのか！？本当にありがとう！決して無駄にはさせん！
You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
保管庫へは、私の後ろのこの部屋を抜けねばならん。他の入口はまさに竜のいる場所だけでな…
You have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
保管庫へ行くには、私の後ろのこの部屋を抜けるしかない。他の入口は、ちょうどドラゴンのいる場所なんだ…
The people of {p} have everlasting gratitude, soldier.
{p} の民は永遠に君に感謝するだろう、兵士よ。
新しいクエスト開始: {p} 保管庫
Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire {p}.
Atila は金庫の内部に多少詳しい。幸運を祈る、成功を願っているぞ。君の勇気は {p} を奮い立たせるだろう。
Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
そうか、縁がなかったようだな…
Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...

Find a way through the depository.
保管庫を抜ける道を探す。

Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.

う、うわあっ！！死んだものと思って、竜が死体を送ってきたのかと！
You really got it!? Hurry then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe {p} can finally be rid of its woes...

She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.

君は英雄だ！竜が街から去り、{p} はもう恐れて暮らさずに済む。

報酬を用意しておいた。{p} の民は君の貢献を末永く忘れんだろう。
Tell me what I should know.
知っておくべきことを教えて。
So you've taken the job. Good luck to you in there.
その仕事に就いたんですね。そこで頑張って。
What would you like to do?
何について知りたいですか？

保管庫への道は、ドラゴンのような見張りたちが守っている。彼らは、侵入してきた泥棒を焼き尽くすよう仕組まれているのだ。

ただ、ちょっとした回避策があります。生きているセンチネルを倒せば、それらは無効化され、通り抜けることができます。

数秒経てば像が火を吐くから火傷しないように気を付けて。頑張って、幸運を祈ります！

そのまま部屋の中へ入って、彼女が眠っているのを確認したら、すぐに卵のところへ駆けつけろ！
I understand if you're worried, but right now I can't think of anything else we can do...
心配なのはわかるけど、今のところ他にできることは思いつかないんだ……
Don't wait any longer, {u}! Place the egg and we can finally lure that wretched dragon out!
もう待たないで、{u}！卵を置けば、ついにあの忌々しいドラゴンを誘い出せるぞ！

Dodegar は木片を慎重に手に取り、彫り始めた。
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Dodegar Bandysnoot と話す。

来てくれてよかった、忙しくなければちょっと手伝ってほしいんだ。

僕は Dodegar Bandysnoot、世界的に有名なホビットの刀鍛冶さ！聞いたことあるかな？

ない？そう…まあいいや、世界一の武器を作る方法を思いついたんだ！
But, I need some help getting the special resources to make it.
でも、作るための特別な材料集めを手伝ってほしいんだ。
You'll help?! Excellent! We shall gather enough resources to make one for each of us!
手伝ってくれる？！やった！二人分作れるだけの材料を集めよう！
So firstly, I need some living wood for the handle, [{~} Enchanted Stick] should be enough.
まず、柄にする生きた木が要る。[{~} Enchanted Stick] あれば足りるはず。
The wood sprites located across the river to the west, in a big tree trunk, have magical properties! The handle can then mold to the user's hand! One shouldn't be too hard to come across!
西の川向こう、大きな木の幹にいる木の精には魔力があるんだ！それで柄が使い手の手に馴染むってわけ！一本くらいならすぐ手に入るはずさ！

ホビットの村 The Shiar はすぐ近くだよ！南の道を行って。弟の Gogedar がいるはず！
Dodegar needs [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] from the Shiar at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Dodegar には [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] が必要。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の The Shiar で手に入れる

兄貴がって…武器を作ろうとしてる…？

いとこの Togedar に聞いてみたら？

Dodegar? Does not really ring a bell I'm afraid.
Dodegar？悪いけど、ピンと来ないね。

ああ！Gogedar の兄さんか、それを先に言ってよ。

神聖なホビットの金属…村の名匠ホビットたちが鍛えた金属さ。手に入れるには少々高いが、うまく使えば大きな可能性を秘めている。
おや。一つ欲しいのかい？

会う人みんなに、うざくて役立たずって言われる。だから頑張るのはやめたんだ。

人生ってつらいよね。みんな耐えて戦うしかない、そしたらいつか幸せになれるかも。

あ、ごめん…話なら Balegar に聞いて。彼の方がずっと賢いから。

My cousin's nephew's dad has had a rough year... I feel bad for him.
いとこのおいっ子の親父が散々な一年でさ…気の毒だよ。
I have nooooo clue about that metal. I heard it was just as valuable as a normal rock.
その金属のことはさーっぱり分からん。ただの石と同じくらいの値打ちだって聞いたけど。
Dodegar takes the piece of metal and starts welding it.
Dodegar は金属片を受け取り、溶接し始めた。
Maybe my cousin Reyoretrsed knows anything about it.
いとこの Reyoretrsed なら何か知ってるかも。
The Shiar で Reyoretrsed を探す。

私の名前の読み方が知りたい？なんと失礼な質問だ。

レイ・オア・ツリー・セッド、当然だろう。人間がここで何をしている？

神聖な何とかの金属を持っているかって？

私は {~}。さて失礼、じっと立っているので忙しいのだ。Richard にでも絡んでくれ。

人間ってのは、本当に会話の練習をした方がいいよ。

金属を持って Dodegar の所へ戻る。
I hope it wasn't too much of an issue to get!
手に入れるの、そんなに大変じゃなかったならいいけど！

…工程を一つ忘れてた。接着剤がないと刃が付けられない。

取り付けるには森の固有種の花の蜜が要るんだ。[{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] があればいける。

その花を見つけるのはちょっと難しいから、探し方のなぞなぞを出すね。

感情が…ずいぶん高ぶっているようだね！ここはひとつ、ええと、樹冠の皆と合流して…少し時間を置かないかい？
Take. Some Time? No. No, I'm done taking time. I'm done crying, I'm done worrying! I'm so... so... angry! At the Crown, at myself, at- at Mora!!!!
時間を。置く？いや。いや、時間を置くのはもうたくさん。泣くのも、心配するのももうたくさん！私…すごく…怒ってる！王家に、自分に、M―Mora に！！！！
At all of you for treating me like I can't handle anything myself!!!
何もできないみたいに私を扱う、あなたたち全員に！！！
S-Sui, please, I- I understand, but-
DO YOU?! Do you understand?! Because it SOUNDS like everything's all just fine for you! Your brothers are still alive! You even have a plan to get them back!!
「わかる」？！本当にわかるの？！だってあなたは全部うまくいってるみたいじゃない！兄弟はまだ生きてる！取り戻す計画まであるし！！
Rex and Zeph, they... they need me. Need us! And... and I'm not letting anyone else get hurt, or- or- or d-die, not if I can stop it!!
Rex と Zeph は…私を必要としてる。私たちを！それに…私が止められるなら、もう誰も傷つけさせないし、し―し―死なせない！！
The Crown... the Sovereigns... the Queen... they'll pay. They'll pay for everything they've done to me, and my- m-my... my family...
王家…君主たち…女王…償わせてやる。私に、私の―か、家族に…したこと全部、償わせてやる…
And how exactly do you expect to be able to take vengeance in your current state, Sui? I beg of you, please rest before doing something so extreme!
で、今の状態でどうやって復讐するつもりだい、Sui？頼むから、そんな極端なことをする前に休みたまえ！
Every minute I waste is another chance for something to go wrong!!! "Fading with each and every passing moment..."
一分無駄にするごとに、何かがまずくなる可能性が増えるの！！！「刻一刻と消えていく…」
If- if only we were there sooner, then- th-then... so- so, no. No, I can't rest! I will be getting my family back!
も、もっと早く着いてたら、そ―そしたら…だ、だから、いや。休んでなんかいられない！家族を取り戻す！
Sui, we... we can't just storm off into a new district without a plan! The Canopy, they- they can help us! And Soosu's device, I'm so close to a breakthrough, I just need-
Sui、僕ら…計画もなしに新しい地区へ突っ込むなんて無理だよ！樹冠なら―樹冠なら力になってくれる！それに Soosu の装置、もうすぐ突破口が見えそうなんだ、あと―
Then stay behind, Yusanu. I... I don't need you, anyway.
なら残ればいい、Yusanu。私…どうせあなたなんていらない。
I said, I don't NEED you, Yusanu! What have you even done this whole time we've been in the {p}?! Taken as hostage, tinkering with- with- with that STUPID device!
言ったでしょ、あなたなんて「いらない」の、Yusanu！{p} にいる間、あなたが何をしたっていうの？！人質になって、あの―あの―あの「くだらない」装置をいじってただけ！
YOU haven't had to do any of the work! YOU didn't have to- to run random tasks without explanation! YOU didn't have to- to f-fight and k- k- kill a Sovereign! You... you...
「あなた」は何の苦労もしてない！「あなた」は説明もなしに―雑用を走り回らなくてよかった！「あなた」は―た、戦って君主をこ、こ、殺さなくてよかった！あなたは…あなたは…
Is... is there nothing I can say to convince you not to go?
行かないよう説得できる言葉は…何もないの？
Fine. I... I can't follow you, Sui, I can't. I'm going to stay with the Canopy... I'm going to save everyone from Deraj... and I'm going to keep working.
わかった。僕は…ついて行けないよ、Sui、無理だ。樹冠に残る…Deraj からみんなを救い出す…そして研究を続ける。
...well, this doesn't have to be goodbye for good, does it? We shall go our separate paths, for a time, then link back together further down the line!
…まあ、これが永遠の別れってわけじゃないだろう？しばらくはそれぞれの道を行き、いずれまた合流すればいい！
うん…そうだね。いいんじゃない。
Hm. If you're set on this path, you'll surely be dealing with the {p} Sovereign. Ah, Majin of House Thalas... what a delightfully horrible man he is.
ふむ。その道を行く気なら、{p} の君主と対峙することになるだろう。ああ、Thalas 家の Majin…なんとも愉快で恐ろしい男だ。
Experience? Ha! Hahahaha! Yes, I suppose you could say that! Goodness. Experience.
経験？はっ！ははははは！ああ、そう言えなくもないね！やれやれ。経験ときたか。
A word of warning... he's an easy man to underestimate. All confidence, bluster, so insufferable you could hardly believe there's anything beneath it all!
一つ忠告を…彼は侮られやすい男だ。自信たっぷりで大口ばかり、鼻持ちならなさすぎて、中身があるとは到底思えない！
But his self-proclaimed "number one" position amongst the Sovereigns isn't just for show! His confidence, his demeanour... all of it is earned. As much as one may wish otherwise!
だが君主の中で「一番」だという自称は伊達じゃない！あの自信も、あの態度も…すべて実力で勝ち取ったものだ。そうでなければいいのにと思うけどね！
And there's nothing he loves more than to exert his influence over those beneath him. Which would be, ah... everybody?
そして下の者に影響力を振るうのが何より好きときた。下の者というのは、ええと…全員かな？
... If he has my family, then... it doesn't matter. I won't let him get in my way.
…あいつが家族を捕まえてるなら…関係ない。邪魔はさせない。
Ooh, frightening. Well, I've said my piece. The rest shall be up to you!
おお、怖い。まあ、言うべきことは言った。あとは君たち次第だ！
If you ever have need of us again, we'll have set up camp in the cave we first met. You remember the one, yes? Where I-
また我々が必要になったら、最初に出会った洞窟に野営しているよ。覚えているだろう？私が―
Sui, I... I'm sorry for Mora. I hope you can... I hope you can save the others. I really do. Please... don't get yourself killed.
Sui、僕…Mora のことは残念だった。君が…他のみんなを救えるといいな。本当に。お願いだから…死なないで。
...I- I'm not planning on it. Bye, Yusanu.
…そ、そんなつもりはないよ。じゃあね、Yusanu。
You shouldn't go in here just yet.
まだここに入るべきじゃない。
Halt! You cannot go down this cave, it is blocked.
止まれ！この洞窟には入れない！中で塞がれている！
Now, here's where you come in- I need you to clear out that cave route so we can use it once more! Good luck, soldier!
そこであんたの出番だ。洞窟の道を片付けて、再び使えるようにしてくれ！健闘を祈る、兵士よ！
I can see the other side! Just a little bit more...
向こう側が見えたぞ！あと少し…
[!] Right-Click the gates of the cow pens to open them and free the cows!
[!] 牛舎の門を右クリックして開け、牛を解放せよ！
Go free those cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...
屠殺場に連れて行かれる前に、農夫から牛たちを解放してくれ！ああ、屠殺場なんて…
Looks like you freed the cows successfully! You should return to Drale, before-
牛を解放できたようだ！Drale のところへ戻ろう。その前に―
An intruder! What are you doing with my cows!? Guard golem! Attack!
侵入者だ！俺の牛に何をしている！？衛兵ゴーレム！かかれ！
You've defeated Bylvis' Guard Golem! You're in the clear now, and the cows are saved! You should return to Drale.
Bylvis の衛兵ゴーレムを倒した！もう危険はない！牛も無事だ！Drale のところへ戻ろう。
Hello again, friend! I'm here with the help! Cows, to me!
また会ったね、友よ！助っ人を連れてきた！牛たち、おいで！
You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while you do that, I'll be searching for a better career.
あんたは…先に行ってくれ。トンネルの出口にいる誰かに成功したって伝えてくれ。その間に俺はもっといい仕事を探すよ。
Talk to Captain Fenor in front of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
{p} の前 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Fenor 隊長と話す。
Ah! You must be a new recruit! Well, I've got a mission for you.
おお！あんたが新兵だな！よし、あんたに任務があるんだ！
There's an old cave behind me. It was used in the Corruption Wars...
後ろに古い洞窟がある。腐敗戦争で使われたものだ…
We used it for quick and easy travel between {p} and {p}. It’s been abandoned for years.
{p} と {p} を素早く行き来するのに使われていたが、もう何年も放置されている。
This cave could prove to be very useful for future recruits who need to travel between {p} and {p}.
この洞窟は、今後 {p} と {p} を行き来する多くの新兵の役に立つだろう。
Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Fenor 隊長の後ろ [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟に入る。
...Oh! Shoot, is it time to get to work already?
…おっと、やべ！もう仕事の時間か？
で、あんたが例の兵士だな？
Uh... well, to start, we'll need to clear that debris. Just... give it a shove, or something. That'll probably do it.
えーと…まずはこの瓦礫をどかさないとな。軽く押せば崩れるだろう。
Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.
鉱夫 Linton が道をふさぐ瓦礫を取り除くのを手伝う。
Pretty easy, huh? Hey, maybe you can just go on ahead, and do the rest yourself?
楽勝だろ？なあ、いっそあんたが先に行って、残りも片付けてくれないか？
...Yeah, no, I should probably do my job. Let me grab my pickaxe, and we can keep going forward.
…いや、だめだな。これは俺の仕事だ。ツルハシを取ってくるよ。先へ進もう。
Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.
洞窟の障害になりそうなものを片付ける。
Oh, come on... Hey, soldier, do your job! Get rid of those monsters, would you?
おいおい…兵士さん、仕事だ！あの魔物どもを片付けてくれ。
A cave-in? Really? More work for me... I'll make us a way through, just keep fighting those corrupteds!
崩落か？また仕事が増えた。俺が道を掘るから、腐敗した奴らと戦っててくれ！
Halfway there... Ugh, I knew I should have brought explosives...
やっと半分だ。はあ、爆薬を持ってくりゃよかったよ…
There we go, I've made us a hole! Get over here, quickly!
よし、穴が開いた！早くこっちに来い！
...Oh, come on. You've got to be kidding me. Another cave-in? Really?
…おいおい。冗談だろ。また崩落かよ？
And of course it's bigger than the last one. What's my pickaxe going to do against this thing?!
しかも案の定、さっきのよりデカい。ツルハシでこれをどうしろってんだ？！
Really should have thought to bring explosives. Well, soldier, we tried our best! Nobody'll blame us if we give up now.
本当に爆薬を持ってくるべきだったな。兵士さん、俺たちは最善を尽くした！ここでやめても誰も何とも言わないよ。
...What? Don't look at me like that. Fine, we can- huh? Do you hear that? Over there, to the right.
…何だよ？そんな目で見るなって。わかったよ。何だ？聞こえるか？あっちだ、右の方！
Oh, uh... Hi... Well, this is a little awkward... I'll just... Go.
あ、えっと…どうも…これはちょっと気まずいね…それじゃあ。
...You know what? I'm not going to ask. As far as I'm concerned, that didn't happen.
…いや、もういい。俺は聞きに行かない。何も起こらなかったよ。
Right, of course you want to check it out. Fine! Go ahead. I'll just... sit here and twiddle my thumbs 'till you're back.
そりゃ見に行きたいよな。いいさ！行ってこい。俺は…ここで暇つぶしして待っておくよ。
Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.
大きな瓦礫の山の右にある小さな穴を調べる。
Oh... Didn't expect you to follow me... Well, um... Hi! This will sound mad but...
あ…ついてくるとは思わなかったよ…えっと…こんにちは！変に聞こえるだろうけど…
I'm Drale, and I'm on a mission to free these cows from the enslavement of {p}.
僕は Drale。{p} で奴隷にされている牛たちを解放するために活動しているんだ。
Those farmers stole those cows. They are sacred animals. Now they're about to turn them into steak! If you were to help me, maybe I could help you...
農夫たちが牛たちを盗んだんだ。牛は神聖な動物なのに、ステーキにされようとしてるよ！手伝ってくれたら、きっと何かお返しするよ…
Go free those innocent cows from enslavement! Qu-quickly! Before that farmer gets back...
罪のない牛たちを解放してきて！は、早く！農夫が戻ってくる前に…
Where are you going? Come here and talk to me first.
どこへ行くの？まずこっちで話を聞いて。
Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.
農夫に見つからずに牛を逃がす。
Ah, good to see my cows are all in tip-top shape! Welp, time to- gah!
おお、牛たちはみんな元気いっぱいだね！さて、そろそろ―うわっ！
農夫の衛兵ゴーレムを倒す。
Golem! No! That cost me thousands of emeralds!
私のゴーレムが！そんな！何千エメラルドもしたのに！
Return to Drale about your success.
Drale のもとに戻り、成功を報告する。
Thank you so much, but we're not done yet. We need to get these cows out the province.
本当にありがとう、でもまだ終わりじゃない。この牛たちをこの地方から連れ出すよ。
There's a small opening behind me. Go through it and help me get these cows on a raft to Gavel!
僕の後ろに小さな隙間がある。そこを通って、牛たちを Gavel 行きのいかだに乗せるのを手伝って！
Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.
Drale と一緒に、牛を乗せたいかだを海へ押し出す。
There's the raft! Help me push it for the cows!
あれがそのいかだ！牛たちのために押すのを手伝って！
And, that should do it! Be free, my friends! A new life awaits!
よし、これでいい！自由になれ、友よ！新しい人生が待ってるよ！
Again, thank you so much for what you have done this day. These cows deserve a better life than being farm animals.
改めて、今日は本当にありがとう。あの牛たちには家畜より良い暮らしがふさわしいよ。
...Oh! Right! You were busy with something before you came to help me, weren't you? Hm... I think I might be able to help you with that as well! Let's go back to the tunnel!
…あっ！そうだ！僕を手伝う前、何か用事の途中だったよね？うーん…それも手伝えるかも！トンネルに戻ろう！
Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.
放棄された洞窟にいる鉱夫 Linton のもとへ戻る。
Oh, good, you're back. It's been, like, an hour! What were you even doing for that long!
おお、戻ったか。もう一時間くらい経ったぞ！そんなに長く何してたんだ！
...You helped some crazy cow-obsessed lunatic steal some cows? I don't think you're allowed to do that. There's a law against that, or something.
…牛にとりつかれた変人の牛泥棒を手伝った？それって法律かなんかで禁止されてるんじゃねえのか？
Eh. Not that I really care, either way. I've certainly done worse.
まあ、どっちでもいいけどな。俺からしたら大したことじゃねえよ。
Well then! Ready to call it quits? We're definitely not going to make any progress, so we might as we-
さてと！もうやめにするか。どうせこれ以上進めねえし。
Since you helped me with my problem, I thought I should repay that favor by helping you!
さっき手伝ってくれたから、今度は僕が恩返しに手伝おうと思って！
Welp, see ya! Oh, and nice to meet you, miner! Now, let's get going my cows!
じゃあね！あと、会えてよかったよ鉱夫さん！さあ行こう、牛たち！
...I- huh. You saw that too, right? I didn't just imagine that?
…お、俺、はあ。あんたも見たよな？俺の幻覚じゃないよな？
You know what? I think I quit. I think this has finally pushed me to my limit! I didn't know that I had one, but apparently I do!
やっぱり俺はやめるよ。今度こそ限界だ！限界なんてないと思ってたけど、あったらしい！
Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the {p} entrance of the cave.
洞窟の {p} 側出口のそばにいる Klafson 軍曹と話す。
Recruit, Captain Fenor told me to meet you here, said if you came out on this side of that tunnel then you completed your mission!
おい、新兵！Fenor 隊長からここで待つように言われてる。トンネルからあんたが出てきたら任務は終わりだと伝えろともな！
You did a great deed today, soldier! We can now use this cave to travel easily between {p} and {p}! Great job!
今日は大手柄だ、新兵！これで {p} と {p} の間を楽に行き来できるぞ！よくやった！
Where is the [Breathing Helmet I] I asked you for?
頼んでおいた [Breathing Helmet I] はどこだ？
Your best bet is to go to the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}, there should be some bait there. Just catch it in the river by the dock when you get it.
{p} の北西の伐採キャンプへ行くのが一番じゃ。そこに餌があるはずじゃよ。手に入れたら、桟橋のそばの川で釣り上げるんじゃ。
I know you might need the pufferfish for something else, but please think about giving it to me. It would warm my heart.
フグは他に使い道があるかもしれんが、どうかわしに譲ることを考えてくれんか。心が温まるんじゃ。
I wonder how Strato made that bait...
Strato はあの餌をどう作ったんじゃろ…
+ ミシック 永遠のフグ
I'm having trouble with the fish in our lake recently and I am sure the problem lies within the lake itself.
最近湖の魚のことで困っていて、原因は湖そのものにあると確信しているんだ。

I would like to commission you to investigate, but since it's freezing cold in our lake you need something to protect you. I heard the people in {p} on the coast of Wynn have something that can help you.
調査を頼みたいが、湖は凍えるほど冷たいから身を守る物が必要だ。Wynn の海岸にある {p} の人々が役立つ物を持っていると聞いた。
Would you mind coming back with a [Breathing Helmet I]? I think that should be everything you need.
[Breathing Helmet I] を持ってきてくれないか？それさえあれば十分だと思う。
Return to {p} and bring Fredris a [Breathing Helmet I]
{p} に戻り、Fredris に [Breathing Helmet I] を届ける
What is this thing supposed to be? You know, I would really appreciate your help, but this [Breathing Helmet I] does not look like it's going to keep you protected.
これは何のつもりだ？手伝ってくれるのは本当にありがたいが、この [Breathing Helmet I] じゃ身を守れそうにない。
Would you mind heading to our local armour merchant and buying one of our [Breathing Helmet II]? I don't want you to drown. Just come back with the helmet and I will tell you about my problem.
地元の防具商人から [Breathing Helmet II] を買ってきてくれないか？溺れられちゃ困る。ヘルメットを持ってきたら、問題を話そう。
Buy a [Breathing Helmet II] and find the underwater cave
[Breathing Helmet II] を買い、水中洞窟を見つける
Explore the cave underneath the frozen lake in {p}
{p} の凍った湖の下にある洞窟を探索する
Who are you? You don't look like one of those villagers we stole the fi... Wait, they didn't send you to retrieve "their" fish, did they?
誰だ？俺たちが魚を盗んだ村人には見えないが…待て、まさか「奴らの」魚を取り返しに来たのか？
For years we let them share the lake with us, the actual inhabitants of it, we were modest and took what we needed, we let them catch the rest. But then they went too far, they caught too much.
何年も、この湖の本当の住人である俺たちは奴らと湖を分け合ってきた。控えめに必要な分だけ取り、残りは奴らに獲らせた。だが奴らはやり過ぎた、獲りすぎたんだ。
We didn't have enough to eat, we were forced to steal their fish, we would have starved otherwise. And now they want their fish, our fish back? We can't do that, I hope you understand.
食べる物が足りず、魚を盗むしかなかった。でなきゃ飢え死にだ。なのに奴らの魚、俺たちの魚を返せだと？それはできない、わかってくれ。
If you want to help us and the villagers, just follow the stream that flows into this lake to the south, you will find the best fishing ground there. The pufferfish should be around there too.
俺たちと村人を助けたいなら、この湖に流れ込む川を南へたどれ。最高の釣り場がある。フグもその辺りにいるはずだ。
Follow the river south to find the fishing dock
川を南へたどり、釣り場の桟橋を見つける
Oh you look a bit lost, let me help you, I've lived here for a long time, I know every corner and every snowflake.
おや、迷ったようじゃな。手伝おう。わしは長くここに住み、隅々から雪のひとひらまで知っとる。
Sadly Strato is no longer alive. He used to work and live at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}. We always met here, caught fish and told each other stories. I really miss those times...
残念ながら Strato はもうおらん。{p} の北西にある伐採キャンプで働き、暮らしておった。わしらはいつもここで会い、魚を釣って話をしたものじゃ。あの頃が懐かしい…

Can I ask you something? As you might see I'm not the richest guy, or the youngest. If you manage to catch that fish, could you hand it over? I know we just met but you seem like somebody who would help an old man.
ひとつ頼んでいいかの？見ての通り、わしは金持ちでも若くもない。その魚を釣れたら、譲ってくれんか？会ったばかりじゃが、あんたは年寄りを助けてくれる人に見える。
Obtain the bait at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}, use it to catch the fish and then give it to Calamaro or Gernald
{p} の北西の伐採キャンプで餌を手に入れ、魚を釣って Calamaro か Gernald に渡す
Just look at those fish, I told you they love this bait.
あの魚を見てみい、この餌が大好きだと言ったじゃろ。
There it comes, the [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], I can't believe it!
来たぞ、[Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish] じゃ、信じられん！

You found a pufferfish! Who would have thought such a small thing could solve our problem. I will start bringing back the fish immediately, but first we will have a nice hot soup. Please take this as payback for your services.
フグを見つけたか！こんな小さい物で問題が解決するとはな。すぐに魚を戻し始めるが、まずは熱いスープだ。手伝いの礼にこれを受け取ってくれ。
You can trade it at the shop right over there, it's hard to miss. I will give you a last advise, you don't want to eat that slimy fish.
そこの店で交換できる、すぐわかるはずだ。最後に忠告だ、あのヌルヌルした魚は食べないほうがいい。
Meet up with Fredris in {p} and claim your reward
{p} の Fredris に会い、報酬を受け取る
Oh you are done with whatever you were doing? I heard you ran around the whole place, I don't know if you were the right person to ask for help...
おや、用事は済んだのか？あちこち走り回っていたと聞いたぞ。頼む相手を間違えたかな…
I will just ask the next one who comes around, no need to have you run around all day. Take this, I appreciate your effort.
次に来た人に頼むことにするよ、一日中走らせるのも悪い。これを受け取ってくれ、苦労に感謝する。
A real disaster! I can't believe this is happening to me!
大災難だ！まさか自分にこんなことが！
I've been fishing for the last few days and I caught nothing! Zilch! This isn't normal!
ここ数日釣りをしてるのに一匹も釣れない！ゼロだ！こんなのおかしい！
I spent my entire life fishing in this area! I wish I could dive under this ice to fix the problem myself...
この辺りで一生釣りをしてきたんだ！氷の下に潜って自分で解決できたらいいのに…
Do you think you could help me? You might actually be exactly what I need!
手伝ってくれないか？君こそ求めていた人かもしれない！
Enter my shack, there you will find the entrance... Good luck!
小屋に入れば入口がある…幸運を！
Explore under the ice to find a cause to the fish problem. You'll need the Breathing Helmet for this.
氷の下を探索し、魚の問題の原因を見つける。Breathing Helmet が必要だ。
Talk to Squidward in the Squid Village.
イカの村で Squidward と話す。
Have I seen any fish? No, of course not! I don't even know what a fish looks like!
魚を見たか？まさか！魚がどんな姿かも知らないね！
Who could be stealing all those fish? I wonder! Actually...
誰が魚を盗んでるんだろうな？不思議だ！実は…
I'm sure Calamaro did it! He's just that kind of guy. He lives in that house down there.
Calamaro の仕業に決まってる！あいつはそういう奴さ。下の家に住んでるよ。
Find Calamaro in the Squid Village.
イカの村で Calamaro を見つける。
Me? Stealing fish? You are out of your mind! It's obviously Kroken who is stealing them!
俺が？魚泥棒？正気か！盗んでるのはどう見ても Kroken だ！
He lives right on top of that waterfall right there, if you want to go talk to him.
あいつはあの滝のすぐ上に住んでる。話したきゃ行ってみな。
Find Kroken in the Squid Village.
イカの村で Kroken を見つける。
Do I look like someone who steals fish?
俺が魚泥棒に見えるか？
It's obvious that Squidward did it, he has tons of crates full of fish!
Squidward の仕業に決まってる、魚の詰まった木箱が山ほどある！
Squidward のもとに戻って話す。
Okay, okay, fine! It was me all along... I know, what a shock, right?
わかった、わかったよ！全部俺だ…驚いただろ？
Okay, I got a proposition for you. Bring me [{~} Raw Fish] and I will stop, deal?
よし、取引だ。[{~} Raw Fish] を持ってきたらやめてやる、どうだ？
Bring back {~} Raw Fish to Squidward.
Squidward に Raw Fish を {~} 匹持っていく。
よし、魚を持ってきたな！
You can trust me, I won't touch the fish in the frozen lake anymore!
信じてくれ、凍った湖の魚にはもう手を出さない！
Talk to Fredris to collect your reward.
Fredris から報酬を受け取る。
Your story really doesn't make sense. Villagers living in a squid village under the lake? Pff!
その話は筋が通らない。湖の下のイカの村に村人が住んでる？ふん！
However, if you can garantee me that my problem is gone, I'll trust you.
だが問題が消えたと保証してくれるなら、信じよう。
Thank you for your help. Here, take these...
助けてくれてありがとう。さあ、これを…
Have you found the issue yet? I'm still waiting!
原因はもう見つかったか？まだ待ってるんだぞ！
Have you seen that weird structure near the lake? I heard quite a lot of stories about it, but nobody is sure about what you can find there.
湖のそばにある妙な建物を見たか？噂はいろいろ聞くが、あそこで何が見つかるのか確かなことは誰も知らない。
However we don't have to fight over the fish in the lake, we just need a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], that would be enough, nothing else. We never wanted to steal the fish.
だが湖の魚を奪い合う必要はない。[Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish] が一匹あればそれで十分だ。魚を盗みたかったわけじゃない。

You're searching a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]? Hmm I heard that name before, my friend, Strato, told me about it years ago. If I remember correctly it is infinite, you can feed every single person in all the provinces from this single fish.
[Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish] を探しとるのか？ふむ、聞いたことがある。友の Strato が昔話してくれた。確か尽きることのない魚で、その一匹で全地方の人々を養えるそうじゃ。
Maybe you can find some sort of bait there, he had some of the best bait I have ever seen. You should be able to acquire some and throw it in the water, maybe that will attract the pufferfish.
そこで何か餌が見つかるかもしれん。あやつの餌は見たこともないほど上等じゃった。手に入れて水に投げれば、フグが寄ってくるかもしれん。
You decided to give me the fish? I wish Strato was still around, he would be so amazed. I can't show you how much this means to me, but take this little gift please, promise me to never change.
魚をわしにくれるのか？Strato がまだおったら、さぞ驚いたじゃろう。どれほど嬉しいか言い表せんが、このささやかな礼を受け取ってくれ。どうか変わらずにいておくれ。
I wish we could have avoided this whole scenario.
こんなことにならずに済めばよかったのに。
Investigate the river settlement's water troubles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で川沿いの集落の水不足を調べる。
Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
おほう、こんな身なりは久しく見とらんわい！{p} の者じゃろ？さぞ贅沢な暮らしをしとったんじゃろうな。
's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
このダムの陰の暮らしはもっと質素じゃよ。あんたみたいなのが来るとは驚いたが、文句じゃない。世界を見て回るのは立派なことじゃ！

Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
あいにく、うちの酒場は干上がっとる。酒はあるが、飲めば飲んだ以上に水が出ていく。体がカラカラになるし、今は水の余裕がこれっぽっちもない。危ないじゃろ？
The dam opens up every month or so to let out some water for us, but it passes through a noble manor, past the hill, rationed out to the rest of the forest.
ダムはひと月ごとに開いて水を流すんじゃが、丘の向こうの貴族の屋敷を通って、森の各地へ配られるんじゃ。
It's so little though, nowadays. The children are going thirsty. The muck in the riverbeds is more mud than water- so even if ya boil it out like I do, what you get is foul trifles.
じゃが近頃はほんのわずかでな。子供らが喉を渇かしとる。川底は水より泥じゃ。わしのように煮沸しても、出てくるのは汚い水ばかり。
Didn't used to be like this, though. Ain't sure what's changed, but I'm just an old geezer. I've lived my life enough- it's what it's doing to the kids that has me worried. ...say, stranger.
昔はこうじゃなかった。何が変わったのか知らんが、わしはただの老いぼれ。もう十分生きた。心配なのは子供らのことじゃ。…なあ、旅の人。
If you're touring about here, you'll probably see the manor soon enough. If ya could get them to spare us some more water a while, I'll give ya a discount! How's about it?
この辺を回るなら、じきに屋敷が見えるじゃろう。しばらく水を多めに流すよう頼んでくれたら、値引きしてやるぞ！どうじゃ？
Ain't quite sure how you would go about convincing the nobles to let out more water for us, I admit. If I did, I'd take the trek up the hill myself- even in spite of my creaky ol' back.
正直、貴族を説得して水を増やしてもらう方法は、わしにもわからん。わかっとったら、きしむ腰でも自分で丘を登っとるわい。
Even if it's just getting them to put a word in to the Sovereign. I imagine that come-lately Zhiraok would do something about it all. I swear that man doesn't know what sleep is...
君主に一言伝えてもらうだけでもいい。新顔の Zhiraok ならなんとかしてくれるじゃろう。あの男は眠るということを知らんのかのう…
I can appreciate a young'un with some spark in their eyes, but he needs to learn to slow down! What's that saying about the brightest candle burning twice as fast?
目に火の宿った若いのは好きじゃが、あやつは少し休むことを覚えにゃならん！一番明るい蝋燭は倍の速さで燃え尽きる、とか言うじゃろ？
Oh, my! Who are you? In such fantastical equipment! Certainly not a guard- I've never seen anything like it! Oh me, oh my...
まあ！どなた？なんて不思議な装備！衛兵ではないわね。こんなの見たことがないわ！まあ、まあ…
Unless... Are you, perhaps...I have heard whispers on the wind of a new Sovereign? I have seen our Sovereign dress rather differently, so maybe-
もしかして…あなたは…新しい君主のお噂を耳にしたけれど？君主様も変わった装いだったから、もしかして―
No? You aren't? Hm! Well, be that as it may, I do wish I could welcome you more hospitably, stranger, but we are in the lean time of the month- the leanest I have seen.
違う？そうではないの？ふむ！それでも、旅の方、もっと温かくお迎えしたいのだけど、今は月でいちばん苦しい時期なの。これまでで最も苦しいわ。
*cough* Oh dear, excuse me. My throat is simply so dry... My children need the water more than I, but I would darn a dozen robes for but a glass now.
*コホン* あら、失礼。喉がからからで…子供たちのほうが水が必要だけど、今なら一杯のために衣を十二着繕ってもいいわ。
The dam opens every month or so- I assume you wouldn't know, stranger. The water is rationed to us by the nobles in a manor over the hill.
ダムはひと月ごとに開くの。旅の方はご存じないわね。水は丘の向こうの屋敷の貴族が配っているのよ。
This time of year is usually dry, but the amount of water we have received lately has been less and less. I wonder what is happening...
この時期はいつも乾くけれど、最近届く水はどんどん減っているの。何が起きているのかしら…
This kind lumberer has been visiting and passing out bottles, and without him I am certain my children wouldn't have made it. I'm unsure how much longer I can keep my family healthy...
親切な木こりさんが瓶を配りに来てくれて、彼がいなければ子供たちは助からなかったわ。いつまで家族を元気に保てるか…
Oh, if only those nobles could spare more for us... Perhaps I could speak with them- but then, who would watch over my children here?
ああ、貴族たちがもう少し分けてくれたら…直接話そうかしら。でもそうしたら、誰が子供たちを見るの？
So...as much as I would like to welcome you with a meal and a hot cup of tea... I simply can't. I am just so sorry for this, stranger.
だから…お食事と熱いお茶でお迎えしたいけれど…どうしても無理なの。本当にごめんなさいね、旅の方。
I beg your pardon for it. I cannot spare the hospitality. Even my gardens I've had to abandon... My great-grandmother's flowers have wilted.
どうかお許しを。おもてなしする余裕がないの。庭まで諦めて…曾祖母の花も枯れてしまったわ。
My son had the idea to press the flowers so they would not be gone forever...But as it is, the risk of losing the rest of my family for the drought... I can't bear it!
息子が花を押し花にして残そうと考えてくれたの…でもこのままでは干ばつで残りの家族まで失うかも…耐えられないわ！
...it may be rude to ask, but...could you ask the nobles of the manor, perhaps? To spare a drop or two extra? I'd be forever indebted to you...
…失礼なお願いだけれど…屋敷の貴族に頼んでいただけないかしら？一滴か二滴多く分けてと。一生恩に着るわ…
Whoa. That is positively outlandish dress. You...couldn't be a crown guard, can you be? That's simply so far out of uniform...so are you from the {p}, maybe?
おお。なんとも奇抜な服装ですね。あなた…王家の衛兵ではないですよね？制服とはかけ離れていますし…では {p} から来られたのですか？
But then, why would you be here? The Festival...isn't that soon over in {p}? Why come all the way over here? I've hardly anything to trade, even.
でも、なぜここに？{p} のお祭りはもうすぐでは？なぜはるばるここまで？取引できる物もほとんどないのに。
It's the dry season, you know. End of the month, I'm sure you- ehm, wait. Perhaps, since you live atop the dam, that isn't the case? Oh, what I would do for that luxury!
今は乾季ですからね。月末ですし、きっと―おっと、待って。ダムの上にお住まいなら、そうでもないのでしょうか？ああ、そんな贅沢ができたら！
Well, to the point- I've nothing to sell but dry herbs. A sad state for our village, when the apothecary cannot even make medicine, but every bit of water has to go towards necessities.
さて、本題ですが、私が売れるのは乾いた薬草だけです。薬屋が薬も作れないとは村も哀れですが、水は一滴残らず必需品に回さねばなりません。
We've been receiving less and less. Some generous folks have been sharing, but that goes only so far. A glass here and there cannot revitalize my poor garden.
届く水は減る一方です。気前よく分けてくれる人もいますが、限度があります。一杯ずつでは哀れな庭は生き返りません。
If you want to find something more suited to the luxuries you might be used to, perhaps visit the manor over the hill? They do ration out the water to us, as well.
慣れた贅沢に見合う物をお探しなら、丘の向こうの屋敷を訪ねては？水を配っているのもあの方々です。
...far be it from me to make demands of a visitor, but... Should you visit, could you put in a word with them? A kindness begets a kindness, after all.
…客人に頼みごとなど柄ではありませんが…もし訪ねるなら、一言伝えていただけますか？親切は親切を呼ぶものですから。
I've lived here all my life, I have. And I've always been learned to make everything stretch, to be diligent and frugal, but with things as they are, those skills fail me.
私はずっとここで暮らしてきました。何事も切り詰め、勤勉で倹約にと教わってきましたが、こうなってはその技も役に立ちません。
People could fall ill without my services, could die, and I would hate to see our families broken apart, but I may have no choice but to leave if this keeps up.
私がいなければ病人が出て、死ぬ人もいるでしょう。家族が離れ離れになるのは嫌ですが、このままでは去るしかないかもしれません。
Oh, but I'm sure a sightseer like yourself doesn't want to hear the qualms of a man such as myself. Do enjoy the sights of our humble forest, would you?
おっと、観光の方が私のような者の愚痴など聞きたくないですよね。この質素な森の景色を楽しんでください。
With the manor over the hill there barely letting out water for us anymore, it's all getting so much tougher. Kills me to see the children struggling like this...
丘の向こうの屋敷がほとんど水を流さんようになって、何もかも厳しくなった。子供らが苦しむのを見るのはつらいわい…
So...as much as I would like to welcome you with a meal and a hot cup of tea... I simply can't. I am just so sorry for this, stranger- there is barely enough water for my own family to drink.
だから…お食事と熱いお茶でお迎えしたいけれど…どうしても無理なの。本当にごめんなさいね、旅の方。家族が飲む水さえ足りないの。
Either way... It is difficult here. Perhaps I ought petition the Sovereeign to increase the rations. I'm sure he would listen, given how much he has helped in the past twenty years, or so.
いずれにせよ…ここは厳しいです。配給を増やすよう君主に請願すべきでしょうか。この二十年ほどの尽力を思えば、きっと聞いてくださるはず。
Hrm. Can't even wash my clothes with the streams this claggy and slow... What a dilemma.
うーむ。川がこんなに濁って遅くちゃ、服も洗えん…困ったもんだ。
I'm telling you, the guards in the dam are putting something in the water to turn the frogs gigantic!
本当だって、ダムの衛兵が水に何か入れてカエルを巨大にしてるんだ！
I've seen one with my own eyes, wandering about! Soon enough they'll send them to eat us!
この目で一匹うろついてるのを見た！そのうち俺たちを食わせに送ってくるぞ！
What? Selling the house? What do you- Oh, that!
え？家を売る？何の―ああ、あれか！
No, no, a salesman sold me a 'For Sale' sign, in case I wanted to sell something. I wasn't sure where else to put it, is all.
いやいや、何か売りたくなった時用にって、セールスマンに「売り出し中」の看板を売りつけられてね。他に置き場所がなかっただけさ。
It's dry enough here that I have considered it, though...
まあ、ここまで乾いてると本気で考えたけど…
Make your way to the manor and question them. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
屋敷へ向かい、話を問いただす。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Welcome to the manor. Have the townspeople sent you?
屋敷へようこそ。町の者に遣わされたのですか？
As I had expected. In that case, let me walk you to the masters.
やはりそうでしたか。では主人方のもとへご案内します。
Still- allow me to lead you to the masters.
とはいえ、主人方のもとへご案内します。
Ah, haha! Hayn, who might this be? Ostentatious dress, I must declare! Is this a tourist come to tour the manor, mayhaps?
おお、はっは！Hayn、こちらはどなたかな？なんと派手な身なりだ！もしや屋敷の見物に来た観光客かね？
Ohh...I see! The locals sent you. Then, allow me to enlighten you on the matter. You see, the Crown has entrusted us to manage the water supplied from the dam.
おお…なるほど！地元の者に頼まれたか。では説明しよう。王家は我々にダムからの水の管理を任せているのだ。
All potable water in the forest comes through us- it is our responsibility to ensure the rations we are given are spread to where it is most needed.
森の飲み水はすべて我々を通る。与えられた配給を最も必要な所へ行き渡らせるのが我々の責任なのだ。
With the Crown Festival in {p} being about this time, the water must go there! Additionally, with all the new construction recently, there have been more places to ration out to.
ちょうど {p} で王冠祭がある時期で、水はそちらへ回さねばならん！さらに最近は新しい建設も多く、配る先が増えたのだ。
We, too, have taken a smaller share than normal. The village down there, unfortunately, has been the lowest priority for some months now. I have petitioned the Sovereign for more water...
我々も普段より少ない分で我慢している。残念ながら、下の村はここ数か月ずっと優先度が最も低い。君主には増水を請願してあるが…
...but that will not solve the problem here and now. Neither would a gulp here, or a bottle there. It does break my heart, it truly does! But we must take our responsibilities seriously.
…それでは今この場の問題は解決せん。ひと口やひと瓶を分けてもな。胸が痛む、本当に痛むとも！だが我々は責任を重んじねばならんのだ。
...Hm. Hm, hm, hm... But perhaps...what if...
…ふむ。ふむ、ふむ、ふむ…だがもしや…こうすれば…
Oh, do speak up! I hear you turning over an idea in your head, good Sir!
おお、言ってくれたまえ！何か考えを巡らせているのが聞こえるぞ、卿！

Well, perhaps it is a foolish thought. But, if they were to tinker with the dam's systems and let out more water for all of us earlier than the next month? Tide us over 'til the Nasin gets his head on straight?
まあ、愚かな考えかもしれん。だが誰かがダムの仕掛けをいじって、来月より早く皆に多めに水を流したら？Nasin が目を覚ますまでの繋ぎに？
Hm! Foolish indeed! Quite unlike you, I must say- only us and the highest ranks of the military have access to the dam! Why, we would be suspects number one, two, and three!
ふむ！実に愚かだ！君らしくもない。ダムに入れるのは我々と軍の最高位だけだ！それでは容疑者の一番、二番、三番が我々になってしまう！
And what if we were to...have some scofflaw break into the mansion, and lift the key, good Master? Why, we would be helpless bystanders, free of responsibility and suspicion.
では…どこかの無法者が屋敷に押し入り、鍵を盗んだとしたら、主人殿？我々は責任も疑いもない、哀れな傍観者というわけです。
...you mean, to have this traveler pose as a thief, and steal the key to the dam?
…つまり、この旅人に盗人を演じさせ、ダムの鍵を盗ませると？
Hahaha!! There is that wisdom I have known from you for so long! What a magnificent idea! It would not be without risk for you, traveler, but we all stand to gain!
はっはっは！！長年知る君の知恵はこれだ！なんと見事な考えだ！旅人よ、君には危険もあろうが、皆が得をするのだ！
The dam is guarded heavily, and assuredly the Crown's military would pursue you...but if you were to succeed, we could have more than enough water 'til the Sovereign receives our petition!
ダムの警備は厳重で、王家の軍が必ず君を追うだろう…だが成功すれば、君主が請願を受けるまで十分すぎる水が手に入る！
That being said, should you take it upon yourself to do this, we must pretend to have never met! To keep suspicion away from us, you know. Still, our gratitude will abound!
とはいえ、引き受けるなら我々は一度も会わなかったことにせねばならん！疑いを避けるためにな。だが感謝は尽きんぞ！
Hayn! Please bring the stranger to the rose, under which we have hidden the key. And good tidings to you!
Hayn！この客人を、鍵を隠したバラの所へ案内してくれ。君に幸運を！
Take the key to the dam from under the rose. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
バラの下からダムの鍵を取る。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Now, away with you, 'scofflaw!' Ah, haha! I shall be looking forward to sharing a veritable tidal wave of water with the forest!
さあ、行きたまえ、「無法者」！はっはっ！森と分かち合う水の大波が楽しみだ！
We shall call for the guards only after you are well out of sight. Be sure to leave a scene- it may delay them for longer.
君が見えなくなってから衛兵を呼ぶとしよう。現場は荒らしておくように。時間稼ぎになる。
Do make a mess, please. The masters will want a convincing scene.
どうぞ散らかしてください。主人方は説得力のある現場をお望みです。
If you've taken the key, take it to the entrance east of here.
鍵を取ったら、ここから東の入口へお持ちください。
Enter the Fruma Dam and find a way to make the water flow. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Fruma Dam に入り、水を流す方法を探す。[-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Hm... Then, once you have entered the dam, you should avoid returning here. I would hate to see you escape, but be caught returning to the scene of the crime.
ふむ…では、ダムに入ったらここへは戻らないことだ。逃げおおせたのに、現場に戻って捕まるのは見たくない。
So this is the scene of the robbery, then. And you say they took the key to the dam?
ここが盗難の現場か。盗まれたのはダムの鍵だと言うのだな？
This room is too open to guard effectively. Reverse psychology doesn't work on thieves- they'll check the obvious spots to cover their bases.
この部屋は広すぎて守りにくい。盗人に裏をかく手は通じない。念のため目立つ場所は全部調べるからな。
By this point...they likely will have gone into the dam. I'll have to mobilize the forces and deal with them.
今頃は…もうダムに入っているだろう。部隊を動かして対処せねば。
I'll be reporting this. You'll get a replacement key, but lose it again and you'll be relieved of your responsibilities. Consider this your one chance.
これは報告する。代わりの鍵は渡すが、また失くせば職を解く。これが唯一の機会だと思え。
So this was your plan! Here to sabotage the dam... Trying to steal water for yourself? Or did you mean to bring destruction? Cause a flood?
これが貴様の計画か！ダムを妨害しに来たな…自分のために水を盗む気か？それとも破壊が目的か？洪水を起こす気か？
I'll not be letting you get away with such heinous crimes. Lay down your weapons!
こんな凶悪な罪を見逃しはせん。武器を捨てろ！
Return to the settlement and tell them about your success. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The water seems to be flowing! Isn't it too early this month? I have to get back and tell the others.
水が流れてきたぞ！今月はまだ早いんじゃないか？戻ってみんなに知らせないと。
Wonderful, wonderful! I've sent Hayn with your payment to the village. Now hurry, hurry, 'scofflaw!' You wouldn't want to be caught, after all that trouble!
素晴らしい、素晴らしい！報酬は Hayn に村へ届けさせた。さあ急げ、急ぐのだ「無法者」！苦労の末に捕まってはたまらんだろう！
Hm! You'd best be going, else the guards may catch you. Our butler has gone away to the village with a dividend of payment. Do hurry there, would you?
ふむ！早く行くがいい、衛兵に捕まるぞ。執事が報酬の分け前を持って村へ向かった。急いでくれたまえ。
My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! My children- They'll have their water!!
ま…まあ！井戸が！！みんな、井戸に水が溜まってる！！子供たちに水が！！
The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... But I will not complain of good fortune!
川も流れています！次の配給の時期にはまだ早いはずですが…幸運に文句は言いません！
Seems like the stranger with that spark in their eyes did it! Have to give 'em that discount I mentioned. I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is.
目に火の宿ったあの旅人がやってくれたようじゃ！約束の値引きをせにゃならん。また酒場をちゃんと開けられるわい！なんと良い日じゃ。
My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! Was this... That strange fellow in the Sovereign-like dress... Did they...?! They must have!! My children- They'll have their water!!
ま…まあ！井戸が！！みんな、井戸に水が溜まってる！！これは…君主様みたいな装いのあの方が…？！きっとそうよ！！子供たちに水が！！
I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is. Say, stranger...
また酒場をちゃんと開けられるわい！良い日じゃ。なあ、旅の人…
The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... Oh! It must have been that tourist! Perhaps they asked the manor to release some extra?
川も流れています！次の配給の時期にはまだ早いはず…あっ！きっとあの観光客です！屋敷に多めに流すよう頼んでくれたのでは？
So then! I have to figure this was you! Got the manor to let out a little extra, did you?
さて！こりゃあんたの仕業じゃな！屋敷に水を多めに流させたんじゃろ？
They have risked life and limb to enter the dam and allow the water to flow freely. Show your thanks, and do not report them.
この方は命がけでダムに入り、水を流してくださいました。感謝を示し、決して通報しないように。
The masters have sent me to hand out compensation for your dangerous actions.
主人方の命で、危険を冒した皆様に補償をお配りします。
Wait, the ro- Why did you jump off th- The masters, wh- Are you from the manor?! Why did-
待って、屋―なぜ屋根から飛び―主人方、な―屋敷の方ですか？！なぜ―
There was no more water for the masters to give. They have fixed the problem for all of us.
主人方にも、もう分ける水がなかったのです。お二人が皆のために問題を解決なさいました。
Even you were short? Gracious. Still...our gardens may now grow, our children may now drink... We can only give you our utmost thanks, stranger!
そちらも足りなかったと？なんと。それでも…庭は育ち、子供たちは水を飲める…旅の方、心より感謝いたします！
Thank ye traveler. I gotta get myself back to the bar. See ye around and stay safe!
ありがとよ、旅の人。わしは酒場に戻らにゃ。またな、気をつけてな！
Did the butler just jump off the roof!? W-whatever, I have to get home! Thank you!
執事さん、今屋根から飛び降りた！？と、とにかく家に帰らなきゃ！ありがとう！
The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
水は屋敷の役にも立つわけですね？仕方ありません、少なくとも森中に配ってくれますから。
They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
なかなか抜け目ない商売人です、そのやり手ぶりはわかります。近いうちに助言をもらおうかな！
I must be going now. The guards won't forgive you for slaying Balsura, but hopefully you can keep from being caught. Good luck.
私はもう行かねば。Balsura を討ったことを衛兵は許さないでしょうが、捕まらずに済むことを願います。ご武運を。
Hey traveler, remember my promise? Discounted water for life! What do ye say? Want some?
よう旅の人、約束を覚えとるか？一生水を値引きじゃ！どうじゃ？いるかね？
Pleasure doing business with ye! Jokes aside, thanks for all you've done.
毎度あり！冗談はさておき、いろいろありがとよ。
Guh, you must be pulling my leg...! ...Thanks for all you've done, traveler.
ぐっ、からかっとるな…！…いろいろありがとよ、旅の人。
Hey traveler, good work out there. Whenever the heat's off ye, come visit me!
よう旅の人、よくやってくれた。ほとぼりが冷めたら顔を出してくれ！
You're still around, traveler! Stay safe, please! I don't know what I would do if you were caught!
旅の方、まだいたのね！どうか気をつけて！捕まったらどうしたらいいか！
Although, if you ever need some water, feel free to stop by!
でも、水が必要ならいつでも寄ってちょうだい！
Hrm. I got so used to the stream being slow that I lost my last robe to the water flow. What a dilemma.
うーむ。川の流れが遅いのに慣れすぎて、最後の衣を流されちまった。困ったもんだ。
I really ought to put away that 'For Sale' sign so no one else gets confused...
あの「売り出し中」の看板、また誰かが勘違いしないようしまっておかないとな…
Fine work, indeed! I might welcome you with a cup of tea, but I cannot abide by 'scofflaws' such as yourself- wink, wink! Now away with you! Ah, haha!
実に見事だ！茶でもてなしたいが、君のような「無法者」は許せんのでな―ウインク、ウインク！さあ行きたまえ！はっはっ！
Hm. Hm, hm, hm... I should keep better track of the ledgers. If I had noticed earlier, petitioned earlier... But of course, a Nasin wouldn't have thought ahead... Hm...
ふむ。ふむ、ふむ、ふむ…帳簿をもっとよく見ておくべきだった。早く気づき、早く請願していれば…だが当然、Nasin に先を見る頭はないか…ふむ…
Stay out of trouble from now on. The beginning of strife is as when one lets out water.
これからは面倒を起こさぬように。争いの始めは堤から水が漏れ出るようなものです。
It seems like an issue is plaguing the villagers. Try asking around to see what you can do.
村人たちは何か問題に悩まされているようだ。周りを聞いてみて、何か手助けできることはないか探してみよう。
The water should be active now. You should return back into the dam.
今頃、水は動き出しているはずだ。ダムに戻ったほうがいい。
The water is flowing again. You should follow it to see where it goes.
水がまた流れ始めた。その流れをたどって、どこへ流れていくのか見てみよう。
I will need those [{~} Gudgeon Meat] from the cave if you want that helmet!
ヘルメットが欲しいなら、洞窟から [{~} Gudgeon Meat] を持ってきてくれ！
また会えてうれしいよ！
But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that our fortune is hidden within it.
だが最近、この難破船に小さな穴が開いた。中に我らの財宝が眠っていると言われている。
Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
{p} の北 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Omango と話す
Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
やあ、私は Omango。丘の上の {p} 村の住人だ。
As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
知っているかもしれないが、私たちの民は昔この地へ渡ってきた。これがその時の船だ。
They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
彼らは贅沢品を大量に持ってきたが、ほとんどは難破で失われた。
Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
残念ながら、誰も探索できていない。深すぎて、そんなに長く水中にいられる生き物はいない！
However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
だが旧友の Sayrr は漁師で、とても特別なヘルメットを持っているんだ…
If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
彼を説得してヘルメットをもらい、宝を見つけたら、分け前をあげよう！
Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Sayrr は船で沖に出ているが、隣の洞窟を通れば彼の釣り場まですぐだ。道中は気をつけて。
When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
ヘルメットを手に入れたら船を探索し、[{~} Ancient Treasure] を持ち帰ってくれ。幸運を。
Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟を抜け、反対側の船にいる Sayrr を見つける
Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
なんだその目は？俺が小さいからか、ええ？言っとくが、お前の倍はある魚を釣ったことがあるんだぜ！
...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
…いや、昔は釣れたんだ。最近はさっぱり食いつかねえ―待て、そもそもなんで俺の船に乗ってきた？
Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
あはっ！ああ、古い呼吸ヘルメットならまだある。欲しいのか？なら先に頼みを聞いてもらうぜ。
I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
聞こえてただろうが、この辺じゃもう魚が食いつかねえ！なんとか稼がなきゃならねえ！あの洞窟に魚はいるんだが…
...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
…ちょっと危ねえんだ。そうだな、釣り竿を貸してやるから、下で [{~} Gudgeon Meat] でも釣ってきてくれ。
The helmet will be all yours after that.
そしたらヘルメットはお前のもんだ。
Bring back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr
[{~} Gudgeon Meat] を Sayrr に持ち帰る ([-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟で入手)
Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
おう！おかえり！魚は釣れたか？
Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
いいね、恩に着るぜ。ほらヘルメットだ、楽しめよ。
Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の難破船を探索し、失われた宝を探す
Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
木箱を壊し、[{~} Old Treasure] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Omango に届ける
You got it! You found the treasure!
やった！宝を見つけたんだね！
As promised, here's your part of the loot.
約束通り、これが君の分け前だ。
Do I know anything about Mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
ミイラに詳しいか？もちろん！一生かけて研究してきたんだ！
Mummies aren't known to be weak, especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil. It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
ミイラは弱いものではない…特にあれは。悪魔的で…純粋な邪悪。私が出会った中でも間違いなく最強の部類だ。
Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just restocked.
ただし…なあ。ピンクの羊毛がずっと欲しかったんだが、唯一売ってる店がちょうど入荷したところでな。
Or better yet, if you happen to have some of that pink wool on you. If you give it to me, well... the tomb is all yours.
いや、もっといいのは、お前がピンクの羊毛をたまたま持ってる場合だ。渡してくれりゃ… 墓はお前のもんだ。
Either way, you can take my wagon over there to {p}, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.
どっちにしろ、向こうの {p} まで俺の荷馬車を使っていいが、帰りは自力だ。[{~} ピンクの羊毛] を渡せば通してやる。
Have you got me [{~} Pink Wool] yet!? You can get it from the shop in {p}.
[{~} ピンクの羊毛] はまだか！？{p} の店で買えるぞ。
I don't know you, and you don't know me. Got it?
俺はお前を知らねえし、お前も俺を知らねえ。いいな？
I live in this camp by choice. A curse follows me... and now trouble starts wherever I go. I left civilization and made camp in the desert, where I could do no more harm.
私は好きでこの野営地に住んでいる。呪いにつきまとわれ…行く先々で災いが起きるのだ。だから文明を離れ、害を及ぼさぬよう砂漠に野営した。
I do miss the comforts of {p} some days, though... you look like a learned adventurer. If I asked you to investigate this curse, perhaps you could help me rid myself of it?
それでも {p} の暮らしが恋しい日もある…君は学のある冒険者に見える。この呪いを調べてくれたら、解く手助けになるだろうか？
It all started when I discovered an old tomb in the North of the desert. Upon entering it, the ground started shaking and I heard inhuman screams coming from deeper within.
すべては砂漠の北で古い墓を見つけた時に始まった。中に入ると地面が揺れ、奥から人ならぬ叫び声が聞こえたのだ。
I ran as fast as I could, learning later the tomb housed the remains of an ancient Mummy... which I accidentally awoke. If the Mummy could be put back to rest, perhaps the curse would go away.
必死に逃げ、後で知ったのだが、その墓には古代のミイラが眠っていた…私はそれをうっかり起こしてしまった。ミイラを再び眠らせれば、呪いも消えるかもしれない。
I have heard of a scholar in {p}, Achper, who may know more about the tomb. I am reluctant to return to the city, in case my presence hurts anyone else.
{p} に Achper という学者がいて、その墓に詳しいらしい。私がいると誰かを傷つけかねないから、街には戻りたくないのだ。
If you would truly like to help, you should start by talking to him.
本当に助けてくれるなら、まず彼と話すといい。
Talk to Achper in {p} about the curse at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Achper に呪いのことを聞く。
They usually are very hard to reach, hidden in their tomb... and they don't like being disturbed.
たいてい墓に隠れていて近づくのはとても難しい…それに邪魔されるのを嫌う。
I have heard of the curse that follows Ormrod, and the only way to remove its effects would be to kill the mummy.
Ormrod につきまとう呪いの話は聞いている。その効果を消す唯一の方法はミイラを倒すことだ。
The tomb lies in the North of the desert, but be very careful!
墓は砂漠の北にある。だが十分に気をつけて！
On top of that, the Creden Tibus bandit clan have been ransacking the tombs around the desert. You might run into trouble with them, so be prepared.
おまけに、盗賊団 Creden Tibus が砂漠中の墓を荒らしている。出くわすかもしれないから備えておくように。
Attempt to enter the Mummy's tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
[{~}, {~}, -{~}] のミイラの墓に入ってみる
Stop! If you're thinking about looting the tomb, you're too late. The Creden Tibus have laid claim here, and you're not getting past.
止まれ！墓を荒らしに来たなら遅かったな。ここは Creden Tibus が押さえた。通さねえぞ。
Mummy? Curse? I don't know anything about that, but I can't let you in - how do I know you won't just grab the gold?
ミイラ？呪い？そんなの知らねえが、入れるわけにはいかねえ。金を持ち逃げしねえって保証がどこにある？
Trouble is, the shop's over in {p} and I'm stuck guarding this tomb. If you go and grab me some before it sells out, I can look the other way.
問題は、その店が {p} にあって、俺はこの墓の見張りで動けねえ。売り切れる前に買ってきてくれたら、見逃してやる。
Use the bandit's wagon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to get to {p}.
[{~}, {~}, -{~}] の盗賊の荷馬車で {p} へ向かう。
Bring back [{~} Pink Wool] to the bandit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[{~} ピンクの羊毛] を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の盗賊に届ける。
Well, whaddya know? You got some Pink Wool! Okay, hand it here and I'll look the other way and let you into the tomb.
おやおや、驚いた！ピンクの羊毛を手に入れたか！よし、渡しな。見なかったことにして墓に入れてやる。
Just don't touch any of the gold, hmm? And if I were you, I wouldn't go in too deep.
ただし金には触るなよ？それと、俺ならあまり奥へは行かねえ。
The clan was going to explore further inside, but the sounds...
団の連中は奥まで探るつもりだったが、あの音が…
Anyway, I'll still let you inside if you want. Just remember, if anyone asks, this conversation never happened.
とにかく、入りたきゃ入れてやる。ただ覚えとけ、誰かに聞かれても、この話はなかったことだ。
Enter the tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and kill the Mummy.
[{~}, {~}, -{~}] の墓に入り、ミイラを倒す。
Bring [{~} Mummy's Bandage] to Ormrod at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
[{~} ミイラの包帯] を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Ormrod に届ける。
Hello, again... have you had any luck?
やあ、また会ったな…どうだった？
Those are the Mummy's bandages?! You did it? My curse is finally lifted!
それはミイラの包帯？！やったのか？ついに呪いが解けた！
I can't thank you enough! As a reward, take this rag I got from the Mummy when I entered the tomb.
感謝してもしきれない！礼として、墓に入った時にミイラから取ったこの布をあげよう。
I am not strong enough to wear it, but I'm sure you are! Take these emeralds too, that's the least I can do!
私には身につける力はないが、君ならきっと大丈夫だ！このエメラルドも持っていってくれ、せめてもの礼だ！
Well, I figured it out soon after you got back. We possess the crystal, don't go looking for Wynn Excavation again, all is not what it seems. Take that as a friendly warning.
まあ、君が戻ってすぐに分かったよ。水晶は我々の手にある。もう Wynn Excavation を探すな、見かけ通りではないんだ。友としての忠告だと思ってくれ。
クエストライン開始: WynnExcavation
Vade に言われて来たの？
One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh, and don't read it!
石板ひとつ完成！Vade に返してね。あ、読んじゃダメよ！
A strange force pushes you back!
奇妙な力に押し戻された！
What are you still doing over here? Go finish your assignment! It's written in your content book.
まだこんな所で何してんだ？さっさと仕事を終わらせろ！コンテンツブックに書いてあるだろ。
[{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる発掘者 Vade と話す
Oh, hey kid. Wanna make some money?
I need you to translate this ancient text.
この古代文書を翻訳してもらいたい。
Just run it down to the lab assistant, Tesha.
研究助手の Tesha に持っていくだけでいい。
I'd take it myself, but I'm far too important for grunt work! The lab is up there in the tent, and don't you dare damage the translation!
自分で行ってもいいが、俺みたいな大物が雑用なんてやれるか！研究所は上のテントだ。翻訳に傷なんかつけるなよ！
Bring the Ancient Writing to Tesha in the tents at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
古代の文書を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] のテントにいる Tesha に届ける
WynnExcavation 研究所へようこそ！
Oh yes, the tablet I was waiting for!
そうそう、待ってた石板！
Oh my! This is quite interesting..
Here, let me finish this up...
Return to Excavator Vade with the translated writing
翻訳された文書を持って発掘者 Vade のもとへ戻る
Oh right, you're that kid I sent out!
ああ、俺が使いに出した小僧か！
Well do you have the translated text or not?
で、翻訳は持ってきたのか？
You do! Brilliant! Let's take a look at that...
持ってるな！上出来だ！どれ、見せてみろ…
"Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
「際立つ木材に供物を投げよ。正しき隅が道を開く」
I wonder if it is talking about inside the temple... Oh, uh, I forgot you were here. Stay out of this kid, it's grown up business!
神殿の中のことを言ってるのか…おっと、お前がいるのを忘れてた。首を突っ込むなよ小僧、大人の仕事だ！
